Add broccoli and cook 1 more minute.
Whisk egg whites, cottage cheese, garlic powder, and seasoning salt in a large bowl; add cooked vegetables and stir to combine.
Line each muffin cup with a half slice of turkey bacon around the edges.
Pour in egg mixture about 1/3 cup per cup. Top with cheddar.
Bake 25 minutes in the center of the oven until set.

name: Golden Milk Overnight Oats
description: Anti-inflammatory turmeric-spiced overnight oats with coconut milk and almond butter.
instructions: Combine coconut milk, chia seeds, turmeric, cinnamon, ginger, almond butter, and maple syrup in a jar; stir until spices are incorporated.
Add rolled oats and stir to combine pressing down to ensure oats are submerged.
Cover and refrigerate overnight or at least 6 hours.
In the morning top with sliced banana and coconut flakes.
Enjoy cold or gently warmed.

name: Greek Yogurt Parfait
description: Layered Greek yogurt with fresh berries and honey-sweetened granola for a quick high-protein breakfast.
instructions: Mix Greek yogurt with vanilla extract.
Spoon half the yogurt into a glass or bowl.
Add half the berries and a sprinkle of granola.
Repeat layers with remaining yogurt and berries.
Drizzle with honey and top with remaining granola and chia seeds.
Serve immediately or refrigerate up to 1 day.

name: Savory Breakfast Quinoa Bowl
description: A hearty bowl of cooked quinoa topped with soft-boiled eggs and sauteed spinach with avocado and feta.
ingredients: salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Bring a small pot of water to a gentle simmer; lower eggs in and cook 7 minutes for jammy yolks. Transfer to ice water to cool then peel and halve.
Heat olive oil in a small skillet over medium heat; add garlic and cook 30 seconds.
Add spinach and tomatoes; cook stirring until spinach wilts about 2-3 minutes.
Divide quinoa between bowls. Top with sauteed spinach and tomatoes, avocado slices, and halved eggs.
Crumble feta over top and season with salt, pepper, and red pepper flakes.
Serve immediately.

name: Brussels Sprout and Bacon Frittata
description: A rich broiled frittata with crispy bacon and tender brussels sprouts with melted Gruyere cheese.
ingredients: 2 small shallots halved and thinly sliced
3/4 lb brussels sprouts halved and sliced 1/4 inch thick
freshly ground black pepper to taste
instructions: Preheat broiler with rack 6 inches from heat.
Cook bacon in a 10-inch oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat until almost crisp about 5 minutes.
Add shallots and cook until softened about 3 minutes.
Add brussels sprouts, season with salt and pepper, and cook tossing until crisp-tender and lightly browned about 5 minutes.
Beat eggs with milk, salt, and pepper in a bowl; stir in cheese and half the chives.
Pour egg mixture into skillet; cook over moderate heat stirring gently until eggs start to set then cook until bottom is lightly browned about 5 more minutes.
Transfer to broiler and cook until top is deep golden and eggs are just set about 5 minutes.
Scatter remaining chives over top and slice into 6 wedges to serve.

name: Sweet Potato and Black Bean Grain Bowl
description: A nourishing bowl of roasted sweet potatoes and black beans over bulgur with green tahini sauce.
instructions: Toast dry bulgur in a saucepan over medium heat 2-3 minutes; add 2 cups water, bring to a boil, cover, and simmer 12 minutes; rest 5 minutes then fluff.
Preheat oven to 400 degrees F; toss sweet potato cubes with olive oil, salt, and pepper on a baking sheet; roast 30 minutes until tender.
Blend cilantro, tahini, lemon juice, garlic, and water until smooth to make the green tahini sauce; season with salt.
Rinse and drain black beans. Slice avocado and jalapeno.
Divide bulgur among four bowls; top with sweet potatoes, black beans, avocado, and jalapeno.
Sprinkle pepitas over each bowl and drizzle generously with green tahini sauce.

name: Cottage Cheese Breakfast Bowl
description: A protein-rich cottage cheese bowl with blueberries and almonds finished with a drizzle of honey.
instructions: Stir vanilla extract into cottage cheese.
Transfer to a bowl and top with blueberries and almonds.
Drizzle honey over top and dust with cinnamon.
Serve immediately or refrigerate up to 2 days.

name: Chocolate Overnight Oats
description: Rich cocoa overnight oats with almond butter that taste indulgent but fuel your morning with fiber.
instructions: Add almond milk, almond butter, maple syrup, chia seeds, and vanilla to a mason jar; stir to combine.
Add oats, cocoa powder, and salt; mix well until cocoa powder is fully incorporated.
Press down with a spoon to ensure all oats are submerged.
Seal and refrigerate overnight or at least 6 hours.
In the morning stir and top with fresh raspberries.
Enjoy cold or microwave briefly to warm.

name: Homemade Maple Pecan Granola
description: Crunchy oven-baked oat and pecan granola sweetened with maple syrup for healthy parfaits and bowls.
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups raw pecans and pepitas mixed
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F and line a large rimmed baking sheet with parchment paper.
Combine oats, nuts and seeds, salt, and cinnamon in a large bowl and stir to blend.
Add coconut oil, maple syrup, and vanilla; mix well until every oat is coated.
Spread onto prepared pan in an even layer.
Bake 21-24 minutes stirring halfway until lightly golden.
Let cool completely undisturbed for at least 45 minutes.
Stir in dried cranberries; break into clusters and store in an airtight container.

name: Spinach and Feta Scrambled Eggs
description: Fluffy scrambled eggs folded with wilted spinach and tangy feta for a fast protein-packed breakfast.
ingredients: salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Whisk eggs and milk together in a bowl; season with salt and pepper.
Melt butter in a nonstick skillet over medium-low heat; add garlic and cook 30 seconds.
Add spinach and cook until just wilted about 1 minute.
Pour in egg mixture and let sit briefly then gently fold and pull eggs toward center to form soft curds.
Remove from heat while still slightly underdone.
Fold in crumbled feta and serve immediately on toast or alone.

name: Avocado Egg Toast with Everything Bagel Seasoning
description: Toasted whole-grain bread topped with mashed avocado and a fried egg finished with everything bagel seasoning.
ingredients: salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Toast bread until golden and firm.
Mash avocado in a small bowl with lemon juice, salt, and pepper.
Heat olive oil in a small nonstick skillet over medium heat; crack egg in and cook until whites are set and yolk is runny about 3 minutes.
Spread mashed avocado on toast.
Place fried egg on top and sprinkle with everything bagel seasoning and red pepper flakes.
Serve immediately.

name: Banana Oat Pancakes
description: Light gluten-free pancakes blended from rolled oats and ripe banana with no flour needed.
ingredients: coconut oil or butter for cooking
instructions: Add all ingredients to a blender in order: almond milk, eggs, egg white, banana, maple syrup, vanilla, oats, baking powder, and salt.
Blend until completely smooth.
Let batter rest 5 minutes while heating a skillet over medium heat.
Grease skillet lightly with coconut oil and pour batter into rounds.
Cook 2-3 minutes until bubbles form on surface; flip and cook 1-2 minutes more until golden.
Serve with maple syrup and fresh fruit.

name: Mango Coconut Chia Pudding
description: Tropical chia pudding made with coconut milk and topped with fresh mango for a vibrant no-cook breakfast.
instructions: Whisk chia seeds, coconut milk, maple syrup, and vanilla in a jar or bowl.
Refrigerate 2 hours then stir well to break up clumps.
Return to fridge and chill overnight until thick and set.
Toss diced mango with lime juice.
Spoon chia pudding into bowls and top with mango and toasted coconut flakes.
Serve chilled.

name: Turkey Sausage and Sweet Potato Hash
description: A hearty skillet hash of roasted sweet potatoes and turkey sausage topped with fried eggs.
ingredients: 2 medium sweet potatoes peeled and diced
12 oz turkey breakfast sausage casings removed
salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a large cast-iron skillet over medium-high heat.
Add sweet potato cubes, season with paprika, garlic powder, salt, and pepper; cook turning occasionally until tender and caramelized about 12 minutes.
Push potatoes to the side; add remaining oil and cook turkey sausage breaking it up until browned about 5 minutes.
Add bell pepper and onion; cook until softened about 4 minutes.
Mix everything together and make 4 wells; crack an egg into each well.
Cover and cook until egg whites are set about 4-5 minutes.
Garnish with parsley and serve.

name: Spinach and Mushroom Breakfast Burrito
description: A protein-rich whole-grain wrap filled with scrambled eggs and sauteed mushrooms with fresh salsa.
ingredients: salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Heat olive oil in a nonstick skillet over medium heat; add mushrooms and cook until browned about 4 minutes.
Add spinach and cumin; cook stirring until spinach wilts about 2 minutes. Transfer to a bowl.
Whisk eggs with salt and pepper; pour into the same skillet over medium-low heat and scramble gently until just set.
Warm tortillas briefly in a dry pan or microwave.
Divide eggs, mushroom mixture, and cheese between tortillas.
Top each with salsa then fold up the bottom, tuck in the sides, and roll to close.
Serve immediately.

name: Strawberry Almond Butter Yogurt Parfait
description: Creamy Greek yogurt layered with fresh strawberries and granola with an almond butter drizzle.
instructions: Stir vanilla and cinnamon into Greek yogurt.
Warm almond butter in a microwave 15-20 seconds until drizzleable.
Spoon half the yogurt into two glasses or bowls.
Layer half the strawberries and granola over the yogurt.
Repeat with remaining yogurt, strawberries, and granola.
Drizzle honey and almond butter over the top.
Serve immediately.

name: Kale and White Bean Breakfast Bowl
description: A savory bowl of sauteed kale and cannellini beans over farro with a poached egg and lemon.
ingredients: 1 can cannellini beans rinsed and drained
4 cups lacinato kale stems removed and chopped
salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Warm farro if needed and divide between two bowls.
Heat 1 tbsp olive oil over medium heat; add garlic and red pepper flakes and cook 30 seconds.
Add kale and beans; cook tossing until kale wilts and beans are warmed through about 5 minutes. Season with salt and pepper.
Bring a shallow pot of water to a gentle simmer; add a splash of vinegar. Crack eggs into separate cups and slide into water; poach 3-4 minutes until whites are set.
Top each farro bowl with kale-bean mixture and a poached egg.
Drizzle with remaining olive oil and lemon juice; top with shaved Parmesan.

name: Sheet Pan Greek Chicken and Vegetables
description: Lemon-garlic marinated chicken breast roasted with bell peppers and tomatoes topped with feta and olives.
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F. Whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, oregano, salt, and pepper; reserve lemon zest.
Toss tomatoes, bell peppers, and onion on a large baking sheet with half the marinade; roast 10 minutes.
Pound chicken breasts to even 3/4-inch thickness and cut each in half; toss with remaining marinade.
Push vegetables to the sides of the sheet pan and add chicken to the center.
Bake 20–25 minutes until chicken reaches 165°F; broil 5 minutes for extra browning.
Top with olives, feta, lemon zest, and fresh parsley before serving.

name: Slow Cooker Chicken Taco Bowls
description: Tender shredded chicken slow-cooked with salsa and black beans served over rice.
instructions: Place chicken breasts in the bottom of a 6-quart slow cooker.
Add black beans, salsa, corn, water, garlic, chili powder, cumin, oregano, cayenne, and pepper; stir briefly.
Cook on low for 8 hours or high for 4 hours.
Cook rice according to package directions; time to finish with slow cooker.
Shred chicken using two forks; stir to combine with the cooking liquid. Taste and add salt if needed.
Build bowls with 1 cup rice, 1 cup chicken mixture, shredded cheese, and sliced green onions.

name: Chicken Stir Fry with Broccoli and Peppers
description: Quick weeknight stir-fry with tender chicken and crisp vegetables in a savory sesame-ginger sauce.
ingredients: 2 boneless skinless chicken breasts cut into 1/2-inch pieces
instructions: Whisk together soy sauce, brown sugar, sesame oil, garlic, ginger, sriracha, cornstarch, and water; set aside.
Heat large wok or skillet over medium-high; add 2 tbsp oil. Add chicken; cook until browned, about 5–7 minutes. Remove to a plate.
Add remaining oil; add carrots and broccoli. Cook and stir 1 minute until broccoli turns bright green.
Add bell pepper and onion; cook and stir 1–2 minutes more.
Return chicken to skillet; pour sauce over everything and stir.
Simmer 1–2 minutes until sauce thickens and turns glossy. Top with green onions and serve over rice.

name: Turkey Meatballs with Marinara
description: Baked lean turkey meatballs seasoned with Italian herbs and served over your favorite sauce.
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F; line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Combine breadcrumbs, Parmesan, Italian seasoning, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and pepper in a bowl.
In a large bowl, combine ground turkey and egg; add breadcrumb mixture. Mix with hands until just combined; do not overmix.
Divide and shape into 16 meatballs (about 2 tbsp each). Place on prepared baking sheet.
Bake 20 minutes until cooked through and internal temperature reaches 165°F.
Warm marinara sauce and serve meatballs over pasta or zucchini noodles.

name: One Pot Chicken and Rice
description: Seasoned chicken thighs seared then simmered over fluffy rice in one skillet for a complete meal.
instructions: Mix paprika, oregano, thyme, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and pepper; coat both sides of chicken.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in deep skillet over medium; sear chicken 5 minutes per side until browned. Remove to a plate.
Add remaining oil and onion; sauté 5 minutes until softened, scraping up browned bits.
Add rice; sauté 1–2 minutes until lightly toasted.
Add broth; stir. Return chicken on top of rice. Cover, bring to boil, then reduce to low; simmer 20 minutes without lifting lid.
Turn off heat; rest 5 minutes. Fluff rice and garnish with parsley.

name: Sheet Pan Lemon Balsamic Chicken and Potatoes
description: Balsamic-marinated chicken and baby potatoes roasted together with briny olives and a creamy feta sauce.
ingredients: 6 boneless skinless chicken breasts or thighs
1 cup mixed fresh herbs dill or basil
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F. Toss potatoes with 2 tbsp olive oil on a large sheet pan; season with salt and pepper.
In a bowl, combine 2 tbsp olive oil, balsamic, Dijon, oregano, paprika, garlic, shallot, salt, pepper, and chili flakes; add chicken and toss.
Nestle chicken among potatoes on the sheet pan.
Bake 25–30 minutes until chicken is cooked through to 165°F.
Mix remaining 1/3 cup olive oil with lemon juice, herbs, and olives. Mix tzatziki with crumbled feta.
Spoon herby olive mixture over chicken; serve with tzatziki-feta sauce.

name: Sheet Pan Chicken Tzatziki with Sweet Potatoes
description: Spiced chicken and roasted sweet potatoes served bowl-style with tzatziki and honey garlic tahini.
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless skinless chicken breasts or thighs cubed
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°F; rub a baking sheet with oil.
Toss chicken with paprika, oregano, garlic powder, onion powder, turmeric, salt, pepper, and 2 tbsp olive oil on one side of sheet pan.
Add sweet potatoes to the other side; toss with remaining oil, salt, and pepper.
Bake 15–20 minutes until chicken is cooked through; toss and cook 5 more minutes until crisp.
Make tahini sauce by whisking tahini, garlic, lemon juice, honey, and 1/4 cup water until smooth; season with salt.
Serve chicken and sweet potatoes over rice with tzatziki, tahini sauce, feta, and sesame seeds.

name: One Pan Lemon Pepper Yogurt Chicken and Rice
description: Greek yogurt marinated chicken baked over fluffy basmati rice and broccoli all in one pan.
ingredients: 6 bone-in or boneless chicken thighs or breasts
instructions: Toss chicken with olive oil, yogurt, lemon zest, garlic, pepper, oregano, thyme, paprika, onion powder, and salt. Marinate 30 minutes if time allows.
Preheat oven to 400°F.
Pour rice and broccoli into a 9×13-inch baking dish; add water and dot with butter.
Arrange marinated chicken over the rice and broccoli.
Bake 30–40 minutes until rice is fluffy and chicken reaches 165°F. If rice seems dry, add 1/3 cup water and bake 10 more minutes.
Serve topped with fresh basil or thyme.

name: One Skillet Greek Lemon Chicken and Rice
description: Seared chicken thighs finished in the oven over toasted orzo and rice with olives and feta.
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F. In a large oven-safe skillet, combine 1 tbsp olive oil, chicken, oregano, paprika, cayenne, 1 tbsp thyme, salt, and pepper; toss to coat.
Set skillet over high heat; sear chicken 3–5 minutes per side until golden. Remove from skillet.
Add butter, orzo, rice, shallots, garlic, and remaining thyme; cook until toasted, about 3 minutes. Add butter and lemon slices; let butter brown.
Pour in broth; stir in spinach. Season with salt and pepper; bring to a boil. Return chicken to skillet.
Cover; reduce heat to lowest setting; cook 10 minutes. Bake uncovered 10–15 minutes until chicken is cooked through.
Top with feta, olives, lemon juice, basil, and a drizzle of olive oil; serve.

name: Pork Tenderloin with Herb Seasoning
description: Herb-crusted pork tenderloin seared golden then finished in the oven to juicy perfection.
ingredients: 1/2 cup white wine or chicken stock
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F. Trim silver skin from each tenderloin; pat dry.
Mix salt, pepper, granulated garlic, and herbes de Provence; rub evenly over pork.
Heat oil in a large oven-proof skillet over medium-high until shimmering. Add tenderloins; cook undisturbed 5 minutes until golden. Flip and cook 3 more minutes.
Add wine or stock; cook 1 minute. Transfer pan to oven.
Bake 15–19 minutes until internal temperature reaches 145°F.
Transfer to cutting board; rest 5–10 minutes before slicing. Serve with pan juices.

name: Mediterranean Turkey Meatball Sheet Pan Dinner
description: Herb-packed turkey meatballs baked alongside lemon-dressed peppers and zucchini on one pan.
ingredients: 1 tbsp each fresh rosemary oregano dill and mint chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F; line a baking sheet with parchment.
Mix together parsley, rosemary, oregano, dill, mint, salt, and pepper; reserve 2 tbsp for vegetables.
Add breadcrumbs, shallot, garlic, and lemon zest to herb bowl; whisk egg with 1 tbsp oil and add. Add ground turkey; mix until just combined.
Shape into 18 meatballs; arrange on sheet pan; spray lightly with oil. Bake 15 minutes.
Toss bell peppers, onion, and zucchini with lemon juice, reserved herbs, and 1 tbsp oil; scatter around meatballs.
Return to oven 15 more minutes until vegetables are tender and meatballs reach 165°F. Top with feta and tomatoes.

name: Sheet Pan Honey Buffalo Chicken with Broccoli
description: Crispy baked chicken tossed in a sweet-hot buffalo sauce alongside perfectly roasted broccoli.
ingredients: 2 lbs chicken breasts or thighs cubed
ranch or blue cheese dressing for serving
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°F; line a baking sheet with parchment.
Toss chicken with paprika, onion powder, garlic powder, salt, and pepper. Add flour; toss again. Add 2 tbsp oil; toss to coat.
Arrange chicken on one side of the pan; toss broccoli with remaining oil on the other side.
Bake 15–20 minutes until chicken is cooked through.
Meanwhile melt hot sauce, butter, seasoned salt, and cayenne in a saucepan. Remove from heat and stir in honey.
Remove broccoli from pan; pour buffalo sauce over chicken and toss. Bake 5 more minutes. Serve with green onions and ranch dressing.

name: Greek Lemon Chicken and Potatoes
description: Classic roasted chicken thighs and potatoes bathed in lemon olive oil and oregano for a robust one-pan dinner.
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F; lightly oil a large roasting pan.
Combine lemon juice, olive oil, garlic, dried oregano, salt, rosemary, pepper, and cayenne in a large bowl. Add chicken and potatoes; toss to coat.
Place chicken skin-side up in the roasting pan; tuck potatoes around chicken; drizzle with 2/3 cup broth. Spoon any remaining marinade over top.
Bake 20 minutes; toss chicken and potatoes. Place chicken skin-side up again; bake another 25 minutes until browned and 165°F at the bone.
Transfer chicken to platter. Toss potatoes with pan juices; broil 3 minutes until crisped.
Deglaze pan with remaining 1/3 cup broth; strain pan juices over chicken and potatoes. Garnish with fresh oregano.

name: BBQ Chicken Burrito Bowls
description: Smoky BBQ chicken over rice with black beans corn and avocado makes a colorful and satisfying bowl.
ingredients: 15 oz can black beans drained and rinsed
instructions: Shred or chop chicken breast and toss with 2–3 tbsp BBQ sauce until well coated.
Drain and rinse black beans. Dice zucchini into 1/4-inch cubes. Shred cheese, slice green onions, and slice avocado.
Prepare 4 cups cooked rice if not already ready.
Build each bowl: place 1 cup rice in the bottom.
Divide chicken, beans, corn, zucchini, cheese, green onions, and avocado evenly among the four bowls.
Drizzle 1 tbsp BBQ sauce over each bowl and serve immediately or refrigerate for meal prep.

name: Sweet and Spicy Chicken Bowl
description: Honey-spiced chicken with pineapple and black beans over brown rice in a vibrant weeknight bowl.
ingredients: 1 boneless skinless chicken breast (3/4 lb) cubed
instructions: Cook rice in chicken broth: bring to boil, cover, simmer 25 minutes on low; rest 10 minutes off heat then fluff.
Mix chili powder, cumin, paprika, garlic powder, cayenne, salt, olive oil, honey, and apple cider vinegar in a bowl.
Add cubed chicken to spice mix; toss until coated. Set aside.
Prepare toppings: drain pineapple and chop smaller, rinse beans, slice green onions, cube avocado, chop cilantro.
Heat non-stick skillet over medium; cook chicken 5–7 minutes until cooked through and slightly caramelized.
Build bowls with 3/4 cup rice, then chicken, beans, pineapple, avocado, green onions, and cilantro.

name: Baked Chicken Breasts and Vegetables
description: Simple Italian-seasoned chicken breasts baked alongside carrots celery and bell peppers for an easy one-pan dinner.
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F.
Arrange chicken breasts in the center of a large baking sheet.
Spread carrots, celery, green onion, and bell peppers around the chicken.
Drizzle olive oil over chicken and vegetables evenly.
Season everything with Italian seasoning, chili powder, lemon pepper, salt, and black pepper.
Bake 30 minutes until chicken is no longer pink and an instant-read thermometer reads 165°F. Sprinkle with fresh parsley before serving.

name: Turkey Stuffed Bell Peppers
description: Colorful bell peppers filled with seasoned ground turkey and rice baked until tender and topped with melted cheese.
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F. Cut peppers in half horizontally; remove seeds. Brush with 1 tbsp oil; season inside with salt and pepper; bake 20 minutes to soften.
Heat remaining oil in a large skillet over medium; brown ground turkey.
Add onion and garlic; sauté until onion is translucent.
Add uncooked rice, marinara, Italian seasoning, garlic powder, 1 tsp salt, and chicken broth; stir; cover and bring to a boil. Reduce heat; simmer 20 minutes without lifting lid. Rest 5 minutes.
Fluff and stir filling; spoon into pepper halves. Top each with mozzarella; cover loosely with foil and bake 15 minutes.
Remove foil; broil 2–3 minutes until cheese is golden. Garnish with parsley.

name: Slow Cooker White Bean Chicken Chili
description: Hearty and creamy white bean chili with tender pulled chicken and green chiles slow-cooked for deep flavor.
ingredients: 2 cans (15 oz each) white cannellini beans drained
sour cream and shredded cheese for serving
instructions: Add chicken breasts to the bottom of a slow cooker.
Add beans, green chiles, onion, garlic, broth, cumin, oregano, chili powder, and salt; stir.
Cook on low 6–8 hours or high 3–4 hours until chicken is very tender.
Remove chicken; shred with two forks.
Stir cream cheese and corn into the slow cooker; return shredded chicken. Cook 15 more minutes on high until cream cheese is fully incorporated and corn is warmed.
Add lime juice and cilantro; taste and adjust seasoning. Serve with sour cream and shredded cheese.

name: Grilled Chicken Thighs with Chimichurri
description: Juicy grilled chicken thighs finished with a bright herb-packed chimichurri sauce for a summer dinner.
instructions: Pat chicken dry and coat with olive oil; season all over with salt, pepper, paprika, and garlic powder. Let sit 15 minutes at room temperature.
Preheat grill to medium-high heat (400–450°F); clean and oil grates.
Grill chicken skin-side down 5–7 minutes until skin is crispy. Flip and grill 10–12 minutes more until internal temperature reaches 165°F. Rest 5 minutes.
Make chimichurri: pulse parsley, cilantro, garlic, red wine vinegar, red pepper flakes, and salt in a food processor; slowly drizzle in olive oil until combined but still textured.
Serve chicken thighs topped generously with chimichurri.

name: Sheet Pan Sausage and Vegetables
description: Sliced turkey sausage and a rainbow of vegetables roasted together on one pan with smoky seasonings.
ingredients: 4 links turkey or chicken sausage sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F. Line a large baking sheet with parchment paper.
Slice sausages into 1/2-inch rounds. Slice bell peppers and onion.
Spread sausage, broccoli, peppers, onion, and cherry tomatoes on the baking sheet in a single layer.
Drizzle with olive oil; sprinkle with garlic powder, Italian seasoning, paprika, salt, and pepper. Toss to coat.
Roast 20–25 minutes until vegetables are tender and slightly caramelized. Stir halfway through.
Garnish with fresh basil and serve immediately as-is or over rice or pasta.

name: Ground Turkey and Zucchini Skillet
description: A fast and satisfying skillet meal of seasoned ground turkey with zucchini and tomatoes over rice.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add onion; sauté 3 minutes until softened.
Add garlic; cook 1 minute. Add ground turkey; cook 5–7 minutes, breaking up with spoon, until no longer pink.
Add Italian seasoning, cumin, paprika, salt, and pepper; stir.
Add diced tomatoes (with juices) and zucchini; stir to combine.
Reduce heat to medium; simmer 8–10 minutes until zucchini is tender and flavors meld.
Taste and adjust seasoning. Serve over brown rice and top with fresh basil.

name: Slow Cooker Chicken and Sweet Potato Stew
description: Warming stew of tender chicken thighs and sweet potatoes in a lightly spiced tomato broth.
ingredients: 2 large sweet potatoes peeled and cubed
instructions: Place chicken thighs in the bottom of a slow cooker.
Add sweet potatoes, onion, garlic, diced tomatoes, and chicken broth.
Sprinkle cumin, paprika, cinnamon, salt, and pepper over the top; stir gently.
Cook on low 6 hours or high 3 hours until chicken is cooked through and sweet potatoes are tender.
Shred chicken using two forks; return to pot. Add chickpeas and stir.
Cook on high 15 more minutes to warm chickpeas. Serve in bowls garnished with fresh cilantro.

name: Baked Lemon Herb Chicken Thighs
description: Aromatic lemon and herb marinated chicken thighs baked until golden with a beautiful pan sauce.
instructions: Combine olive oil, lemon juice, lemon zest, garlic, rosemary, thyme, oregano, salt, and pepper in a bowl. Add chicken; toss to coat. Marinate 15 minutes minimum.
Preheat oven to 425°F.
Heat an oven-proof skillet over medium-high. Sear chicken thighs skin-side down 3–4 minutes until golden; flip and sear 2 more minutes.
Add chicken broth to skillet. Transfer to oven; bake 20–25 minutes until internal temperature reaches 165°F.
Remove chicken; set skillet over medium heat. Whisk butter into pan juices until glossy.
Serve chicken with pan sauce drizzled over top and lemon slices alongside.

name: Turkey and Quinoa Stuffed Portobello Mushrooms
description: Hearty portobello caps filled with seasoned ground turkey and quinoa then baked with Parmesan.
ingredients: 4 large portobello mushroom caps stems removed
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F. Place mushroom caps gill-side up on a baking sheet; brush with olive oil; season with salt and pepper. Pre-bake 10 minutes.
Cook quinoa per package directions if not already prepared.
Heat olive oil in a skillet; sauté onion 3 minutes; add garlic and cook 1 minute.
Add ground turkey; cook 6–8 minutes until cooked through; break into crumbles. Season with Italian seasoning, paprika, salt, and pepper.
Stir in drained tomatoes and cooked quinoa. Remove from heat.
Spoon turkey-quinoa filling into mushroom caps; top with Parmesan. Bake 15 minutes until cheese melts. Garnish with parsley.

name: Chicken Fajita Sheet Pan Bake
description: Colorful sheet pan chicken fajitas with smoky sliced chicken and charred peppers ready in under 30 minutes.
ingredients: 1.5 lbs boneless skinless chicken breasts sliced into strips
salsa avocado and sour cream for serving
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F. Line a large baking sheet with parchment.
Mix chili powder, cumin, paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and pepper; toss with chicken strips, peppers, and onion in a bowl. Drizzle with olive oil; toss again.
Spread evenly in a single layer on the baking sheet; do not crowd.
Bake 20–22 minutes until chicken is cooked through and vegetables are slightly charred at the edges.
Squeeze lime juice over everything.
Serve in warm tortillas topped with salsa, sliced avocado, and sour cream.

name: Chicken and Vegetable Soup
description: Nourishing homemade chicken soup loaded with vegetables and herbs for a comforting weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat. Sauté onion, carrots, and celery 5 minutes until softened.
Add garlic; cook 1 minute.
Add chicken breasts, broth, potatoes, thyme, parsley, bay leaf, salt, and pepper. Bring to a boil.
Reduce heat; simmer 20 minutes until chicken is cooked through and potatoes are tender.
Remove chicken and shred with two forks; return to pot. Add frozen peas.
Cook 5 more minutes until peas are heated through. Remove bay leaf; taste and adjust seasoning. Serve hot.

name: Pork and Vegetable Fried Rice
description: Lean pork tenderloin with colorful vegetables tossed in a light soy-sesame sauce for a quick healthy fried rice.
ingredients: 1 lb pork tenderloin cut into small pieces
3 cups cooked and cooled brown rice
instructions: Season pork pieces with salt and pepper. Heat 1 tbsp oil in large wok or skillet over high heat; cook pork 4–5 minutes until cooked through; remove to plate.
Add 1 tbsp oil; scramble beaten eggs until just set; push to side.
Add remaining oil; stir-fry garlic, peas and carrots, and bell pepper 2–3 minutes.
Add cold rice; stir-fry 3–4 minutes, pressing against pan to allow crisping.
Return pork to wok with vegetables and rice. Add soy sauce, oyster sauce, sesame oil, and ginger; toss everything together.
Cook 2 more minutes; taste and adjust seasoning. Top with green onions and serve.

name: Baked Turkey Breast with Roasted Root Vegetables
description: Herb-seasoned turkey breast roasted alongside colorful root vegetables for an easy celebratory dinner.
ingredients: 3 medium carrots peeled and cut into chunks
2 parsnips peeled and cut into chunks
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F. Combine 2 tbsp olive oil, rosemary, thyme, garlic, salt, and pepper; rub all over turkey breast.
Toss carrots, parsnips, beets, and onion with remaining 1 tbsp olive oil; season with salt and pepper.
Spread vegetables in a large roasting pan; pour in chicken broth.
Set turkey breast on top of vegetables.
Roast 75–90 minutes until turkey reaches 165°F internal temperature, basting with pan juices every 30 minutes.
Let turkey rest 10 minutes before slicing. Serve with roasted vegetables and pan juices.

name: Cauliflower Chicken Casserole
description: Creamy and comforting chicken casserole with roasted cauliflower and a lightened-up cheese sauce.
ingredients: 1.5 lbs boneless skinless chicken breasts cubed
1 large head cauliflower cut into florets
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F. Toss cauliflower with 1 tbsp olive oil; season with salt and pepper; roast on a baking sheet 15–20 minutes until golden.
Meanwhile heat remaining oil in oven-proof skillet; cook chicken pieces 5–6 minutes until browned. Season with garlic powder, paprika, thyme, salt, and pepper.
Add garlic; cook 1 minute. Pour in broth; bring to simmer.
Stir in Greek yogurt until smooth. Add roasted cauliflower; toss to combine.
Sprinkle cheddar and mozzarella on top.
Bake uncovered 15–20 minutes until cheese is bubbly and golden. Garnish with chives and serve.

name: Ginger Sesame Ground Turkey Bowls
description: Savory ground turkey seasoned with ginger and sesame served over brown rice with crisp cucumber.
instructions: Whisk soy sauce, hoisin, rice vinegar, sesame oil, ginger, garlic, cornstarch, and water in a small bowl; set sauce aside.
Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add ground turkey; cook 6–8 minutes breaking into crumbles until no longer pink.
Pour sauce over turkey; stir well and cook 2–3 minutes until sauce thickens and glazes the meat.
Prepare rice and toppings.
Build bowls with a base of brown rice.
Top with glazed turkey, cucumber, shredded carrots, green onions, and sesame seeds. Drizzle with sriracha if desired.

name: Quinoa Chickpea Salad
description: Bright lemony quinoa salad with chickpeas, cucumber, bell pepper, and fresh parsley tossed in a zesty dressing.
ingredients: 1 can 15 oz chickpeas rinsed and drained
freshly ground black pepper to taste
instructions: Combine rinsed quinoa and water in a saucepan and bring to a boil over medium-high heat.
Reduce heat to a gentle simmer and cook uncovered until quinoa absorbs all water about 15 minutes.
Remove from heat cover and let rest 5 minutes then fluff with a fork and cool.
In a large bowl combine chickpeas cucumber bell pepper onion and parsley.
In a small bowl whisk together olive oil lemon juice vinegar garlic and salt.
Once quinoa is mostly cool add to the bowl and drizzle dressing over top.
Toss thoroughly season with black pepper and rest 5-10 minutes before serving.

name: Greek Chicken Wraps
description: Juicy marinated grilled chicken thighs tucked into flatbreads with hummus, cucumber, tomato, and a creamy dill yogurt sauce.
instructions: Combine olive oil lemon juice garlic oregano salt and pepper in a zip bag and add chicken thighs to marinate at least 30 minutes.
Stir together Greek yogurt dried dill a squeeze of lemon juice and a pinch of salt to make the sauce and set aside.
Soak sliced red onion in ice water 5-10 minutes then drain to mellow the flavor.
Cook marinated chicken in a skillet over medium heat 5-7 minutes per side until browned and cooked through.
Rest chicken 5 minutes then slice.
Smear each flatbread with hummus then pile on sliced chicken tomatoes cucumber and onion.
Add dollops of dill yogurt sauce wrap tightly and serve.

name: Crunchy Thai Peanut Quinoa Salad
description: Shredded purple cabbage, carrots, and snap peas tossed with quinoa in a vibrant sesame peanut dressing.
instructions: Rinse quinoa and combine with water in a pot over medium heat. Bring to a gentle boil then simmer 10-15 minutes until water is absorbed.
Cover and let rest 5 minutes then fluff and set aside to cool.
Whisk together peanut butter and soy sauce until smooth adding a splash of water if too thick.
Whisk in maple syrup sesame oil lime juice and red pepper flakes.
In a large bowl combine cooled quinoa cabbage carrot snow peas cilantro and green onion.
Pour peanut sauce over salad and toss until everything is coated.
Taste and adjust seasoning then divide into bowls and garnish with chopped peanuts.

name: Chicken Lettuce Wraps
description: Savory ground chicken stir-fried with hoisin sauce, water chestnuts, and bell pepper served in crisp iceberg lettuce cups.
ingredients: 1 can 8 oz water chestnuts drained and diced
instructions: In a small bowl stir together hoisin sauce soy sauce rice vinegar sesame oil ginger and garlic to make the sauce.
Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat and add ground chicken breaking it up as it cooks until browned.
Add diced bell pepper and water chestnuts to the skillet and saute 2 minutes.
Pour sauce into skillet and stir well cooking another 2 minutes.
Remove from heat and top with sliced green onions and chopped peanuts.
Spoon about 1/3 cup chicken filling into each lettuce cup and serve immediately.

name: Everyday Lentil Soup
description: Hearty one-pot lentil soup with carrots, celery, kale, and fresh herbs ready in about 35 minutes.
ingredients: 1 cup green or brown lentils rinsed
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat and add garlic shallots carrots and celery.
Season with salt and pepper and saute 4-5 minutes until slightly tender.
Add potatoes stir and cook 2 minutes more.
Pour in vegetable broth and add rosemary or thyme then increase heat to medium-high and bring to a rolling simmer.
Add lentils stir and once simmering again reduce heat to low. Simmer uncovered 15-20 minutes until lentils and potatoes are tender.
Stir in chopped kale cover and cook 3-4 minutes to wilt.
Taste and adjust seasoning then serve garnished with fresh parsley.

name: Herbed Quinoa Chickpea Salad
description: Fluffy quinoa with chickpeas, spinach, fresh herbs, and feta tossed in a creamy lemon-tahini dressing.
ingredients: 1 can 15 oz chickpeas rinsed and drained
instructions: Cook quinoa in water by bringing to a boil then simmering 15 minutes until water is absorbed. Remove from heat cover and rest 5 minutes then fluff.
Toast pepitas in a dry skillet over medium heat stirring frequently about 5 minutes until fragrant.
Whisk together olive oil lemon juice tahini garlic salt and pepper to make the dressing.
Combine cooked quinoa chickpeas spinach parsley cilantro green onion feta and pepitas in a large bowl.
Drizzle all the dressing over the salad and toss to combine.
Serve immediately or refrigerate up to 3 days.

name: Golden Curry Lentil Soup
description: Fragrant one-pot red lentil soup simmered with carrots, ginger, coconut milk, and warm curry spices.
ingredients: 1 small serrano pepper seeded and minced
fresh cilantro and lime for serving
instructions: Heat a large pot over medium heat and add water and shallot. Saute 3 minutes stirring frequently until softened.
Add garlic ginger and serrano and saute 2-3 minutes more.
Add carrots and a pinch of salt and stir cooking 1-2 minutes.
Pour in vegetable broth and coconut milk and increase heat to medium-high to bring to a low boil.
Add lentils coconut aminos and curry powder and stir. Reduce heat to a gentle simmer and cook uncovered 12-16 minutes until carrots and lentils are tender.
Taste and adjust seasoning then divide into bowls and garnish with cilantro and lime juice.

name: Sushi Bowl with Sriracha Mayo
description: Seasoned sushi rice topped with imitation crab, avocado, cucumber, carrots, nori, and a drizzle of sriracha mayo.
instructions: Rinse rice and combine with 2 cups water in a pot. Bring to boil then reduce to low and simmer covered 15 minutes. Turn off heat and rest covered 10 minutes then fluff.
Stir together rice vinegar sugar and salt until dissolved and fold into cooked rice.
Whisk together mayonnaise and sriracha to make spicy mayo.
Prepare toppings: shred crab julienne carrot slice cucumber and avocado.
Divide seasoned rice among four bowls.
Top each bowl with crab carrot cucumber avocado nori pieces and sesame seeds.
Drizzle with sriracha mayo and serve.

name: Shawarma Sheet Pan Chicken Bowl
description: Spiced chicken thighs roasted on a sheet pan with chickpeas and vegetables served over grains with tzatziki or tahini.
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs boneless skinless chicken thighs cut into 1-inch pieces
1 small red onion cut into pieces
1 red bell pepper cut into pieces
1 can 15 oz chickpeas rinsed and drained
2 cups cooked farro or brown rice
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees F.
Add chicken veggies and chickpeas to a large mixing bowl and drizzle with olive oil.
Season with all spices and salt and toss to evenly combine.
Transfer mixture onto a rimmed baking sheet in an even layer.
Roast 30-35 minutes until chicken is cooked through and vegetables are tender.
Broil the last 2 minutes for extra char if desired.
Serve over farro or brown rice with tzatziki or tahini sauce on the side.

name: Turkey Taco Lettuce Wraps
description: Lean ground turkey seasoned with Mexican spices and served in crisp iceberg lettuce cups for a low-carb protein-packed lunch.
ingredients: optional toppings shredded cheese salsa avocado
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium heat and add ground turkey onion and bell pepper. Cook breaking up meat until browned about 5-7 minutes.
Drain excess fat if needed.
Add garlic powder cumin salt chili powder paprika and oregano and stir to coat.
Pour in water and tomato sauce and stir to combine.
Simmer uncovered 5 minutes until sauce reduces and thickens.
Spoon filling into lettuce leaves and serve with optional toppings like cheese salsa or avocado.

name: Roasted Sweet Potato Buddha Bowl
description: Nourishing bowl of roasted sweet potato, chickpeas, greens, quinoa, avocado, and tahini dressing for a filling plant-based meal.
ingredients: 1 can 15 oz chickpeas rinsed and drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees F. Toss sweet potatoes with 1 tbsp olive oil paprika cumin salt and pepper and spread on one half of a baking sheet.
Toss chickpeas with remaining oil salt and pepper and spread on the other half.
Roast 25-30 minutes tossing halfway until sweet potatoes are tender and chickpeas are crispy.
Whisk tahini lemon juice garlic and water together until smooth and pourable.
Divide quinoa among four bowls and top with greens.
Add roasted sweet potato chickpeas avocado and red cabbage to each bowl.
Drizzle generously with tahini dressing and serve.

name: Honey Lime Chili Chicken Bowl
description: Sheet-pan chili-lime chicken with roasted peppers and onions served over rice with avocado and a honey-lime vinaigrette.
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs boneless chicken breasts or thighs
salt and chili flakes to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees F.
On a baking sheet toss chicken with olive oil honey garlic chili powder cumin salt and chili flakes.
Add bell peppers and onion with a drizzle of olive oil and a pinch of salt and arrange everything evenly on the pan.
Bake 20-25 minutes until chicken is cooked and peppers begin to char.
Whisk together salsa verde lime juice and a drizzle of olive oil and honey for the vinaigrette.
Slice the chicken thinly.
Serve chicken and peppers over rice topped with avocado tomatoes cilantro and drizzle of vinaigrette.

name: Banh Mi Rice Bowl
description: Savory ground chicken over coconut jasmine rice with a fresh herb cucumber salad and spicy mayo for a quick satisfying bowl.
ingredients: 1 cup mixed fresh herbs cilantro and basil
3 tbsp mixed sesame seeds and peanuts
instructions: Toss cucumber herbs peanuts sesame seeds sesame oil and lime juice together in a bowl for the salad and season with salt.
Combine tamari fish sauce chili paste and maple syrup in a bowl adding 1/3 cup water.
Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and add chicken shallots and garlic. Cook breaking up meat until browned about 5 minutes.
Add sauce and cook another 5 minutes until meat is slightly crispy.
Add pickled carrots and cook 1 minute more then remove from heat.
Spoon meat over rice in bowls and top with the cucumber herb salad.
Drizzle with spicy mayo and serve immediately.

name: California Chicken Avocado Rice Bowl
description: Spice-rubbed grilled chicken with grilled peppers, zucchini, mashed avocado, cherry tomatoes, and feta over rice.
instructions: Rub chicken with garlic powder paprika cumin salt and pepper.
Grill chicken over medium-high heat 6-7 minutes per side until cooked through then rest 5 minutes and slice.
Toss sliced peppers and zucchini with olive oil salt and pepper and grill alongside the chicken until charred and tender.
Mash avocados with lemon juice parsley and a pinch of flaky salt.
Divide rice among bowls and top with sliced chicken and grilled vegetables.
Add a large dollop of mashed avocado and scatter cherry tomatoes feta and toasted walnuts over each bowl.
Serve immediately.

name: Chicken Shawarma Sweet Potato Bowl
description: Marinated shawarma-spiced chicken with oven-crisped sweet potato fries, couscous, and garlic tahini yogurt sauce.
ingredients: 2 large sweet potatoes cut into fries
instructions: Whisk olive oil with all spices salt and pepper and toss with chicken thighs to coat. Marinate at least 30 minutes.
Preheat oven to 400 degrees F. Spread chicken on one sheet pan and sweet potato fries on another drizzled with oil and salt.
Roast chicken 25-30 minutes until cooked through and sweet potatoes 30-35 minutes until crispy.
Stir together Greek yogurt tahini garlic and lemon juice for the sauce thinning with water if needed.
Cook couscous or quinoa according to package directions.
Assemble bowls with couscous greens chicken and sweet potato fries.
Add sliced avocado and drizzle generously with garlic tahini yogurt sauce.

name: Smashed Chickpea Salad Sandwich
description: Lightly smashed chickpeas with lemon, olives, red onion, and parsley piled on toasted whole grain bread with tahini dressing.
ingredients: 1 can 15 oz chickpeas drained and rinsed
zest and juice of half a lemon
instructions: Combine chickpeas olives red onion parsley lemon zest and juice salt and pepper in a bowl.
Lightly smash the mixture with the back of a fork to a coarse chunky texture not a puree.
Stir in olive oil and taste to adjust seasoning.
Whisk tahini with minced garlic lemon juice and a splash of water until spreadable.
Spread tahini on toasted bread slices.
Top with arugula then pile on the smashed chickpea mixture.
Add roasted red pepper if using close the sandwich slice and serve.

name: Mediterranean Quinoa Roasted Veg Bowl
description: Roasted eggplant, zucchini, and squash tossed with quinoa, cherry tomatoes, fresh herbs, and crumbled feta.
ingredients: 1/4 cup toasted almonds or pine nuts
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees F with racks in upper and lower thirds. Line two rimmed baking sheets with parchment.
Divide eggplant zucchini and squash between the pans drizzle each with 1 tbsp olive oil and season with salt and pepper.
Roast 25-30 minutes until softened and browning at the edges. Set aside to cool.
Cook quinoa in water simmering 15 minutes until absorbed then rest covered 5 minutes and fluff.
Toast almonds in a small dry skillet over medium heat 4-8 minutes until golden.
In a large bowl whisk lemon juice and garlic then slowly whisk in remaining olive oil.
Add quinoa tomatoes basil mint roasted vegetables and nuts and stir gently. Stir in feta season to taste and serve.

name: Spicy Tuna Guacamole Bowl
description: Seasoned canned tuna over rice with guacamole, edamame, cucumber, carrots, and sriracha for an easy poke-style lunch.
ingredients: 2 cans 5 oz chunk light tuna in water drained
instructions: Cook edamame according to package directions and let cool.
Dice cucumber and shred carrot.
Stir soy sauce sesame oil and rice vinegar into drained tuna.
Divide cooked rice among four bowls about 3/4 cup each.
Top each bowl with 1/4 cup edamame half a can of seasoned tuna 2 tbsp guacamole cucumber shredded carrot and cilantro.
Drizzle 1 tbsp sriracha over each bowl and sprinkle with sesame seeds.
Serve immediately or refrigerate components separately up to four days.

name: Tuna Salad Wrap
description: Classic tuna salad with celery, walnuts, and lemon wrapped in a whole grain tortilla with romaine and sliced tomato.
ingredients: 1 can 12 oz chunk light tuna in water drained
instructions: Drain canned tuna well and flake into a bowl.
Add celery walnuts green onion mayonnaise lemon juice pepper and salt and stir to combine.
Slice tomato thinly and tear romaine into smaller pieces.
Warm each tortilla in the microwave 5-10 seconds so it stays pliable.
Layer romaine then tomato slices then one-third of the tuna salad on each tortilla.
Roll up tightly tucking in the sides as you go and place seam-side down.
Slice each wrap in half and serve.

name: Lighter Turkey Club Sandwich
description: Lean turkey breast with crisp bacon, lettuce, and tomato on whole grain bread for a high-protein satisfying lunch.
instructions: Cook bacon in a skillet until crisp then drain on paper towels.
Toast bread slices until golden.
Spread light mayo on both pieces of toast.
Layer one slice of lettuce on the bottom bread then add turkey and tomato slices.
Season tomato with salt and pepper.
Top with bacon and the second slice of lettuce then close the sandwich.
Slice diagonally and serve immediately.

name: Roasted Mushroom Herbed Quinoa Bowl
description: Savory roasted baby bella mushrooms over herbed quinoa with Parmesan, green onions, lemon, and toasted pepitas.
ingredients: 16 oz baby bella mushrooms halved or quartered
1 tbsp olive oil plus more for drizzling
instructions: Preheat oven to 425 degrees F and line a rimmed baking sheet with parchment.
Toss mushrooms with olive oil and salt and spread on the baking sheet. Roast 15-18 minutes tossing halfway until tender and condensed.
Meanwhile combine rinsed quinoa and water in a saucepan and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer 15-20 minutes until water is absorbed.
Remove from heat cover and rest 5 minutes then fluff with a fork.
Stir in Parmesan most of the parsley green onions garlic salt and olive oil.
Add lemon juice and black pepper to taste.
Pour quinoa into bowls and top with roasted mushrooms their juices pepitas and remaining parsley.

name: Vegan Nicoise Salad
description: A plant-based twist on the French classic with chickpeas, green beans, tender potatoes, olives, and a bright mustard dressing.
ingredients: 1 can 15 oz chickpeas rinsed and drained
4 cups butter lettuce or mixed greens
instructions: Boil potatoes in salted water 10-12 minutes until tender then drain and slice.
Blanch green beans in boiling water 2-4 minutes until bright green then plunge into ice water and drain.
Stir together chickpeas with a pinch of salt mustard maple syrup dill and sunflower seeds.
Whisk olive oil vinegar salt and pepper together to make the dressing.
Divide lettuce between two plates and top with chickpeas green beans potatoes and olives.
Add cherry tomatoes then drizzle with dressing and serve.

name: Sesame Chicken Rice Bowl
description: Crispy golden sesame-glazed chicken breast served over steamed rice with a sticky savory-sweet sesame sauce.
instructions: Toss cubed chicken with salt pepper ginger and arrowroot until evenly coated.
Heat 1 tbsp avocado oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and cook chicken in batches until golden brown 5-6 minutes per batch. Set aside.
Mix soy sauce sugar tomato paste rice vinegar sesame oil sesame seeds and ginger together in a bowl.
Whisk 1 tbsp cornstarch with 2 tbsp water to make a slurry.
Add remaining sesame oil to the pan with red pepper flakes and garlic and cook 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add half the sauce cook 1 minute then return chicken and pour in remaining sauce and slurry. Cook 2 more minutes.
Serve over rice garnished with sesame seeds and green onions.

name: Salmon Lentil Salad
description: Flaky seared salmon over tender green lentils with mixed greens, cucumber, and a bright lemon scallion dressing.
ingredients: fresh dill or parsley for serving
instructions: Simmer lentils in water or broth with a pinch of salt for 18-20 minutes until tender. Drain and cool slightly.
Whisk together olive oil lemon juice Dijon mustard garlic salt and pepper to make the dressing.
Season salmon fillets with salt and pepper.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat with a drizzle of oil and cook salmon skin-side down 4-5 minutes then flip and cook another 2-3 minutes until just cooked through.
Toss warm lentils with half the dressing scallions and cucumber.
Spread greens on two plates and top with dressed lentils.
Flake salmon over the top drizzle with remaining dressing and garnish with fresh dill or parsley.

name: Mason Jar Greek Salad
description: Layered mason jar salad with lemon-oregano dressing, chickpeas, cucumber, tomatoes, feta, and crisp romaine that stays fresh for days.
ingredients: 1 can 15 oz chickpeas drained and rinsed
instructions: Whisk together olive oil lemon juice red wine vinegar oregano salt and pepper to make the dressing.
Divide dressing between two large mason jars.
Layer chickpeas on top of the dressing.
Add red onion cucumber olives and cherry tomatoes.
Add crumbled feta next.
Top with chopped romaine last so it stays crisp.
Seal jars and refrigerate up to 3 days. Shake to combine before eating.

name: Teriyaki Chicken Meatball Bowl
description: Baked ground chicken meatballs glazed in glossy teriyaki sauce served over jasmine rice with steamed broccoli.
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degrees F and line a baking sheet with parchment.
Mix ground chicken egg panko garlic ginger soy sauce and green onions until combined then shape into 16 meatballs.
Bake meatballs 20 minutes until golden and cooked through.
Combine soy sauce brown sugar garlic ginger water and cornstarch in a small saucepan. Cook over medium heat stirring until sauce simmers and thickens.
Toss cooked meatballs in teriyaki sauce to coat.
Cook rice according to package and steam broccoli until tender.
Divide rice and broccoli among four bowls and top with four meatballs and extra sauce. Garnish with sesame seeds and green onion.

name: Southwest Black Bean Quinoa Bowl
description: Hearty bowl of quinoa with black beans, corn, avocado, roasted peppers, and a cumin-lime dressing for a meatless lunch.
ingredients: 1 can 15 oz black beans rinsed and drained
1 red bell pepper roasted and diced
instructions: Cook quinoa in vegetable broth by bringing to a boil then simmering 15 minutes until absorbed. Fluff and cool.
Whisk together olive oil lime juice cumin chili powder garlic powder salt and pepper for the dressing.
In a large bowl combine cooled quinoa black beans corn roasted pepper red onion and cilantro.
Pour dressing over the bowl and toss well to combine.
Gently fold in diced avocado at the end.
Taste and adjust seasoning then divide into bowls.
Serve at room temperature or chilled.

name: Shrimp and Avocado Grain Bowl
description: Sauteed garlicky shrimp over farro with arugula, avocado, cucumber, and a bright lemon herb dressing.
ingredients: 1 lb large shrimp peeled and deveined
1 1/2 cups farro cooked according to package
instructions: Cook farro according to package directions until tender about 20 minutes then drain and cool slightly.
Whisk together 3 tbsp olive oil lemon juice Dijon mustard parsley salt and pepper for the dressing.
Season shrimp with garlic paprika salt and pepper.
Heat 2 tbsp olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and cook shrimp 2-3 minutes per side until pink and curled.
Divide farro among four bowls and top with arugula.
Arrange shrimp avocado cucumber and cherry tomatoes over each bowl.
Drizzle generously with lemon herb dressing and serve.

name: White Bean and Kale Soup
description: Comforting Tuscan-style soup with cannellini beans, kale, tomatoes, and rosemary for a fiber-rich satisfying lunch.
ingredients: 2 cans 15 oz cannellini beans rinsed and drained
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat and saute onion 5 minutes until softened.
Add garlic and red pepper flakes and cook 1 minute until fragrant.
Stir in diced tomatoes with their juices and cook 3 minutes.
Add cannellini beans broth rosemary and Parmesan rind if using. Bring to a simmer.
Simmer uncovered 15 minutes to meld flavors. Discard rosemary sprig and Parmesan rind.
Stir in kale and cook 3-4 minutes until wilted.
Add lemon juice and adjust seasoning with salt and pepper. Serve with whole grain bread.

name: Edamame Brown Rice Power Bowl
description: Wholesome bowl of brown rice with edamame, shredded carrots, cucumber, avocado, nori, and a ginger sesame dressing.
instructions: Cook brown rice according to package directions about 40-45 minutes then fluff and cool slightly.
Cook edamame per package instructions and drain.
Whisk together soy sauce rice vinegar sesame oil ginger honey and garlic to make the dressing.
Divide brown rice among four bowls.
Top each bowl with edamame shredded carrot cucumber and avocado.
Scatter nori pieces and sesame seeds over each bowl.
Drizzle with ginger sesame dressing and serve.

name: Keto Breakfast Casserole
description: Hearty baked egg casserole with sausage, cheddar, and broccoli for an easy make-ahead keto breakfast.
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F and grease a 9x13-inch casserole dish.
In a skillet over medium-high heat, cook minced garlic for 1 minute, then add sausage and cook until browned, breaking it apart with a spatula.
Blanch broccoli in boiling water for 5 minutes until crisp-tender, then drain and pat dry.
In a large bowl, whisk together eggs, heavy cream, half the cheddar, parsley, salt, and pepper.
Spread sausage and broccoli evenly in the casserole dish, then pour egg mixture over the top.
Sprinkle remaining cheddar on top and bake for 30 minutes until eggs are set and cheese is golden.

name: Almond Flour Pancakes
description: Fluffy low-carb pancakes made with almond flour that are naturally gluten-free and ready in minutes.
ingredients: butter or coconut oil for cooking
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together almond flour, erythritol, baking powder, and salt.
In a separate bowl, whisk eggs, almond milk, vanilla, and melted butter.
Add wet ingredients to dry and stir until a smooth batter forms.
Heat a lightly oiled skillet over medium heat and pour 1/4 cup batter per pancake.
Cook for 2–3 minutes until bubbles form at the edges and the surface looks mostly set, then flip.
Cook 1–2 minutes more until golden brown. Serve with sugar-free syrup and butter.

name: Basic Chaffle
description: Crispy cheese and egg waffles made in a mini waffle iron — zero flour and under 1g net carbs each.
instructions: Preheat a mini waffle maker for 5 minutes until hot.
In a small bowl, whisk together the egg, mozzarella, almond flour, baking powder, and salt until combined.
Pour half the batter into the center of the waffle maker and close the lid.
Cook for 3–4 minutes until steam stops and the chaffle is golden and crispy.
Carefully remove and allow to cool on a rack for 1–2 minutes to crisp up further.
Repeat with remaining batter. Serve with butter, sugar-free syrup, or savory toppings.

name: Fathead Pizza
description: Classic keto pizza with a chewy mozzarella and almond flour fathead dough topped with marinara and pepperoni.
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Combine 1 1/2 cups mozzarella and cream cheese in a microwave-safe bowl; microwave 90 seconds, stirring halfway, until melted.
Stir in the egg and almond flour until a dough forms, then add garlic powder, oregano, salt, and pepper.
Turn dough onto the parchment-lined pan and press or roll into a 10-inch round.
Poke dough all over with a fork and bake for 8–10 minutes until golden and set.
Spread pizza sauce over the crust, top with mozzarella and pepperoni, and bake 5–8 more minutes until cheese is bubbly.

name: Keto Bread Loaf
description: A light and airy almond flour bread with only 1g net carb per slice that toasts beautifully.
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F and line an 8x4-inch loaf pan with parchment paper.
Beat egg whites with cream of tartar using a hand mixer until soft peaks form; set aside.
In a food processor, combine egg yolks, almond flour, baking powder, salt, melted butter, and stevia; mix until a thick dough forms.
Add one-third of the egg whites to the food processor and pulse to combine, then pour batter into a large bowl.
Gently fold in remaining egg whites in two additions, being careful not to deflate them.
Pour batter into prepared loaf pan and bake for 30 minutes until golden and a toothpick comes out clean. Allow to cool completely before slicing.

name: Lettuce-Wrapped Beef Tacos
description: Juicy seasoned ground beef served in crisp butter lettuce cups with all the classic taco toppings.
instructions: In a large skillet over medium-high heat, cook ground beef, breaking it apart, until browned and no longer pink, about 8 minutes.
Drain excess fat, then add garlic, taco seasoning, and salsa; stir to combine and simmer for 3 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Lay lettuce leaves on a serving platter to serve as taco shells.
Spoon seasoned beef into each lettuce cup.
Top with shredded cheddar, avocado, sour cream, and cilantro; serve with lime wedges.

name: Chicken Cauliflower Rice Burrito Bowl
description: Shredded salsa chicken over seasoned cauliflower rice with avocado, sour cream, and cheese.
instructions: Place chicken breasts in a skillet, pour salsa over them, season with salt, and cook covered over medium heat for 18–20 minutes until cooked through.
Shred chicken with two forks and return to the pan; simmer for 5 minutes to absorb flavors.
Rice the cauliflower using a food processor or grater.
In a separate skillet, melt butter over medium-high heat and sauté cauliflower rice with taco seasoning for 5–7 minutes until tender; season with salt.
Divide cauliflower rice into bowls and top with shredded chicken.
Add diced avocado, shredded cheese, sour cream, and cilantro; serve immediately.

name: Zoodle Carbonara
description: Creamy bacon and egg carbonara sauce tossed with zucchini noodles for a classic pasta experience without the carbs.
instructions: Spiralize zucchini into noodles; pat dry with paper towels and set aside.
Fry bacon in a large skillet over medium heat until crispy; set aside the pan with drippings to cool slightly.
In a saucepan, bring heavy cream to a boil then reduce heat and simmer until reduced by one quarter; remove from heat and let cool slightly.
In a bowl, combine egg yolks, cooked bacon with fat, and Parmesan; stir into the warm cream, stirring constantly to prevent curdling.
Return saucepan to medium-low heat and add zoodles; toss for 1–2 minutes until warmed through and coated.
Season with salt and pepper, divide into bowls, and top with extra Parmesan and parsley.

name: Avocado Alfredo Zoodles with Chicken
description: Creamy avocado Alfredo sauce over zucchini noodles topped with pan-seared seasoned chicken thighs.
ingredients: salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Season chicken thighs with thyme, garlic powder, salt, and pepper.
Heat 2 tbsp olive oil in a skillet over medium heat and cook chicken for 6 minutes per side until cooked through; set aside to rest.
Blend avocados, heavy cream, Parmesan, garlic, parsley, and lemon juice until smooth using an immersion blender or food processor.
Transfer sauce to a saucepan and bring to a simmer over medium heat; season with salt and pepper.
Toss zoodles in the sauce until fully coated and warmed through, about 2 minutes.
Slice chicken and serve over the zoodle Alfredo; garnish with extra Parmesan and parsley.

name: Keto Butter Burgers
description: Juicy beef and jalapeño patties wrapped in lettuce with avocado, cheese, and a pat of butter on top.
ingredients: 8 large romaine or butter lettuce leaves
mustard and sugar-free ketchup for serving
instructions: Preheat a grill or cast iron skillet over medium-high heat.
In a bowl, combine ground beef, jalapeño, onion, salt, and pepper; mix with hands and form into 4 patties.
Grill or pan-fry patties for 5–7 minutes per side to desired doneness; add cheese in the last minute of cooking.
Let burgers rest for 5 minutes while you prep the lettuce wraps.
Lay 2 lettuce leaves on each plate to form a wrap.
Place each patty on the lettuce, top with a pat of butter, avocado, tomato slices, and condiments; wrap the lettuce around and serve.

name: Chicken Bacon Ranch Casserole
description: Creamy ranch-seasoned chicken and crispy bacon baked with two cheeses and broccoli for a satisfying keto dinner.
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F.
Steam broccoli for 5 minutes until crisp-tender; drain and pat dry.
In a large bowl, combine shredded chicken, crumbled bacon, broccoli, garlic, ranch dressing, and half of each cheese; season with salt and pepper.
Transfer mixture to a greased 9x13-inch baking dish.
Top with remaining mozzarella and cheddar cheeses.
Bake for 15 minutes until hot and bubbly and cheese is melted; garnish with chives and serve.

name: Cheesy Chicken Zucchini Casserole
description: Seared chicken with sautéed zucchini and mushrooms in a rich cream cheese sauce baked until golden.
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs chicken breast cut into pieces
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F. Pat chicken dry and season with salt and pepper.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a skillet over medium-high; sear chicken pieces until cooked through, then transfer to a large bowl.
Add remaining oil; sauté mushrooms and onion for 8 minutes until soft; add zucchini and cook 8–10 more minutes until tender. Transfer to the bowl with chicken.
Add cream and broth to the skillet; scrape up browned bits and simmer 5 minutes until slightly thickened; stir in 3 oz cheese.
Remove from heat; stir in sour cream. Pour sauce over chicken and vegetables; mix to combine. Transfer to a baking dish.
Sprinkle remaining cheese on top; bake 10 minutes until melted, then broil 2 minutes until golden.

name: Keto Egg Muffin Cups
description: Portable baked egg cups loaded with veggies, bacon, and cheddar — perfect for meal-prep breakfasts.
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F and line a 12-cup muffin tin with parchment liners.
Toss broccoli, cauliflower, red pepper, and garlic with olive oil; spread on a baking sheet and roast for 15 minutes until edges are browned.
Distribute roasted vegetables and crumbled bacon evenly among the muffin cups.
In a bowl, whisk together eggs, heavy cream, salt, pepper, and cheddar cheese.
Pour egg mixture over the vegetables in each muffin cup, filling about three-quarters full.
Bake for 15–20 minutes until eggs are set. Cool 5 minutes before removing; refrigerate up to 5 days.

name: Steak and Eggs
description: A hearty classic keto breakfast of pan-seared ribeye steak served alongside crispy-edged fried eggs.
instructions: Pat steaks dry with paper towels; season both sides generously with salt and pepper.
Heat 1 tbsp avocado oil in a cast iron skillet over medium-high heat until shimmering.
Cook steaks, flipping every 60–90 seconds, for about 6 minutes total for medium-rare; transfer to a cutting board and rest 5 minutes.
Heat remaining oil in a medium nonstick skillet over low heat.
Crack 2 eggs per serving into the pan; season with salt and pepper; cover and cook on low until whites are set but yolks are still runny, about 4 minutes.
Slice steaks against the grain and serve alongside fried eggs; garnish with parsley.

name: Keto Salmon with Honey Garlic Glaze
description: Broiled salmon fillets with a sweet-savory keto honey and coconut aminos glaze ready in 25 minutes.
ingredients: sea salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Preheat oven broiler to 500°F with rack 6 inches from heat.
Pat salmon fillets dry; season both sides with salt and pepper.
In a large bowl, whisk together keto honey, coconut aminos, olive oil, paprika, garlic powder, and ginger.
Add salmon to bowl and turn to coat; marinate for at least 10 minutes.
Place salmon in a baking dish, brush any remaining glaze over top.
Broil for 10–12 minutes until salmon flakes easily with a fork; garnish with green onions and serve.

name: Parmesan Crusted Salmon
description: Flaky baked salmon enveloped in a golden, herby Parmesan crust and ready in under 30 minutes.
ingredients: sea salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Place salmon on prepared sheet; pat dry and drizzle with olive oil and lemon juice; season both sides with salt and pepper.
In a small bowl, mix Parmesan, parsley, dill, and garlic powder; stir in melted butter until crumbly.
Crumble Parmesan mixture evenly over salmon and press lightly to adhere.
Bake for 15–17 minutes until fish flakes easily with a fork and the topping is golden brown.
Optional: broil for 1–2 minutes for a crispier crust; serve immediately.

name: Creamy Tuscan Salmon
description: Pan-seared salmon fillets in a rich Parmesan cream sauce with sun-dried tomatoes and wilted spinach.
instructions: Pat salmon dry; season both sides with salt and pepper.
Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high; sear salmon skin-side down for 5–6 minutes; flip and cook 1–2 minutes to medium; transfer to a plate.
Wipe out pan; sauté garlic and sun-dried tomatoes over medium heat for 1–2 minutes until fragrant.
Add broth and cream; bring to a boil then simmer 5 minutes until slightly thickened.
Stir in spinach over low heat until just wilted; stir in Parmesan until sauce is smooth and creamy.
Return salmon to pan; spoon sauce over fillets; heat through and garnish with parsley before serving.

name: Keto Blueberry Muffins
description: Ultra-moist almond flour blueberry muffins with only 3g net carbs each and a fluffy bakery-style texture.
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F and line a 12-cup muffin pan with parchment liners.
In a large bowl, whisk together almond flour, erythritol, baking powder, and salt to combine.
Stir in melted butter, almond milk, eggs, and vanilla extract until a thick batter forms.
Gently fold in blueberries, being careful not to smash them.
Divide batter evenly among the 12 muffin cups and bake for 20–25 minutes until tops are golden and a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean.
Cool in pan for 10 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack; store in the refrigerator for up to 1 week.

name: Chocolate Keto Fat Bombs
description: Rich chocolate macadamia nut fat bombs that taste like decadent truffles with only 1g net carb each.
instructions: Line a 24-cup mini muffin pan with parchment liners.
Pulse macadamia nuts in a food processor, starting and stopping, until broken down into small pieces.
Add MCT oil, melted coconut oil, and vanilla; continue to process until a nut butter forms.
Add cocoa powder and sweetener 2 tablespoons at a time, pureeing after each addition until smooth.
Spoon batter into mini muffin liners, filling to the top; sprinkle crushed macadamia nuts on top.
Freeze for at least 30 minutes until solid; store in the refrigerator for up to 2 weeks.

name: No-Bake Keto Cheesecake
description: Creamy no-bake cheesecake with an almond flour crust and a cloud-like cream cheese filling that sets in the fridge.
instructions: In a bowl, combine almond flour, 3 tbsp erythritol, and salt; stir in melted butter and 1 tsp vanilla until crumbly but cohesive.
Press crust into the bottom of a parchment-lined 9-inch springform pan; refrigerate while making the filling.
Beat cream cheese and 1 cup powdered erythritol with a hand mixer until smooth; beat in sour cream, lemon juice, and vanilla.
In a separate bowl, whip heavy cream to stiff peaks; gently fold into the cream cheese mixture.
Pour filling over the crust and smooth the top; cover and refrigerate at least 4 hours or overnight.
Melt sugar-free chocolate and drizzle over the set cheesecake before slicing and serving.

name: Keto Chocolate Mousse
description: Silky rich chocolate mousse made with mascarpone and whipped cream — just 4 ingredients and no baking required.
instructions: Add heavy whipping cream to a medium bowl and beat with a hand mixer to soft peaks; set aside.
Microwave mascarpone for 20 seconds to soften; beat with a hand mixer until smooth.
Sift cocoa powder over the mascarpone; add liquid stevia and vanilla; beat until fully combined and smooth.
Gently fold the whipped cream into the mascarpone mixture until uniform and fluffy.
Divide mousse into 4 serving glasses or bowls.
Refrigerate for 1–2 hours until chilled and set; serve with optional sugar-free whipped cream on top.

name: Keto Avocado Chocolate Pudding
description: A five-ingredient blended avocado chocolate pudding that delivers rich flavor in under five minutes.
ingredients: 1 medium ripe avocado pitted and peeled
instructions: Remove the pit from the avocado and scoop the flesh into a mixing bowl.
Add cocoa powder, liquid stevia, vanilla extract, and salt.
Mash with a fork until a smooth pudding texture forms; for an extra-smooth result, use a hand mixer or small blender.
Taste and adjust sweetness by adding more stevia if desired.
Transfer to two small serving bowls.
Serve immediately or refrigerate up to 2 hours; top with crushed nuts or sugar-free whipped cream if desired.

name: Keto Cheesecake Bites
description: Mini baked cheesecake cups with a raspberry swirl and cream cheese frosting — just 2g net carbs each.
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F and line a 24-cup mini muffin pan with parchment liners.
In a small saucepan, combine raspberries, 1 tbsp erythritol, and water; heat over low until berries soften, smash, and sauce thickens; set aside to cool.
Beat cream cheese and 1/2 cup erythritol with a hand mixer at low-medium speed until fluffy.
Beat in egg, then lemon juice and vanilla at low speed to avoid air bubbles.
Spoon filling into liners; add 1/2 tsp raspberry sauce to each and swirl with a toothpick.
Bake 10–15 minutes until puffed but still jiggly; cool at room temperature then refrigerate at least 1 hour until firm; top with whipped cream and a fresh raspberry.

name: Keto Bacon and Cheese Omelette
description: A classic fluffy three-egg omelette filled with crispy bacon and sharp cheddar for a satisfying low-carb breakfast.
ingredients: sea salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Crack eggs into a bowl, add heavy cream, salt, and pepper; whisk until smooth and slightly frothy.
Heat butter in an 8-inch nonstick skillet over medium-low heat until foamy.
Pour in egg mixture and cook, gently pushing cooked edges toward the center while tilting the pan, for 3–4 minutes until eggs are mostly set but slightly wet on top.
Sprinkle crumbled bacon and cheddar over one half of the omelette.
Fold the omelette in half over the filling and cook 1 more minute until cheese melts.
Slide onto a plate, garnish with chives, and serve immediately.

name: Keto Avocado Bacon Chicken Bunless Burger
description: Juicy chicken patties wrapped in lettuce with crispy bacon, avocado, and caramelized onion rings.
instructions: In a bowl, combine ground chicken, scallions, garlic, egg, salt, and pepper; mix until combined.
Divide into 4 portions and shape into patties.
In a skillet over medium heat, fry bacon and onion rings until bacon is crispy and onions are softened; remove and set aside.
In the same skillet with bacon drippings, fry chicken patties over medium-high heat for 4–5 minutes per side until golden and cooked to 165°F.
Lay two lettuce leaves on each plate as the bun base.
Stack each lettuce wrap with a chicken patty, bacon, avocado slices, and caramelized onion rings; fold and serve.

name: Cauliflower Fried Rice
description: Savory cauliflower rice stir-fried with eggs, bacon, sesame oil, and low-sodium soy sauce for a grain-free takeout fix.
ingredients: 1 cup frozen peas and carrots thawed
instructions: Rice cauliflower using a food processor or grater; set aside.
Cook diced bacon in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat until crispy; remove and set aside, leaving 1 tbsp drippings in the pan.
Add garlic and ginger to the pan; stir-fry 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add cauliflower rice; stir-fry for 5–6 minutes until tender and slightly golden.
Push rice to the side; scramble beaten eggs in the clear space until set, then mix into the rice.
Stir in bacon, peas and carrots, coconut aminos, and sesame oil; season with salt and pepper; top with green onions.

name: Low-Carb Curry Chicken with Cauliflower Rice
description: Coconut cream curry chicken with tender vegetables served over golden buttered cauliflower rice.
ingredients: 1 can 14 oz coconut cream solid part only
instructions: Melt butter in a large pan over medium heat; sauté onion, ginger, and chili for 5 minutes until fragrant.
Add curry paste and chicken; fry for 8–10 minutes until chicken is lightly browned.
Add broccoli and green beans; pour in solid coconut cream; season with salt and pepper.
Simmer covered for 15 minutes until chicken is cooked through.
Meanwhile, grate cauliflower and sauté in a skillet with 1 tbsp butter over medium heat for 5–8 minutes; add turmeric and salt.
Serve curry over cauliflower rice.

name: Keto Pesto Chicken Zoodle Salad
description: Shredded poached chicken thighs tossed with pesto zoodles, cherry tomatoes, and creamy feta cheese.
instructions: Place chicken thighs in a pot, cover with cold water, and bring to a boil; reduce heat and simmer for 15 minutes until cooked through.
Remove chicken and shred using two forks; set aside.
Spiralize zucchini and place zoodles in a large mixing bowl.
Pour pesto over zoodles and toss with tongs until fully coated.
Add shredded chicken, cherry tomatoes, and feta to the zoodles; gently toss until evenly combined.
Drizzle with olive oil, season with salt and pepper, and serve at room temperature or chilled.

name: Keto Chimichurri Chicken with Zoodles
description: Herby chimichurri-sauced pan-seared chicken breasts served over tender spiralized zucchini noodles.
ingredients: salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Slice chicken breasts horizontally into thin cutlets; season both sides with salt and pepper.
Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high; cook chicken 4 minutes per side until golden and cooked through; set aside.

In a tall beaker, combine lemon juice, lemon zest, bell pepper, chili, 1/3 cup olive oil, parsley, garlic, salt, and pepper; blend with an immersion blender to desired consistency for the chimichurri.
Boil salted water and blanch zoodles for 60 seconds; drain well; drizzle with 1/2 tbsp olive oil, salt, and pepper.
Divide zoodles between two plates and top with sliced chicken.
Spoon chimichurri generously over chicken and zoodles; serve immediately.

name: Cream Cheese Keto Pancakes
description: Ultra-simple two-ingredient cream cheese pancakes that are light and delicate with virtually zero carbs.
ingredients: butter or coconut oil for cooking
sugar-free syrup and butter for serving
instructions: Combine cream cheese, eggs, vanilla, and cinnamon in a blender or food processor; blend until completely smooth.
Heat a lightly oiled small skillet over medium heat.
Pour 1/4 cup batter into the pan and swirl gently to spread into a thin round.
Cook for 1–2 minutes until bubbles form at the edges and the surface looks set; carefully flip.
Cook 1 minute on the second side until lightly golden; transfer to a warm plate.
Repeat with remaining batter; serve with butter and sugar-free syrup.

name: Baked Mac and Cheese
description: Rich and creamy macaroni baked with a buttery panko topping until golden and bubbling.
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F. In a medium saucepot combine broth, cream, garlic powder, smoked paprika, and salt; bring to a boil then simmer 7 minutes.
