Remove sauce from heat and whisk in combined cheeses a handful at a time until smooth.
Boil macaroni 7 minutes until just tender; drain. Stir macaroni into cheese sauce.
Toast panko in butter in a small skillet 3 minutes; cool.
Pour half the mac into a greased 8x8-inch dish, sprinkle reserved cheese, top with remaining mac.
Mix toasted panko with additional cheddar and scatter over top.
Bake 20 minutes until bubbling and topping is golden brown. Rest 5 minutes before serving.

name: Baked Chicken Nuggets
description: Crispy cornflake-crusted chicken nuggets baked golden in the oven without any frying.
ingredients: 1.5 lbs boneless skinless chicken breasts cut into 1-inch chunks
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F. Place a wire rack on a foil-lined baking sheet and coat with nonstick spray.
Toss chicken with ranch seasoning, salt, and pepper; let sit 30 minutes.
Set up three bowls: flour, whisked buttermilk and egg, and cornflake crumbs mixed with Parmesan and oil.
Dredge each piece in flour, dip in buttermilk mixture, then press into cornflake mixture.
Arrange on rack in a single layer and coat with nonstick spray.
Bake 13 to 15 minutes until crisp and cooked through. Serve immediately with ketchup or honey mustard.

name: Honey Dijon Chicken Tenders
description: Panko-crusted chicken strips coated in a sweet honey mustard glaze and baked until crispy.
ingredients: 2 boneless skinless chicken breasts sliced into strips
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F. Line a baking sheet with foil or a silicone mat.
In a large bowl combine panko, garlic powder, paprika, salt, and pepper; set aside.
In a small bowl whisk together melted butter, Dijon mustard, and honey.
Working in batches, dip chicken strips in the honey-mustard mixture then dredge in panko, pressing to coat.
Arrange on prepared baking sheet.
Bake 25 to 30 minutes until golden brown and crispy. Serve immediately with extra honey mustard for dipping.

name: Mini Chicken Quesadillas
description: Bite-sized flour tortilla quesadillas stuffed with rotisserie chicken, salsa, and melted cheese.
ingredients: salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°F to keep finished batches warm.
In a bowl combine chicken, cheese, salsa, and cilantro; season with salt and pepper.
Spread refried beans on half of each tortilla then top with chicken mixture and fold to seal.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a cast iron skillet over medium-low heat.
Cook quesadillas in batches 1 to 2 minutes per side until golden brown. Keep warm in oven.
Repeat with remaining oil and quesadillas. Serve with guacamole, pico de gallo, and sour cream.

name: Pepperoni Pizza Bites
description: Fluffy yogurt-dough pizza cups filled with marinara, mozzarella, and turkey pepperoni.
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F and spray two 12-cup mini muffin tins with oil.
Whisk together flour, baking powder, and salt. Add yogurt and mix until combined; dough will look crumbly.
Knead on a floured surface about 15 turns until tacky but not sticky. Divide into 16 equal balls.
Press each ball into the bottom of a muffin cup allowing it to go up the side slightly.
Bake 15 minutes, remove and press centers down to create a well.
Fill each well with 2 tsp sauce, 1 tbsp cheese, and a sprinkle of pepperoni. Bake 3 more minutes until cheese melts.
Cool 2 minutes then carefully remove bites with a small knife or spatula.

name: Pigs in a Blanket
description: Cocktail sausages wrapped in buttery crescent roll dough and baked golden in minutes.
ingredients: 2 cans refrigerated crescent rolls 8 oz each
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F. Line baking sheets with parchment paper.
Unroll crescent roll dough and separate into triangles. Cut each triangle lengthwise into 3 narrow strips to yield 48 pieces.
Place one cocktail sausage at the wide end of each dough strip and roll up toward the narrow end.
Place seam-side down on prepared baking sheets.
Brush with egg wash if desired for extra browning.
Bake 12 to 15 minutes until crescent dough is golden brown. Serve warm with ketchup, mustard, or honey mustard.

name: Baked Chicken Parmesan
description: Crispy breadcrumb-coated chicken topped with marinara and melted mozzarella over spaghetti.
ingredients: 1 lb boneless skinless chicken breasts cut in half crosswise
salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°F. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Cook spaghetti according to package instructions; drain.
Combine breadcrumbs and Parmesan in a shallow bowl.
Brush each chicken piece with melted butter then dredge in breadcrumb mixture pressing to coat.
Place on baking sheet and bake 20 minutes. Gently flip and bake 5 more minutes until golden.
Spoon 1 tbsp marinara onto each piece and sprinkle with mozzarella. Bake 5 minutes until cheese melts.
Serve immediately over spaghetti with additional marinara on the side.

name: Cheesy Broccoli Rice
description: Fluffy white rice folded with chopped broccoli, sharp cheddar, and Parmesan into a simple side.
instructions: Combine rice and water in a large pot. Bring to a boil, reduce to low, cover, and simmer 15 minutes. Turn off heat and rest covered 5 minutes.
Chop thawed broccoli florets into small pieces.
Fluff rice with a fork. Stir in butter, salt, garlic powder, and pepper until butter melts.
Fold in chopped broccoli; the cooler broccoli will slightly lower the rice temperature.
Add Parmesan and cheddar and fold to combine. Cheese should soften but not fully melt.
Taste and adjust salt and butter. Serve immediately.

name: Homemade Fish Sticks
description: Panko-breaded tilapia strips pan-fried to a crispy golden finish kids love with ketchup.
instructions: Pat fish dry and cut into sticks about 3 inches long and 1/2 inch wide.
Set up three bowls: flour mixed with 1 tsp seasoning salt, whisked eggs, panko mixed with 1 tsp seasoning salt.
Bread each stick by dipping in flour, then egg, then pressing into panko.
Heat oil in a small skillet over medium heat until a pinch of panko sizzles on contact.
Fry fish sticks in batches 2 to 4 minutes per side until golden brown; do not crowd the pan.
Transfer to a paper-towel-lined plate to drain. Serve warm with ketchup or tartar sauce.

name: Sloppy Joe Crescent Cups
description: Savory ground beef sloppy joe filling baked in crescent roll cups and topped with cheddar.
ingredients: 1 cup sloppy joe sauce from a 15 oz can
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F. Spray 8 regular muffin cups with cooking spray.
Cook ground beef and onion in a skillet over medium-high heat 5 to 7 minutes until no longer pink; drain fat. Stir in sloppy joe sauce and heat through; cool slightly.
Unroll crescent rolls and press seams together. Cut into 8 squares.
Press one square into the bottom and up the sides of each muffin cup.
Divide beef mixture evenly among cups (about 1/4 cup each). Top each with shredded cheddar.
Bake 14 to 18 minutes until dough is deep golden brown and filling is hot. Cool 5 minutes then remove with a metal spatula.

name: Mini Meatballs in Marinara
description: Tender bite-sized beef meatballs baked and simmered in marinara sauce for easy kid dinners.
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F and line a rimmed baking sheet with parchment paper.
Soak panko in milk for 2 minutes until absorbed to form a panade.
Gently combine ground beef, panade, egg, salt, garlic powder, onion powder, pepper, and Parmesan; do not overmix.
Roll into tablespoon-sized balls and arrange on baking sheet.
Bake 10 to 13 minutes until cooked through to 165°F.
Warm marinara sauce in a saucepan and add cooked meatballs; simmer 5 minutes. Serve over pasta or with crusty bread.

name: Creamy Chicken and Cheesy Rice Skillet
description: One-pan chicken and rice simmered in broth with peas and carrots then broiled with melted cheddar.
ingredients: 2/3 lb boneless skinless chicken breast diced
instructions: Sauté diced onion in butter in a deep oven-safe skillet over medium heat until soft.
Add diced chicken and cook 3 minutes until opaque on outside.
Stir in rice, thyme, salt, pepper, and broth. Bring to a boil over medium-high heat.
Reduce to low, cover, and simmer 15 minutes stirring occasionally.
Stir in frozen vegetables; cover and cook 5 more minutes. Add cream and stir to combine.
Top with shredded cheddar and broil in oven 3 to 5 minutes until cheese is melted and bubbly. Serve hot.

name: Pancake Mini Muffins
description: Fluffy bite-sized pancake muffins baked in a mini tin and served with warm maple syrup for dipping.
ingredients: 1/2 cup blueberries or mini chocolate chips optional
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F. Generously spray a 24-cup mini muffin tin with baking spray.
Sift together flour, baking powder, sugar, and salt.
Stir together milk and eggs, then whisk in vanilla. Combine wet and dry ingredients, then stir in melted butter.
Fill each muffin cup 2/3 full with batter.
Drop 2 to 3 blueberries or a pinch of chocolate chips into each cup if desired.
Bake 8 to 9 minutes until tops are golden brown. Let cool 2 minutes in pan then turn out. Serve warm with maple syrup for dipping.

name: Sneaky Veggie Pasta Sauce
description: A silky tomato pasta sauce blended with five hidden vegetables that kids will never detect.
ingredients: 1 medium roasted sweet potato peeled and cubed
1 can 28 oz diced tomatoes with juice
1 carton 32 oz chicken or vegetable broth
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat. Add onion and sauté 3 minutes until fragrant.
Add garlic, carrot, bell pepper, zucchini, and sweet potato. Cook stirring occasionally 5 to 10 minutes.
Stir in Italian seasoning, tomato paste, diced tomatoes, and broth. Bring to a gentle simmer then turn off heat.
Carefully transfer sauce in two batches to a blender and purée until smooth.
Return puréed sauce to pot and simmer on low 5 minutes. Season with salt and pepper.
Toss with cooked pasta or use as pizza sauce. Freeze leftovers in airtight containers for up to 3 months.

name: Zucchini Pasta with Creamy Sauce
description: Roasted zucchini blended into a silky Parmesan sauce tossed with pasta for a sneaky-veggie dinner.
ingredients: 1 lb pasta such as cavatappi or fusilli
instructions: Toss zucchini with garlic, onion, olive oil, salt, and pepper. Spread on a sheet pan and roast at 425°F for 25 minutes until tender and browned, tossing halfway.
Meanwhile bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook pasta al dente per package directions. Reserve 1 cup pasta water before draining.
Transfer roasted vegetables to a blender. Add Parmesan and broth and purée until smooth.
Return drained pasta to pot and pour zucchini sauce over top. Toss to coat, adding reserved pasta water as needed to loosen the sauce.
Top with fresh black pepper and extra Parmesan. Serve immediately.

name: Cheesy Pasta Bake
description: Hearty penne baked with a meat sauce, ricotta, and three cheeses until bubbling and golden.
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F and grease a 9x13-inch baking dish. Cook pasta al dente; drain.
Brown ground meat with onion, salt, and pepper in a skillet; drain fat.
Add crushed tomatoes, tomato sauce, basil, oregano, and garlic powder. Simmer 5 minutes.
Remove from heat and stir in cooked pasta to coat evenly.
In a small bowl stir together ricotta and Parmesan.
Spread half the noodle mixture in the baking dish. Dollop ricotta mixture over top and spread. Sprinkle with half the mozzarella. Layer remaining noodles and top with remaining mozzarella.
Bake 30 to 35 minutes until bubbling. Rest 10 minutes before serving.

name: Tater Tot Casserole
description: Classic ground beef casserole topped with crispy tater tots and melted cheddar cheese.
ingredients: salt and black pepper to taste
2 cans 10.5 oz each condensed cream of mushroom soup
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F. Spray a 9x13-inch baking dish with nonstick spray.
Brown ground beef and onion in a large skillet over medium heat until no longer pink; drain fat. Season with salt and pepper.
Transfer meat mixture to prepared baking dish. Top with frozen tater tots in an even layer.
Whisk together cream of mushroom soup and milk in a bowl; pour evenly over the tater tots.
Sprinkle shredded cheddar cheese on top.
Bake uncovered 40 minutes until tater tots are golden and filling is bubbling. Serve hot.

name: Classic Sloppy Joes
description: Sweet and tangy ground beef filling piled high on soft hamburger buns for a messy classic.
ingredients: 1 small green bell pepper finely chopped
salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Brown ground beef with onion, bell pepper, and garlic in a large skillet over medium-high heat, breaking into small pieces; drain fat.
Stir in ketchup, tomato paste, brown sugar, mustard, and Worcestershire sauce.
Add water and stir to combine. Season with salt and pepper.
Cook over medium-high heat 7 to 8 minutes stirring often until sauce thickens.
Spoon generously onto hamburger buns and serve immediately with plenty of napkins.

name: Stovetop Mac and Cheese
description: One-pot creamy macaroni and cheese made with a simple milk-cooked pasta method and sharp cheddar.
instructions: Combine dry macaroni and 2 cups milk in a medium pot with a lid. Bring to a boil over medium-high heat stirring occasionally.
Reduce heat to low and simmer stirring often until pasta is tender and has absorbed most of the milk, about 10 minutes. Replace lid quickly after each stir.
Season with salt, pepper, paprika, and Dijon mustard. If mixture looks dry, add the remaining milk.
Turn off heat and stir in shredded cheddar until melted and creamy.
Serve immediately.

name: Pizza Sausage Rolls
description: Bagel-dough rolls stuffed with pizza sauce, mozzarella, and Italian sausage baked golden and sliced.
ingredients: 1 cup all-purpose flour plus more for dusting
2 raw chicken Italian sausage links halved lengthwise
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper and spray with oil.
Whisk flour, baking powder, and salt. Add yogurt and mix until combined. Knead on floured surface 15 turns until tacky but not sticky.
Divide dough into 4 equal balls. Roll each into a 5.5-inch circle about 1/4 inch thick.
Spread 2 tsp pizza sauce down the center of each circle leaving a 1/2-inch border. Top with 1 cheese slice then 1/2 sausage link.
Bring sides of dough up and wrap around sausage; press seams to seal. Place seam-side down on baking sheet.
Brush with egg wash and top with sesame seeds if using. Bake 25 to 30 minutes until golden.
Cool 5 minutes then slice each roll into 6 pieces and serve.

name: Hidden Veggie Mini Meatballs
description: Baked beef meatballs with carrots, onion, and parsley blended right in for extra nutrition.
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F and line a rimmed baking sheet with foil; coat with nonstick spray.
Add carrots, parsley, and onion to a food processor and grind well, scraping down sides as needed.
Add remaining ingredients and pulse to combine into a smooth mixture.
Portion into 2-tablespoon-size meatballs and place on baking sheet.
Bake 22 to 25 minutes until cooked through.
Simmer in warm marinara sauce for 5 minutes if desired. Serve over pasta or with bread.

name: Sheet Pan Chicken Parmesan
description: Easy sheet-pan chicken cutlets breaded and baked with burst cherry tomatoes and fresh mozzarella.
ingredients: 3 cups mixed cherry or grape tomatoes
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F and lightly oil a baking sheet.
Toss tomatoes with garlic, oregano, olive oil, salt, and pepper in a bowl; set aside.
Season chicken with salt and pepper. Dredge in flour, dip in beaten eggs, then press into panko to coat.
Place chicken on baking sheet and coat with nonstick spray. Bake 8 minutes.
Scatter tomato mixture around chicken and bake 15 more minutes until chicken is cooked through and tomatoes have burst.
Top chicken with mozzarella during the last 10 minutes of cooking. Garnish with fresh basil and serve immediately.

name: Cheesy Ground Beef Rice Casserole
description: Ground beef and white rice baked together with cream soup and topped with bubbly cheddar cheese.
ingredients: 1 cup long grain white rice uncooked
1 can 10.5 oz condensed cream of mushroom soup
salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F and grease a 9x13-inch baking dish.
Brown ground beef with onion in a skillet over medium heat; drain fat. Season with garlic powder, salt, and pepper.
Whisk together cream of mushroom soup and beef broth in a bowl until smooth.
Spread uncooked rice evenly in the baking dish. Top with browned beef mixture. Pour soup-broth mixture evenly over top.
Cover tightly with foil and bake 35 minutes until rice is tender.
Uncover, sprinkle with cheddar, and bake uncovered 5 more minutes until cheese is melted and bubbly. Serve hot.

name: Butter Noodles with Parmesan
description: Simple egg noodles tossed in butter and showered with Parmesan for the ultimate kid-approved pasta.
ingredients: salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Cook pasta in a large pot of well-salted boiling water per package directions until al dente. Reserve 1/2 cup pasta water before draining.
Drain pasta and return to the pot over low heat.
Add butter and toss until melted and pasta is coated.
Sprinkle in garlic powder and Parmesan and toss to combine; add a splash of reserved pasta water if needed to loosen.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve immediately garnished with extra Parmesan and parsley if desired.

name: Homemade Chicken Tenders with Ranch
description: Whole wheat breadcrumb-coated baked chicken strips served with a cool Greek yogurt ranch dip.
ingredients: 1 lb boneless skinless chicken breast cut into 1-inch strips
instructions: In a small bowl stir together Greek yogurt, mayonnaise, 1/2 tsp garlic powder, 1/2 tsp onion powder, salt, and pepper for the ranch; refrigerate.
Preheat oven to 450°F. Place a wire rack on a baking sheet and coat with cooking spray.
Season chicken strips with salt and pepper. Set up flour, beaten eggs, and breadcrumbs mixed with garlic and onion powder in three bowls.
Dredge strips in flour, dip in egg, then press in breadcrumbs to coat. Place on rack and spray with cooking spray.
Bake 8 minutes, flip each strip and spray again. Bake 8 to 10 more minutes until crisp and golden.
Serve immediately with Greek yogurt ranch.

name: Mini Pepperoni Flatbread Pizzas
description: English muffin pizzas topped with marinara, mozzarella, and pepperoni ready in under 20 minutes.
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F. Arrange English muffin halves cut-side up on a baking sheet.
Spread about 2 tbsp marinara sauce on each muffin half.
Top each with shredded mozzarella, dividing evenly.
Scatter mini pepperoni over the cheese. Sprinkle with oregano.
Bake 8 to 10 minutes until cheese is melted and bubbly and muffin edges are toasted.
Cool 2 minutes before serving so cheese does not burn little mouths.

name: BBQ Mini Meatball Lunchbox Bites
description: Juicy pan-cooked mini meatballs coated in smoky BBQ sauce for lunchboxes or after-school snacking.
ingredients: salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Combine ground beef with garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and pepper in a large bowl; mix gently.
Using a small cookie scoop or hands roll mixture into mini meatballs roughly 1 inch in diameter.
Heat a large skillet over medium heat and cook meatballs in batches turning occasionally 8 to 10 minutes until cooked through and no longer pink inside.
Drain excess fat from skillet. Return meatballs to pan and add barbecue sauce.
Stir to coat all meatballs in sauce and heat through over low heat 2 minutes.
Serve warm or pack into lunchboxes once cooled.

name: Scrambled Egg Breakfast Quesadillas
description: Fluffy scrambled eggs with cheddar and mild salsa folded inside a golden flour tortilla.
instructions: Whisk eggs with milk, salt, and pepper until blended.
Melt butter in a nonstick skillet over medium-low heat and scramble eggs gently until just set; remove from heat.
Warm a clean skillet or griddle over medium heat.
Lay one tortilla flat and sprinkle half with cheese; top with scrambled eggs and a spoonful of salsa then fold over.
Cook quesadilla 2 to 3 minutes per side until golden brown and cheese is melted. Repeat with remaining tortillas.
Slice into wedges and serve with sour cream.

name: Pull-Apart Garlic Cheese Bread Bites
description: Soft pull-apart rolls brushed with garlic butter and loaded with gooey mozzarella inside.
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F. Grease a 9-inch round baking dish or cast iron skillet.
Mix melted butter with garlic and parsley in a small bowl.
Cut each biscuit round into quarters. Toss biscuit pieces with garlic butter, mozzarella, and Parmesan until evenly coated.
Arrange coated pieces in the prepared dish in a single somewhat crowded layer.
Bake 15 to 18 minutes until dough is cooked through and tops are golden brown.
Serve warm straight from the dish with marinara sauce for dipping.

name: Simple Stovetop Chicken Quesadillas
description: Quick skillet quesadillas filled with seasoned chicken and melted Monterey Jack cheese.
ingredients: salsa and sour cream for serving
instructions: Toss shredded chicken with chili powder, garlic powder, and salt in a bowl.
Heat a large skillet over medium heat with a small drizzle of olive oil.
Lay one tortilla flat and sprinkle cheese over half the tortilla. Top with seasoned chicken and more cheese then fold tortilla in half.
Cook quesadilla 3 to 4 minutes until golden on the bottom. Flip and cook 2 minutes more.
Repeat with remaining tortillas.
Cut each quesadilla into 3 wedges and serve with salsa and sour cream.

name: Spaghetti Carbonara
description: Rich Roman pasta with eggs, guanciale, and pecorino forming a silky cream-free sauce.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook spaghetti until al dente.
Cook guanciale with 2 tbsp olive oil over medium heat until fat renders and meat is crisp about 7 minutes.
Whisk eggs yolks Pecorino Parmigiano and pepper together in a large heatproof metal bowl.
Transfer pasta to skillet with guanciale using tongs leaving pasta water in pot.
Add remaining 1 tbsp olive oil and let pasta cool slightly then scrape pasta and pork into egg mixture.
Add 1/2 cup pasta water to bowl stir well then set bowl over pot of simmering water.
Stir constantly with tongs until sauce thickens to a creamy silky consistency.
Season with salt divide into bowls and top with extra cheese and pepper.

name: Cacio e Pepe
description: Three-ingredient Roman pasta coated in a glossy sauce of pecorino and toasted black pepper.
ingredients: 1 tsp whole black peppercorns toasted and coarsely ground
instructions: Bring a medium pot of lightly salted water to a boil and cook pasta reserving 1 cup starchy water before draining.
Toast peppercorns in a dry skillet over medium heat until fragrant then coarsely grind.
Add 1/2 cup pasta water and butter to a large skillet over medium heat and stir to combine.
Add cooked pasta and toss vigorously until water emulsifies with butter.
Remove from heat and add both cheeses tossing rapidly with tongs.
Add pasta water a splash at a time until sauce is glossy and clings to noodles.
Plate immediately and finish with extra pepper and cheese.

name: Bucatini Allamatriciana
description: Bucatini tossed in a spicy tomato sauce with guanciale and Pecorino Romano.
ingredients: 1 can 28 oz whole San Marzano tomatoes crushed
instructions: Cook guanciale in olive oil over medium heat until fat renders and edges crisp about 8 minutes.
Add red pepper flakes and cook 30 seconds then deglaze with white wine and simmer until evaporated.
Add crushed tomatoes season with salt and simmer 15 minutes until sauce thickens.
Cook bucatini in a large pot of salted water until al dente reserving 1 cup pasta water.
Add drained pasta to sauce and toss over medium heat adding pasta water as needed.
Remove from heat stir in half the pecorino and plate.
Top with remaining pecorino and a grind of black pepper.

name: Simple Essential Bolognese
description: A slow-simmered meat ragu from Smitten Kitchen that develops deep flavor over several hours.
instructions: Pulse onion carrot celery and garlic in a food processor until finely chopped.
If using pancetta cook in a large Dutch oven until crisp then add vegetables and cook until browned about 10 minutes.
Add ground beef and cook until deeply browned about 10 minutes.
Add milk and cook until absorbed then add wine and cook until evaporated.
Stir in tomato paste bay leaf and nutmeg then add 2 cups water and bring to a simmer.
Cook uncovered on lowest heat for 3 hours adding water as needed.
Boil pasta until 1 to 2 minutes shy of done then toss with ragu and reserved pasta water.
Serve in wide bowls with Parmigiano.

name: Classic Fettuccine Alfredo
description: Silky buttery fettuccine made without cream using only butter Parmesan and starchy pasta water.
ingredients: 1 cup finely grated Parmigiano-Reggiano plus more for serving
instructions: Cook fettuccine in a large pot of salted boiling water and reserve 2 cups pasta water before draining.
Melt butter in a large saucepan over medium heat then add 1 cup pasta water and whisk to combine.
Add drained pasta and toss vigorously.
Add grated Parmesan in three batches tossing constantly between additions.
Add more pasta water a splash at a time until sauce is creamy and glossy.
Season with salt and pepper then plate and top with extra cheese.

name: Rigatoni With Easy Vodka Sauce
description: Creamy tangy tomato vodka sauce with rigatoni for a pantry-friendly weeknight dinner.
instructions: In a large skillet melt butter over medium heat and sauté shallot and garlic until soft 4 to 5 minutes.
Add tomato paste and red pepper flakes and cook stirring until paste darkens about 5 minutes.
Add vodka and stir scraping up any browned bits then remove from heat briefly.
Cook rigatoni in salted water until al dente reserving 2 cups pasta water.
Return sauce to medium heat add cream and 1/4 cup pasta water and stir to combine.
Stir in half the Parmesan until melted then add drained pasta.
Fold in remaining cheese adding pasta water as needed and season with salt.
Serve topped with fresh basil.

name: Garden Herb Shrimp Scampi Linguine
description: Garlicky butter-lemon shrimp scampi with zucchini and fresh herbs over linguine.
ingredients: 1 lb large shrimp peeled and deveined
instructions: Cook linguine in well-salted water until al dente reserving 1 cup pasta water then drain.
Heat 2 tbsp olive oil in a large skillet and sear shrimp seasoned with salt and pepper 2 to 3 minutes per side then remove.
Add remaining oil to skillet along with zucchini and shallot and cook 5 minutes.
Add butter garlic thyme and red pepper flakes and cook until fragrant 1 to 2 minutes.
Pour in wine lemon zest and juice and bring to a simmer.
Add shrimp back and toss in pasta thinning sauce with pasta water as needed.
Remove from heat and stir in parsley and chives.
Divide into plates and garnish with fresh herbs.

name: Spaghetti Puttanesca
description: Bold and briny tomato sauce with anchovies olives capers and garlic over spaghetti.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat and cook garlic until golden about 1 minute.
Add anchovies capers olives and red pepper flakes and cook 1 to 2 minutes until anchovies dissolve.
Stir in crushed tomatoes and oregano season lightly and simmer 10 to 15 minutes.
Cook spaghetti in salted water until al dente reserving 1/2 cup pasta water.
Add drained pasta to sauce with a splash of pasta water and toss over low heat 1 minute.
Plate and garnish with fresh parsley.

name: Simplest Spaghetti al Limone
description: Bright uncooked lemon Parmesan sauce over hot spaghetti with fresh basil and olive oil.
ingredients: 1 lemon zest of half juice of whole
kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Cook spaghetti in well-salted water until al dente reserving 1 cup pasta water.
Grate lemon zest into a large serving bowl and add the lemon juice.
Grate Parmesan over the bowl and add olive oil salt and pepper.
Whisk together until smooth and combined.
Add hot drained spaghetti to the bowl and toss until coated.
Add reserved pasta water a tablespoon at a time tossing until glossy and lightly sauced.
Stir in basil and finish with a drizzle of olive oil and extra Parmesan.

name: Slow Roasted Mushroom Pasta
description: Sheet-pan roasted mushrooms and chickpeas over pasta with burrata and balsamic drizzle.
ingredients: 1 lb mixed mushrooms cremini and shiitake
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Toss mushrooms and chickpeas with olive oil rosemary garlic lemon zest and salt on a large sheet pan.
Roast 30 to 35 minutes tossing once until mushrooms are caramelized and chickpeas are crisp.
Cook linguine in salted water until al dente drain and return to pot.
Toss pasta with butter balsamic vinegar Parmesan and kale until kale wilts.
Fold in roasted mushrooms and chickpeas.
Divide into plates top with burrata and drizzle with olive oil.

name: My Old-School Baked Ziti
description: Classic crowd-pleasing baked ziti with meat sauce mozzarella and dollops of ricotta.
ingredients: 1 lb Italian sausage or ground beef
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F.
Cook ziti until 2 minutes shy of al dente drain and reserve 1/2 cup pasta water.
Brown meat with onion garlic oregano and red pepper flakes in an ovenproof skillet 6 to 8 minutes.
Add crushed tomatoes and simmer 5 minutes then stir in spinach until wilted.
Stir drained pasta into sauce and thin with pasta water if needed.
Pour half pasta mixture into a 9x13 baking dish and top with half the cheeses.
Add remaining pasta and finish with remaining mozzarella and Parmesan.
Bake 30 minutes until bubbling and golden.

name: Lasagna Bolognese
description: Decadent multi-layer lasagna with slow-cooked bolognese bechamel and Parmesan.
ingredients: For assembly: 1 lb fresh or dry lasagna noodles
instructions: Make bolognese: cook vegetables until browned add beef brown well add tomato paste wine and milk then simmer 3 to 4 hours adding water as needed.
Make bechamel: melt butter whisk in flour cook 1 minute then gradually whisk in milk and simmer until thick about 10 minutes.
Cook lasagna noodles or soak dry noodles in hot water 10 minutes.
Preheat oven to 400°F.
Spread a thin layer of bechamel in a 9x13 pan then layer noodles bolognese bechamel and Parmesan repeating 4 to 5 times.
Finish top layer with remaining bechamel and Parmesan.
Bake covered 30 minutes then uncover and bake 15 more minutes until golden and bubbling.
Rest at least 15 minutes before slicing.

name: Perfect Vegetable Lasagna
description: Sky-high five-layer vegetable lasagna with fennel mushrooms spinach and creamy ricotta.
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F.
Soak noodles in hot water 10 minutes then drain.
Cook onion and fennel in olive oil over medium-high heat 8 to 10 minutes until browned.
Add mushrooms and cook 5 minutes then stir in spinach until wilted.
Make sauce: sauté garlic add tomato paste then crushed tomatoes and simmer 5 minutes.
Mix ricotta with heavy cream and season with salt and pepper.
Layer sauce noodles ricotta vegetables and cheese repeating 4 times ending with sauce and cheese.
Cover with foil and bake 30 minutes then uncover and bake 20 more minutes until golden.

name: Skillet-Baked Macaroni and Cheese
description: No-boil one-skillet mac and cheese with cheddar Gruyere and a golden panko crust.
ingredients: 3 tbsp unsalted butter plus 2 tbsp for breadcrumbs
6 oz sharp white cheddar coarsely grated
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F.
Melt 2 tbsp butter in a 10-inch ovenproof skillet and toast breadcrumbs until golden then set aside.
Soak dry macaroni in hot tap water 10 minutes then drain.
Melt remaining 3 tbsp butter in the skillet over medium-high heat whisk in flour then gradually whisk in milk.
Cook stirring until thickened 3 to 4 minutes then season with salt pepper cayenne and nutmeg.
Add cheeses reserving 2/3 cup and stir until melted.
Stir in drained macaroni then top with reserved cheese and toasted breadcrumbs.
Bake 30 to 35 minutes until golden and pasta is cooked through.

name: Pasta Salad With Roasted Tomatoes
description: A vibrant make-ahead pasta salad with slow-roasted tomatoes olives pine nuts and fresh basil.
ingredients: olive oil and salt for roasting
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°F and roast tomatoes halved and cut-side-up with oil and salt for 90 minutes until shriveled.
Cook pasta until 1 to 2 minutes shy of done then drain and cool in a large bowl.
Make dressing: mince garlic with oregano salt and pepper into a paste then whisk with lemon juice vinegar and olive oil.
Toss pasta with roasted tomatoes Pecorino pine nuts and olives.
Add dressing to taste and adjust seasoning.
Finish with torn basil.
Serve immediately or refrigerate up to 3 days.

name: Lemon Butter Cheese Ravioli
description: Store-bought cheese ravioli in a browned butter thyme sauce with garlic Parmesan breadcrumbs.
instructions: Toast panko with olive oil garlic and Parmesan in a skillet over medium heat until golden then set aside.
Cook ravioli in salted water until al dente according to package directions.
Melt butter in a large skillet over medium heat until golden brown about 3 to 4 minutes.
Add thyme and stir then pour in wine and lemon juice and simmer 2 minutes.
Drain ravioli and add to sauce tossing gently to coat.
Plate and top generously with garlic Parmesan breadcrumbs and fresh basil.
Finish with a grind of black pepper.

name: One Pot Burrata Lemon Pesto Pasta
description: One-pot pasta with basil pesto ricotta and melty burrata for a summery weeknight dinner.
instructions: Cook pasta in salted water until al dente reserving 1/2 cup pasta water then drain.
In the same pot over medium-high heat cook olive oil shallot garlic thyme and red pepper flakes 1 minute.
Add reserved pasta water pasta pesto balsamic and ricotta and stir to combine.
Break burrata over pasta and remove from heat stirring gently until melty.
Add basil lemon zest and lemon juice then season with salt and pepper.
Serve immediately topped with extra basil.

name: Ricotta Gnocchi With Tomato Sauce
description: Quick light homemade ricotta gnocchi cooked until pillowy and tossed in simple tomato sauce.
ingredients: 3.5 oz all-purpose flour plus more for dusting
instructions: Press ricotta in paper towels to remove moisture until you have about 12 oz.
Combine ricotta eggs egg yolk cheese and a pinch of salt then stir in flour until a soft dough forms.
On a floured surface divide dough into 4 pieces and roll into 1-inch-thick logs then cut into 1-inch pieces.
Boil gnocchi in salted water until they float then cook 20 seconds more and remove with a slotted spoon.
Make sauce: sauté garlic in olive oil add tomatoes and simmer 10 minutes.
Toss gnocchi in sauce and finish with torn basil and Parmesan.

name: Orecchiette With Sausage and Broccoli
description: Rustic orecchiette with crumbled Italian sausage broccoli garlic and Pecorino Romano.
instructions: Cook orecchiette in salted water until al dente reserving 1/2 cup pasta water then drain.
Brown sausage in 1 tbsp olive oil breaking it into pieces 5 to 6 minutes then add garlic and cook 1 minute.
Add remaining olive oil broth broccoli and red pepper flakes and cook 3 to 4 minutes until broccoli is tender-crisp.
Stir in butter until melted then simmer 2 minutes.
Add drained pasta and half the cheese to the pan and toss well.
Adjust consistency with pasta water as needed.
Serve topped with remaining cheese.

name: Pasta Primavera
description: Spring-inspired pasta tossed with sautéed seasonal vegetables in a lemony olive oil sauce.
instructions: Cook penne in a large pot of salted water until al dente then drain reserving 1/2 cup pasta water and toss with a drizzle of oil.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet and sauté garlic onion zucchini squash asparagus and tomatoes 3 to 4 minutes until just tender.
Add drained pasta peas Pecorino and lemon juice to skillet and toss.
Splash in pasta water as needed to loosen sauce.
Stir in basil and season with red pepper flakes salt and pepper.
Serve garnished with extra cheese and basil.

name: Aglio e Olio
description: Classic Roman pasta of spaghetti with garlic slowly toasted in olive oil and red pepper flakes.
instructions: Cook spaghetti in a large pot of salted boiling water until al dente reserving 1 cup pasta water then drain.
Combine olive oil and garlic in a cold skillet then cook over medium heat until garlic turns golden and fragrant about 8 to 10 minutes.
Add red pepper flakes and cook 30 seconds.
Add drained pasta to skillet along with 1/2 cup pasta water and toss vigorously.
Remove from heat stir in parsley and half the Parmesan.
Add more pasta water if needed to keep it silky.
Plate and top with remaining cheese and black pepper.

name: Gnocchi alla Sorrentina
description: Tender potato gnocchi baked in tomato sauce with fresh mozzarella and basil.
ingredients: 1 cup all-purpose flour plus more for dusting
2 cups homemade or store-bought marinara sauce
instructions: Bake potatoes at 400°F until tender then halve and scoop flesh through a ricer onto a floured surface.
Spread riced potato and let steam escape then make a well add egg salt and 3/4 of flour.
Mix gently adding remaining flour as needed until a soft non-sticky dough forms.
Roll into ropes and cut into 1-inch pieces then press with a fork to shape.
Boil gnocchi in salted water until they float then drain.
Preheat oven to 400°F.
Toss gnocchi with marinara in a baking dish scatter mozzarella and Parmesan on top and bake 15 to 20 minutes until cheese is bubbly.

name: Cheese Ravioli With Brown Butter and Sage
description: Pillowy cheese ravioli tossed in a nutty brown butter sauce with crispy sage leaves.
ingredients: 1 lb store-bought or fresh cheese ravioli
1/2 cup apple cider or dry white wine
instructions: Cook ravioli in salted water 3 to 4 minutes until al dente then drain.
Melt butter with garlic walnuts and sage in a large skillet over medium heat.
Cook stirring occasionally until butter is golden-brown and sage is crisp 4 to 5 minutes.
Remove sage leaves and set aside.
Reduce heat add apple cider vinegar and wine and simmer 1 minute.
Season with nutmeg salt and pepper.
Add drained ravioli to sauce and toss gently.
Plate and top with crispy sage and shaved cheese.

name: Stovetop Mac and Cheese
description: Quick creamy stovetop macaroni and cheese with cheddar Gruyere and a touch of cayenne.
instructions: Cook macaroni in salted water until barely al dente then drain.
Melt butter in a large saucepan over medium heat whisk in flour and cook 1 minute.
Gradually whisk in milk and cream and cook until sauce thickens 5 to 6 minutes.
Remove from heat and stir in both cheeses mustard cayenne and nutmeg until smooth.
Season generously with salt and white pepper.
Fold in drained macaroni and stir over medium-low heat 1 to 2 minutes until hot and creamy.
Serve immediately.

name: Cold Italian Pasta Salad
description: A classic deli-style pasta salad with salami olives roasted peppers and zesty Italian dressing.
ingredients: 1/2 cup jarred roasted red peppers chopped
instructions: Cook pasta in salted water until al dente then drain and rinse under cold water.
Whisk together olive oil red wine vinegar oregano garlic salt and pepper for dressing.
Combine cooled pasta with salami tomatoes olives roasted peppers pepperoncini and mozzarella in a large bowl.
Pour dressing over and toss well to coat.
Add Parmesan and toss again.
Taste and adjust seasoning adding more vinegar or salt as needed.
Refrigerate at least 30 minutes before serving.

name: Pasta alla Gricia
description: The ancestor of carbonara featuring guanciale toasted pepper and Pecorino without eggs or tomato.
ingredients: 1 tbsp kosher salt for pasta water
instructions: Cook pasta in a medium pot of salted water using less water than usual to concentrate starch.
Cook guanciale in a large skillet over medium-low heat until golden and fat renders about 10 minutes.
Transfer guanciale to a plate and pour all but 1/4 cup fat into a heatproof cup.
Add pepper to hot fat and toast 30 seconds off heat.
With 2 minutes left on pasta add 1 1/2 cups pasta water to skillet and bring to a boil to reduce.
Transfer pasta with tongs to skillet and toss vigorously over medium heat 3 to 5 minutes until sauce emulsifies.
Off heat stir in guanciale and cheese adding pasta water as needed until glossy.

name: Creamy Mushroom Tagliatelle
description: Tagliatelle tossed with caramelized wild mushrooms butter white wine and fresh herbs.
ingredients: 1 lb mixed wild mushrooms shiitake cremini oyster
instructions: Cook tagliatelle in salted water until al dente reserving 1/2 cup pasta water then drain.
Melt butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat and add mushrooms in a single layer.
Cook undisturbed until golden 4 to 5 minutes then toss and cook 3 more minutes.
Add garlic thyme and sage and cook 1 minute.
Pour in white wine and simmer until reduced by half.
Add cream and pasta water and stir then season with salt and pepper.
Add pasta and toss to coat finishing with Parmesan lemon juice and parsley.

name: Classic Pesto Genovese With Linguine
description: Traditional basil pesto with pine nuts Parmesan and garlic tossed with al dente linguine.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook linguine until al dente reserving 1 cup pasta water.
In a food processor pulse basil pine nuts and garlic until coarsely chopped.
With motor running stream in olive oil until smooth.
Transfer to a bowl and stir in both cheeses and lemon juice then season with salt and pepper.
Drain pasta and immediately toss with pesto loosening with reserved pasta water until silky.
Serve at once with extra Parmesan and a drizzle of oil.

name: Pasta E Fagioli
description: Hearty Italian pasta and bean soup with rosemary garlic cannellini beans and ditalini.
ingredients: 2 cans 15 oz each cannellini beans drained
instructions: Cook pancetta in olive oil in a large pot over medium heat until crisp 5 minutes.
Add onion and cook until softened 5 minutes then add garlic rosemary and red pepper flakes and cook 1 minute.
Add tomatoes broth Parmesan rind and one can of beans.
Mash remaining beans and stir into pot for a thick creamy texture.
Simmer 15 minutes then add pasta and cook until just al dente.
Remove rosemary and Parmesan rind season with salt and pepper.
Ladle into bowls and top with Parmesan and a drizzle of olive oil.

name: Spinach Ricotta Stuffed Shells
description: Jumbo pasta shells stuffed with herbed spinach ricotta and baked in marinara with mozzarella.
ingredients: 2 cups fresh spinach wilted and chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F.
Cook shells in salted water until al dente then drain and cool.
Mix ricotta spinach 1/2 cup mozzarella Parmesan egg garlic Italian seasoning salt and pepper until combined.
Spread 1 cup marinara in the bottom of a 9x13 baking dish.
Fill each shell with ricotta mixture and arrange snugly in pan.
Spoon remaining marinara over shells and top with remaining mozzarella.
Cover with foil and bake 25 minutes then uncover and bake 15 more minutes until bubbling.
Serve with extra Parmesan.

name: Crispy Pan-Seared Salmon
description: Golden-skinned salmon fillets seared to perfection with a translucent medium-rare center.
instructions: Pat salmon fillets completely dry with paper towels on both sides.
Season generously with salt and pepper on both sides.
Heat oil in a cast iron skillet over medium-high heat until shimmering.
Place fillets skin-side down; press gently with a flexible spatula for 15 seconds to prevent buckling.
Reduce heat to medium-low and cook 90% through on skin side about 6 minutes until skin is crisp.
Flip fillets and cook flesh side for 15 seconds until center reaches 120°F.
Transfer to a paper-towel-lined plate; serve immediately with lemon wedges.

name: Shrimp Scampi
description: Classic garlicky shrimp in white wine butter sauce served over linguine or crusty bread.
ingredients: 1.5 lbs large shrimp peeled and deveined
instructions: Cook linguine in salted boiling water until al dente; drain and reserve 1/2 cup pasta water.
Melt butter with olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add garlic and red pepper flakes; sauté 1 minute until fragrant.
Add white wine, salt, and pepper; let reduce by half about 2 minutes.
Add shrimp and cook 2 to 4 minutes until pink and opaque, flipping once.
Stir in lemon juice and parsley.
Toss with linguine adding pasta water as needed for a silky sauce.
Serve immediately.

name: Miso-Glazed Black Cod
description: Silky black cod marinated in a sweet miso glaze and broiled until caramelized and flaky.
instructions: Whisk miso, sugar, mirin, sake, soy sauce, and sesame oil until sugar dissolves.
Pat cod fillets dry and place in a zip-lock bag with the marinade.
Marinate in refrigerator at least 8 hours and up to 24 hours.
Preheat broiler with rack 6 inches from element.
Remove fillets from marinade and wipe off excess; place on an oiled foil-lined baking sheet.
Broil 8 to 12 minutes until surface is deeply caramelized and fish flakes easily.
Serve immediately with steamed rice.

name: Maryland Crab Cakes
description: Classic jumbo lump crab cakes with minimal filler and Old Bay seasoning.
instructions: Whisk together egg, mayonnaise, mustard, lemon juice, Old Bay, parsley, salt, and pepper in a large bowl.
Add crab meat and panko; gently fold with a spatula being careful not to break up the crab lumps.
Portion into 4 to 6 mounds on a buttered baking sheet; do not flatten.
Refrigerate uncovered at least 30 minutes to firm up.
Preheat oven to 450°F and place a small pat of butter on each cake.
Bake 12 to 14 minutes until edges are lightly browned; broil last 2 minutes for color.
Serve warm with lemon wedges and tartar sauce.

name: Classic Cioppino
description: San Francisco-style tomato and wine seafood stew loaded with clams, mussels, shrimp, and fish.
ingredients: 1/2 lb firm white fish cut into pieces
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat; sauté onion and fennel until soft about 8 minutes.
Add garlic, red pepper flakes, and bay leaf; cook 2 to 3 minutes.
Stir in tomato paste; season lightly with salt and pepper.
Add white wine and clam juice; bring to a simmer and cook 5 minutes.
Add canned tomatoes breaking them up; cover and simmer 20 minutes.
Add clams and mussels; cover and cook until they just begin to open about 5 minutes.
Add shrimp and fish; cover and cook 3 to 5 minutes until opaque.
Stir in butter; garnish with parsley; serve with crusty bread.

name: Connecticut-Style Lobster Roll
description: Buttery warm lobster rolls on toasted split-top brioche buns with lemon and fresh herbs.
ingredients: kosher salt and pepper to taste
instructions: Chop lobster meat into large bite-sized pieces.
Melt 6 tbsp butter in a skillet over medium-low heat; add garlic, lemon zest, and half the lemon juice.
Add lobster meat and gently warm tossing to coat about 2 to 3 minutes; season with salt and pepper.
Remove lobster from pan; wipe skillet clean and melt remaining 2 tbsp butter over medium-high heat.
Toast brioche buns on cut sides until golden about 2 minutes per side.
Fill each bun generously with warm buttery lobster.
Drizzle any remaining butter over top; garnish with chives and dill. Serve immediately.

name: Baja Fish Tacos
description: Crispy beer-battered cod in warm corn tortillas with crunchy slaw and chipotle crema.
ingredients: 1.5 lbs cod fillets cut into strips
instructions: Whisk flour, beer, baking powder, cumin, paprika, and garlic powder into a smooth batter; season with salt and pepper.
Toss shredded cabbage with lime juice and a pinch of salt; set aside 10 minutes.
Mix sour cream with minced chipotle; refrigerate until needed.
Heat 2 inches of oil in a heavy pot to 375°F.
Pat cod strips dry; dip in batter letting excess drip off.
Fry in batches until golden and crispy about 3 to 4 minutes; drain on paper towels.
Warm tortillas on a hot griddle.
Assemble tacos with slaw, fried fish, avocado, and chipotle crema. Serve with lime wedges.

name: Peruvian Ceviche
description: Fresh white fish cured in citrus juice with red onion, aji amarillo, and cilantro.
ingredients: 1.5 lbs fresh sea bass or flounder cut into 1/2-inch cubes
1 cup fresh lime juice about 10 limes
2 aji amarillo peppers seeded and minced
instructions: Combine fish cubes with lime juice and 1 tsp salt in a non-reactive bowl; toss to coat.
Cover and refrigerate 15 to 20 minutes until fish is opaque and partially cured.
Soak sliced red onion in cold salted water 10 minutes; drain well.
Drain most of the lime juice from the fish reserving a few tablespoons.
Add onion, aji amarillo, garlic, and cilantro; toss gently.
Season with salt and pepper; fold in avocado and corn.
Serve immediately with tortilla chips.

name: Seafood Paella
description: Saffron-scented bomba rice cooked with shrimp, mussels, and calamari in a wide paella pan.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large paella pan over medium heat.
Sauté onion, bell pepper, and garlic until onion is translucent about 5 minutes.
Add tomatoes, paprika, saffron, salt, and pepper; cook stirring 5 minutes.
Pour in white wine and cook 10 minutes.
Add rice; stir 1 minute to coat.
Pour stock evenly around the pan; bring to a boil then reduce to medium-low. Do not stir.
Cook uncovered 15 to 18 minutes.
Nestle shrimp, mussels, and calamari into the rice; scatter peas on top; cook 5 minutes until shellfish open.
Remove from heat; cover with foil and rest 10 minutes.
Garnish with parsley and lemon wedges; serve from the pan.

name: Pan-Seared Scallops
description: Perfectly seared sea scallops with a caramelized golden crust and nutty browned butter sauce.
ingredients: 1 lb dry sea scallops (10 to 13 scallops)
instructions: Remove abductor muscle from side of each scallop; place on a paper-towel-lined plate and refrigerate 30 minutes to dry thoroughly.
Season scallops generously on both sides with kosher salt.
Heat a large stainless steel skillet over high heat 3 to 5 minutes until very hot.
Add enough neutral oil to coat the bottom; place scallops in single layer with at least 1 inch between each.
Cook undisturbed 2 to 3 minutes until a deep golden crust forms and they release easily.
Flip scallops; add butter and garlic; cook 1 to 2 minutes while basting with browned butter.
Transfer to plates; spoon pan butter over top; finish with flaky salt and parsley. Serve immediately with lemon.

name: Moules Marinières
description: Classic French steamed mussels in a fragrant white wine and shallot broth with crusty bread.
ingredients: 4 lbs live mussels cleaned and debearded
kosher salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Scrub mussels under cold running water; remove beards. Discard any open mussels that don't close when tapped.
Melt butter in a large pot over medium heat; sauté shallots and garlic until softened about 3 minutes.
Add white wine, thyme, and bay leaf; bring to a simmer and cook 2 minutes.
Add mussels; cover with a tight-fitting lid and cook over high heat 3 to 5 minutes until all shells open. Shake the pot occasionally.
Discard any mussels that remain closed.
Stir in heavy cream and parsley; season with salt and pepper.
Ladle into bowls with plenty of broth; serve with crusty bread.

name: Blackened Catfish
description: Cajun-spiced catfish fillets seared in a screaming-hot cast iron skillet until charred and aromatic.
instructions: Mix paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, thyme, cayenne, white pepper, black pepper, and salt in a small bowl.
Heat a heavy cast iron skillet over high heat 8 to 10 minutes until extremely hot and just beginning to smoke.
Dip each catfish fillet in melted butter; coat both sides with the spice mixture pressing gently.
Working in batches place fillets in the hot pan without crowding; drizzle 1 tsp melted butter over each.
Cook until bottom is deeply charred about 2 minutes; flip and add another tsp butter.
Cook 1 to 2 minutes more until fish is cooked through.
Serve immediately with lemon wedges and parsley.

name: Low Country Shrimp Boil
description: Classic Southern boil with shrimp, andouille sausage, corn, and potatoes in a seasoned broth.
ingredients: 2 lbs large shrimp peeled and deveined
1 lb andouille sausage cut into 1-inch pieces
4 ears corn each cut into 4 pieces
instructions: Fill a large stockpot with water; add lemon quarters, onion, garlic, Old Bay, salt, and pepper; bring to a boil.
Add potatoes and cook 10 to 12 minutes until just fork-tender.
Add corn and sausage; cook 5 to 6 minutes more.
Add shrimp; cook 2 to 3 minutes until pink and opaque.
Drain and spread everything onto a large baking sheet.
Toss with melted butter; sprinkle extra Old Bay and parsley over top.
Serve immediately with lemon wedges and extra melted butter.

name: Linguine alle Vongole
description: Traditional Italian pasta with fresh littleneck clams in a garlicky white wine broth.
ingredients: 3 lbs littleneck clams scrubbed and cleaned
instructions: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil; cook linguine to 1 minute shy of al dente; reserve 1 cup pasta water before draining.
Heat olive oil in a large deep skillet over medium-low; add garlic and red pepper flakes; cook until garlic is lightly golden 1 to 2 minutes.
Add white wine, lemon juice, and clams; cover and steam over medium-high heat until clams open 5 to 8 minutes. Transfer clams to a bowl as they open; discard any that don't open after 10 minutes.
Whisk butter into the simmering clam liquid.
Add drained linguine to the pan; toss and cook 2 minutes until al dente adding pasta water as needed.
Stir in half the parsley.
Return clams to pan; toss gently. Serve with remaining parsley and a drizzle of olive oil.

name: Grilled Halibut with Lemon Herb Butter
description: Thick halibut fillets grilled over medium heat and finished with a bright lemon herb compound butter.
instructions: Preheat grill or grill pan to medium-high and lightly oil the grates.
Make compound butter by mashing together butter, garlic, parsley, lemon zest, lemon juice, and thyme; set aside.
Brush halibut fillets with olive oil; season all over with salt, pepper, and smoked paprika.
Grill halibut 5 to 6 minutes per side until grill marks form and internal temperature reaches 145°F.
Transfer to plates; immediately top each fillet with a generous spoonful of compound butter.
Serve with grilled asparagus or a simple green salad.

name: Seared Ahi Tuna Steaks
description: Sesame-crusted sushi-grade tuna seared rare with a soy ginger dipping sauce and sliced avocado.
ingredients: 2 sushi-grade ahi tuna steaks (8 oz each)
instructions: Allow tuna steaks to come to room temperature for 20 minutes; pat dry.
Combine soy sauce, rice vinegar, ginger, sesame oil, and honey in a small bowl to make dipping sauce.
Mix sesame seeds, salt, and pepper on a plate; press tuna steaks into the mixture on all sides to coat.
Heat neutral oil in a cast iron skillet over medium-high heat until very hot.
Sear tuna 1 to 2 minutes per side until browned outside but rare in the center (130°F for medium-rare).
Rest 2 minutes then slice against the grain into 1/2-inch strips.
Serve over avocado with dipping sauce and scallions.

name: Honey Garlic Baked Salmon
description: Oven-baked salmon glazed with a sweet and savory honey garlic sauce that caramelizes beautifully.
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F; line a baking dish with foil and lightly grease.
Whisk honey, soy sauce, garlic, rice vinegar, and red pepper flakes together to make the glaze.
Place salmon skin-side down in the prepared baking dish; season with black pepper.
Spoon the honey garlic glaze over each fillet coating evenly.
Bake 12 minutes until salmon flakes easily and the glaze is caramelized.
Optionally broil last 2 minutes for extra caramelization.
Garnish with parsley; serve with lemon wedges and steamed rice.

name: New England Clam Chowder
description: Creamy classic chowder with tender clams, potatoes, and smoky bacon in a rich cream base.
ingredients: 1.5 lbs Yukon Gold potatoes peeled and cubed
kosher salt and white pepper to taste
instructions: Cook bacon in a large pot over medium heat until crispy; remove with a slotted spoon and set aside leaving fat in pot.
Sauté onion and celery in bacon fat until soft about 5 minutes; add garlic and cook 1 minute.
Sprinkle flour over vegetables; cook stirring 2 minutes to make a roux.
Gradually whisk in clam juice; bring to a simmer while stirring.
Add milk, cream, potatoes, thyme, and bay leaf; simmer over medium-low heat 15 to 20 minutes until potatoes are tender.
Drain canned clams; stir clams into chowder during last 3 minutes of cooking.
Remove bay leaf; season with salt and white pepper.
Serve garnished with bacon and chives with oyster crackers on the side.

name: Salmon Teriyaki
description: Glazed salmon with a classic Japanese teriyaki sauce served with steamed rice and broccoli.
ingredients: steamed rice and broccoli for serving
instructions: Whisk soy sauce, mirin, sake, sugar, sesame oil, garlic, and ginger to make teriyaki sauce; reserve half for serving.
Pat salmon dry; heat vegetable oil in an oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat.
Place salmon skin-side up; sear 3 minutes until golden then flip.
Brush generously with teriyaki sauce; transfer pan to a 400°F oven.
Roast 6 to 8 minutes brushing once more with sauce until salmon is cooked through.
Drizzle with reserved sauce; garnish with scallions and sesame seeds.
Serve with steamed rice and broccoli.

name: Sheet Pan Shrimp Boil
description: Easy oven version of a classic shrimp boil with parboiled potatoes, corn, and andouille sausage.
ingredients: 1 lb medium shrimp peeled and deveined
3 ears corn each cut into 6 pieces
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F; lightly oil a large rimmed baking sheet.
Boil potatoes in salted water 10 to 13 minutes until just tender; add corn during last 5 minutes. Drain well.
Whisk melted butter, garlic, and Old Bay together in a bowl.
Spread potatoes, corn, shrimp, and sausage in a single layer on the baking sheet; pour butter mixture over and toss to coat.
Bake 12 to 15 minutes until shrimp are opaque and corn is tender.
Serve immediately from the pan with lemon wedges and parsley.

name: Garlic Butter Baked Cod
description: Flaky cod fillets baked with herb butter and topped with a buttery Ritz cracker crumble.
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Crush crackers and combine with 4 tbsp melted butter, chives, parsley, lemon zest, onion powder, and garlic powder; mix until all crumbs are moistened.
Place cod fillets in a large oven-safe skillet; drizzle remaining 1 tbsp butter over fish and turn to coat.
Season fish with salt and pepper.
Mound cracker mixture on top of each fillet pressing lightly to adhere.
Roast 10 to 16 minutes depending on thickness until fish flakes easily and juices bubble around edges.
Squeeze lemon juice over top; sprinkle with paprika; serve with lemon wedges.

name: Grilled Salmon with Avocado Salsa
description: Smoky grilled salmon topped with a bright avocado and mango salsa for a vibrant summer dish.
instructions: Preheat grill or grill pan to medium-high; oil grates well.
Brush salmon with olive oil; season all sides with cumin, paprika, garlic powder, salt, and pepper.
Grill salmon 4 to 5 minutes per side until grill marks form and fish is cooked through.
Gently combine avocado, mango, red onion, jalapeño, cilantro, and lime juice; season with salt.
Transfer salmon to plates; top generously with avocado-mango salsa.
Serve immediately with rice or a green salad.

name: Honey Walnut Shrimp
description: Crispy battered shrimp tossed in a creamy honey sauce and topped with candied walnuts.
ingredients: 1 lb large shrimp peeled and deveined
instructions: Bring 1/2 cup water and sugar to a boil; add walnuts and cook 2 minutes; drain and cool on parchment.
Whisk egg whites until frothy; toss shrimp in egg whites then in cornstarch to coat.
Heat 2 inches of oil to 375°F in a heavy pot.
Fry shrimp in batches 2 to 3 minutes until golden and crispy; drain on paper towels.
Mix mayonnaise, condensed milk, honey, lemon juice, and sesame oil in a large bowl.
Toss fried shrimp in the sauce until evenly coated.
Serve immediately over steamed rice topped with candied walnuts.

name: Thai Basil Shrimp Stir-Fry
description: Quick and spicy shrimp stir-fry with Thai basil, chilies, and oyster sauce over jasmine rice.
ingredients: 1.5 lbs large shrimp peeled and deveined
instructions: Combine oyster sauce, fish sauce, soy sauce, and sugar in a small bowl; set aside.
Heat oil in a wok or large skillet over very high heat until smoking.
Add garlic, Thai chilies, and shallot; stir-fry 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add shrimp and bell pepper; stir-fry 2 to 3 minutes until shrimp are pink.
Pour in sauce; toss everything together and cook 1 minute more.
Remove from heat; stir in Thai basil leaves until just wilted.
Serve immediately over steamed jasmine rice.

name: Spicy Tuna Poke Bowl
description: Hawaiian-style raw tuna poke with sesame soy dressing served over sushi rice with fresh toppings.
ingredients: 1.5 lbs sushi-grade ahi tuna cut into 3/4-inch cubes
instructions: Cook sushi rice per package instructions; fold in rice vinegar, sugar, and salt while warm; fan to room temperature.
Whisk soy sauce, sesame oil, rice vinegar, Sriracha, and honey together.
Add tuna cubes and scallions; toss to coat; marinate 10 minutes in the refrigerator.
Divide sushi rice among four bowls.
Top each bowl with marinated tuna, avocado slices, cucumber, and edamame.
Garnish with sesame seeds and pickled ginger. Serve immediately.

name: Smoked Salmon Pasta
description: Creamy fettuccine with smoked salmon, capers, and lemon zest — a quick and elegant weeknight dinner.
ingredients: 8 oz smoked salmon torn into pieces
salt and white pepper to taste
instructions: Cook fettuccine in salted boiling water until al dente; reserve 1/2 cup pasta water before draining.
Melt butter in a large skillet over medium heat; sauté shallots until soft about 3 minutes; add garlic and cook 1 minute.
Pour in heavy cream; simmer until slightly thickened about 3 minutes.
Stir in crème fraîche, lemon juice, and lemon zest.
Toss drained pasta with the cream sauce adding pasta water as needed.
Fold in smoked salmon and capers; remove from heat immediately so salmon stays silky.
Garnish with fresh dill and white pepper; serve right away.

name: Crispy Coconut Shrimp
description: Shrimp coated in toasted coconut and panko, fried until golden and served with a sweet mango dipping sauce.
ingredients: 1.5 lbs large shrimp peeled and deveined tails on
instructions: Make dipping sauce by blending mango, sweet chili sauce, lime juice, and ginger until smooth; refrigerate.
Set up breading station: flour with salt and cayenne in one dish, beaten eggs in a second, coconut mixed with panko in a third.
Pat shrimp dry; dredge in flour then egg then press firmly into coconut-panko mixture.
Heat 2 inches of oil in a heavy pot to 350°F.
Fry shrimp in batches 2 to 3 minutes until golden and coconut is toasted; drain on paper towels.
Serve immediately with mango dipping sauce.

name: Lobster Bisque
description: Velvety rich bisque made with a deep lobster shell stock and chunks of tender lobster meat.
ingredients: 2 lobster tails or 1 lb cooked lobster meat
kosher salt and white pepper to taste
instructions: If using whole lobster tails, cook in boiling salted water 8 minutes; remove meat and reserve shells.
Melt butter in a large pot over medium heat; sauté onion, celery, and carrots until soft about 8 minutes.
Add garlic and tomato paste; cook 2 minutes more.
Add cognac; cook 1 minute until mostly evaporated.
Add white wine, lobster shells, stock, paprika, thyme, and bay leaf; simmer 20 minutes.
Remove shells and bay leaf; use an immersion blender to purée soup until smooth.
Stir in heavy cream and half-and-half; simmer 10 minutes until slightly thickened; season with salt and white pepper.
Chop lobster meat into bite-sized pieces; stir into bisque; heat through 2 minutes. Serve garnished with chives.

name: Salmon Patties with Dill Aioli
description: Pan-fried salmon cakes made from canned wild salmon with a creamy homemade dill aioli.
ingredients: 2 cans (14.75 oz each) wild-caught salmon drained
instructions: Make dill aioli by mixing 1/2 cup mayonnaise with 2 tbsp dill, minced garlic, and 1 tbsp lemon juice; refrigerate.
Combine drained salmon, panko, egg, 3 tbsp mayonnaise, mustard, lemon juice, scallions, 1 tbsp dill, and Old Bay; mix gently.
Season with salt and pepper; form into 8 patties about 1/2-inch thick.
Refrigerate patties 10 minutes to firm up.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Cook patties 3 to 4 minutes per side until golden brown and heated through.
Serve warm with dill aioli and lemon wedges.

name: Garlic Steamed Dungeness Crab
description: Whole Dungeness crab steamed until bright red and served with warm garlic drawn butter and lemon.
ingredients: 2 live or pre-cooked Dungeness crabs (about 2 lbs each)
instructions: Fill a large steamer pot with 2 inches of salted water; add a steamer basket and bring to a boil.
Place crabs in the steamer basket; sprinkle with Old Bay; cover tightly.
Steam live crabs 15 to 20 minutes until bright red and cooked through; steam pre-cooked crabs 8 minutes until heated through.
While crabs steam, melt butter in a small saucepan over low heat with garlic; simmer 5 minutes then squeeze in juice from half lemon.
Strain garlic from butter and keep warm.
Serve crabs immediately with drawn butter, lemon wedges, and a seafood cracker set.
Garnish with fresh parsley.

name: Roasted Brussels Sprouts
description: Halved Brussels sprouts roasted at high heat until caramelized and crispy on the edges.
ingredients: 1 lb Brussels sprouts, trimmed and halved
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Trim and halve the Brussels sprouts and place on the baking sheet.
Drizzle with olive oil, season with salt and pepper, and toss to coat evenly.
Arrange cut-side down in a single layer on the sheet pan.
Roast for 20 to 25 minutes until deeply golden on the flat sides.
Remove from oven and toss with minced garlic and Parmesan.
Squeeze lemon juice over the top and serve immediately.

name: Ratatouille
description: A classic Provencal baked vegetable dish with layered zucchini and eggplant over tomato sauce.
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F.
Spread tomato sauce evenly in the bottom of a large baking dish and stir in garlic.
Slice all vegetables into thin rounds approximately 1/16-inch thick using a mandoline.
Arrange vegetables in alternating overlapping rows over the tomato sauce.
Drizzle with olive oil and sprinkle with thyme, salt, and pepper.
Cover with foil and bake 45 minutes until almost fork-tender.
Remove foil, increase oven to 425°F, and bake 15 minutes more until edges are caramelized.
Serve warm or at room temperature.

name: Crispy Sweet Potato Roast
description: Thinly sliced sweet potatoes fanned upright in a baking dish and roasted until crisped on top.
ingredients: 5 lbs sweet potatoes, peeled and thinly sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F.
Melt butter and oil together in a small saucepan.
Pour 2 tablespoons of the butter-oil mixture into the bottom of a 2-quart baking dish.
Arrange potato slices vertically in the dish and tuck shallot slivers between every few slices.
Brush tops with remaining butter-oil mixture and season generously with salt, pepper, and pepper flakes.
Cover with foil and bake 45 to 50 minutes until potatoes are tender.
Increase heat to 450°F, remove foil, and roast 15 to 20 minutes more until tops are browned and crispy.
Serve immediately.

name: Slow-Roasted Sweet Potatoes
description: Sweet potatoes rubbed with oil and salt and baked low and slow until the flesh is deeply caramelized.
instructions: Preheat oven to 275°F and line a large baking sheet with foil.
Rub each sweet potato with 1 teaspoon olive oil, 1/2 teaspoon salt, and 1/4 teaspoon pepper until well coated.
Arrange on the baking sheet and bake until very soft inside and caramelized on the bottom, about 2 1/2 hours.
Switch oven to broil and run potatoes under the broiler until lightly charred on top, 5 to 10 minutes.
Let cool 10 minutes, then gently crush each potato to expose the flesh.
Finish with a pat of butter and serve.

name: Best Ever Green Bean Casserole
description: A from-scratch green bean casserole with fresh mushrooms and homemade cream sauce.
ingredients: 1 lb fresh green beans, trimmed and halved
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F.
Blanch green beans in salted boiling water for 5 minutes, then plunge into ice water and drain.
Melt butter in a large oven-safe skillet over medium heat and saute mushrooms until golden, about 8 minutes.
Add garlic and cook 1 minute. Whisk in flour and cook 1 minute more.
Gradually whisk in half-and-half and broth, cooking until thickened, about 3 minutes.
Season with salt, pepper, and soy sauce. Stir in green beans.
Top with panko and fried onions and bake uncovered 20 minutes until bubbly and golden.

name: Gingery Glazed Carrots
description: Tender carrots coated in a glossy ginger glaze with butter and a touch of soy sauce.
ingredients: 1 lb medium carrots, peeled and cut on diagonal
instructions: Combine water, butter, ginger, sugar, and soy sauce in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add carrots and bring to a boil.
Cover and cook, stirring occasionally, until carrots are almost tender, about 12 minutes.
Stir cornstarch into 1 tablespoon cold water to form a slurry.
Uncover carrots and stir in cornstarch slurry, cooking until sauce thickens and glazes the carrots, 2 to 3 minutes.
Season with salt and rice vinegar, garnish with parsley, and serve.

name: Creamed Spinach and Wild Rice Casserole
description: A rich bake of caramelized onions with creamy spinach, wild rice, and melted Gruyere.
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F and grease a 9x13-inch baking dish.
Cook onions in butter over medium-low heat, stirring occasionally, until deeply caramelized, about 30 minutes.
Add spinach and cook until wilted. Add garlic, thyme, and poultry seasoning and cook 1 minute more.
Stir in cream cheese, heavy cream, and milk until smooth. Season with salt and pepper.
Spread wild rice in the baking dish and pour creamed spinach mixture over it, stirring gently.
Top with Gruyere and bake 30 minutes until bubbly and golden. Let rest 5 minutes before serving.

name: Crispy Sweet Potatoes with Bourbon Maple Butter
description: Smashed and twice-roasted sweet potatoes drizzled with a bourbon maple pecan butter.
ingredients: 3 large sweet potatoes, peeled and cubed
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Toss sweet potatoes with olive oil, salt, and pepper and spread on the baking sheet.
Roast for 20 minutes until soft and beginning to char on the edges.
Remove from oven and gently smash each cube slightly with a fork to flatten.
Melt butter in a small saucepan and stir in maple syrup, bourbon, and cayenne; cook 1 minute.
Toast pecans in a dry skillet over medium heat until fragrant, about 3 minutes.
Drizzle bourbon maple butter over the sweet potatoes and return to oven for 10 minutes.
Serve topped with toasted pecans.

name: Buttery Mashed Potatoes
description: Classic creamy mashed potatoes made with Yukon Gold potatoes, butter, and warm cream.
ingredients: 3 lbs Yukon Gold potatoes, peeled and quartered
instructions: Place potatoes in a large pot and cover with cold salted water.
Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce to a steady simmer.
Cook until potatoes are very tender when pierced with a fork, 15 to 20 minutes.
Drain well and return to the pot over low heat for 1 minute to evaporate excess moisture.
Pass potatoes through a ricer or mash with a potato masher until smooth.
Add butter in pieces and stir until fully melted.
Gradually add warm cream and stir until fluffy and smooth.
Season with salt and white pepper and serve immediately.

name: Scalloped Potatoes au Gratin
description: Thinly sliced potatoes layered with cream and garlic and topped with melted Gruyere.
ingredients: 3 lbs Yukon Gold potatoes, very thinly sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F and butter a 9x13-inch baking dish.
Combine cream, milk, garlic, salt, pepper, and nutmeg in a saucepan and bring just to a simmer.
Layer one-third of the potato slices in the dish, slightly overlapping, then pour over one-third of the cream mixture and sprinkle with one-third of the cheeses.
Repeat layers twice more, finishing with cheese on top.
Cover tightly with foil and bake 35 minutes.
Remove foil and bake 20 to 25 minutes more until potatoes are tender and top is golden and bubbly.
Let rest 10 minutes before slicing and serving.

name: Roasted Broccoli with Parmesan
description: Broccoli florets roasted at high heat until charred and tender, finished with Parmesan and lemon.
ingredients: 1 large head broccoli, cut into florets
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Cut broccoli into even medium florets and pat dry thoroughly.
Toss florets with olive oil, garlic, salt, pepper, and red pepper flakes on the baking sheet.
Spread in a single layer with space between florets.
Roast for 14 to 18 minutes until edges are golden and stems are crisp-tender.
Immediately sprinkle with Parmesan and lemon juice and serve warm.

name: Roasted Cauliflower with Garlic
description: Cauliflower florets tossed in olive oil and roasted until golden brown with caramelized edges.
ingredients: 1 large head cauliflower, cut into florets
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F and line a large baking sheet with parchment paper.
Break cauliflower into even bite-sized florets and add to the baking sheet.
Drizzle with olive oil and melted butter, then sprinkle with garlic powder, paprika, salt, and pepper.
Toss to coat and spread into a single even layer with flat sides down.
Roast for 15 minutes, then flip and roast another 7 minutes until golden and caramelized.
Sprinkle with parsley and serve immediately.

name: Roasted Asparagus with Lemon
description: Fresh asparagus roasted at high heat with olive oil and finished with bright lemon and Parmesan.
ingredients: 1 lb fresh asparagus, woody ends trimmed
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F and line a rimmed baking sheet with parchment paper.
Place trimmed asparagus on the baking sheet and pat dry.
Drizzle with olive oil, season with salt and pepper, and toss to coat.
Spread in a single layer and place lemon halves cut-side down alongside asparagus.
Roast thin asparagus 9 to 12 minutes or thick spears 15 to 20 minutes until fork-tender.
Transfer to a serving platter, squeeze roasted lemon over the top, and sprinkle with Parmesan and parsley.

name: Honey Roasted Carrots
description: Caramelized roasted carrots tossed with honey, garlic, and butter until sticky and golden.
ingredients: 1 lb medium carrots, peeled and cut into 2-inch pieces
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Toss carrots with olive oil, butter, honey, garlic, salt, and pepper in a large bowl.
Spread on a rimmed baking sheet in a single layer.
Roast for 15 minutes, then toss carrots in the accumulated glaze and spread out again.
Continue roasting 10 minutes more until tender and caramelized on the edges.
Transfer to a serving dish, toss in any remaining glaze, and sprinkle with parsley.
Serve warm.

name: Hasselback Potatoes
description: Accordion-sliced potatoes roasted until crispy on the edges and fluffy inside with garlic herb butter.
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Place each potato between two chopsticks to act as a cutting guide.
Slice each potato crosswise into very thin 1/8-inch slices, stopping when the knife hits the chopsticks so the base stays intact.
Place potatoes on the baking sheet, drizzle with olive oil, and season with salt and pepper, working oil between the slices.
Roast for 50 minutes.
Whisk together melted butter, garlic, rosemary, and thyme. Brush generously over potatoes, getting butter between the slices.
Return to oven and roast 25 more minutes until slices are deeply golden and crispy.
Sprinkle with parsley and serve immediately.

name: Herb Rice Pilaf
description: Toasted long-grain rice cooked in seasoned broth with onion and fresh herbs until fluffy.
instructions: Melt butter with olive oil in a medium saucepan over medium heat.
Add onion and saute until translucent, about 4 minutes. Add garlic and cook 1 minute more.
Add rice and stir to coat, toasting until lightly golden and fragrant, about 4 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper, then pour in warmed broth and bring to a boil.
Cover tightly, reduce heat to low, and cook for 15 minutes without lifting the lid.
Remove from heat and let rest, covered, for 10 minutes.
Fluff with a fork, stir in parsley and chives, and serve.

name: Roasted Vegetable Quinoa
description: Fluffy quinoa tossed with roasted seasonal vegetables and a bright lemon dressing.
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F.
Toss zucchini, bell pepper, and tomatoes with 2 tablespoons olive oil, salt, and pepper on a baking sheet. Roast 20 minutes until tender.
Combine quinoa and broth in a saucepan, bring to a boil, then reduce to a gentle simmer and cook uncovered 15 minutes until liquid is absorbed.
Remove from heat, cover, and rest 5 minutes, then fluff with a fork.
Whisk together remaining olive oil, lemon juice, lemon zest, and garlic to make a dressing.
Combine quinoa, roasted vegetables, and chickpeas in a large bowl. Drizzle with dressing and toss.
Stir in fresh basil and serve warm or at room temperature.

name: Lemon Herb Couscous
description: Fluffy couscous steamed in broth and tossed with fresh herbs, toasted almonds, and bright citrus.
instructions: Place couscous in a large heatproof bowl with salt and olive oil.
Pour boiling broth over couscous, stir once, and immediately cover tightly with plastic wrap.
Let steam for 5 minutes without lifting the cover.
Fluff couscous with a fork, breaking up any clumps.
Add lemon zest, lemon juice, parsley, mint, almonds, and currants and toss gently.
Season with black pepper and additional salt to taste.
Serve warm or at room temperature.

name: Sauteed Garlic Mushrooms
description: Cremini mushrooms sauteed in butter with garlic and fresh thyme until golden and deeply savory.
ingredients: 1 lb cremini mushrooms, cleaned and sliced
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat until shimmering.
Add butter, mushrooms, salt, and pepper and cook, stirring occasionally, until mushrooms release their liquid and liquid evaporates, about 8 to 10 minutes.
Stir in soy sauce, balsamic vinegar, and garlic and cook, stirring constantly, for 30 to 60 seconds until garlic is fragrant.
Remove from heat and stir in fresh thyme and parsley.
Taste and adjust seasoning, then serve hot.

name: Creamed Spinach
description: Rich and velvety creamed spinach made with fresh spinach, cream cheese, and Parmesan.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Add spinach and blanch 1 minute until wilted.
Drain and squeeze out excess moisture in small handfuls. Roughly chop and set aside.
Melt butter in a large skillet over medium heat. Add shallot and cook until softened, about 3 minutes. Add garlic and cook 1 minute more.
Add cream cheese and heavy cream, stirring until cream cheese melts and sauce is smooth.
Stir in Parmesan and nutmeg.
Add chopped spinach and stir to combine and heat through, 2 to 3 minutes.
Season with salt, pepper, and lemon juice. Serve hot.

name: Classic Coleslaw
