description: Crisp green and red cabbage tossed in a creamy tangy dressing with celery seed and honey.
instructions: Combine shredded green cabbage, red cabbage, and grated carrots in a large bowl.
In a separate bowl, whisk together mayonnaise, vinegar, honey, celery seeds, salt, and pepper until smooth.
Pour dressing over the cabbage mixture and toss thoroughly to coat.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow flavors to meld and cabbage to soften slightly.
Toss again just before serving and adjust seasoning as needed.

name: Caprese Salad
description: A classic Italian salad of ripe heirloom tomatoes, fresh mozzarella, basil, and good olive oil.
instructions: Slice tomatoes and mozzarella into roughly 1/4-inch thick rounds.
On a large serving platter, alternate and overlap slices of tomato, mozzarella, and basil leaves.
Drizzle generously with extra-virgin olive oil.
Drizzle balsamic reduction over the top.
Season with flaky sea salt and black pepper.
Serve immediately at room temperature.

name: Cucumber Dill Salad
description: Crisp cucumbers and red onion marinated in a vinegar dressing and finished with fresh dill.
ingredients: 1/2 large red onion, very thinly sliced
instructions: In a large bowl, toss together sliced cucumber, onion, vinegar, honey, and salt until well coated.
Cover and refrigerate for 20 minutes, allowing the cucumbers to release their water and absorb the dressing.
Transfer to a clean serving bowl, leaving excess liquid behind.
Sprinkle with fresh dill and chives.
Season with black pepper and serve chilled.

name: Grilled Summer Vegetables
description: Zucchini, bell peppers, and eggplant grilled with a herb-garlic marinade until tender.
ingredients: 1 red onion, cut into thick rounds
instructions: Combine olive oil, balsamic vinegar, garlic, thyme, oregano, salt, and pepper in a small bowl.
Toss vegetables in the marinade and let sit for 10 minutes.
Preheat a gas or charcoal grill to medium-high heat.
Grill vegetables in batches, turning once, until tender with grill marks, about 3 to 4 minutes per side.
Transfer to a serving platter as they finish.
Drizzle any remaining marinade over the grilled vegetables, scatter fresh basil on top, and serve warm.

name: Honey Butter Corn on the Cob
description: Sweet corn boiled in salted water and finished with honey butter and a pinch of smoked paprika.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil.
Mix softened butter, honey, and smoked paprika in a small bowl until smooth.
Add corn to the boiling water and cook until kernels are bright yellow and crisp-tender, 4 to 5 minutes.
Remove corn with tongs and place on a serving platter.
Immediately spread each ear with a generous amount of honey butter.
Season with salt and pepper, garnish with chives, and serve hot.

name: Buttermilk Cornbread
description: A moist and golden cornbread baked in a cast iron skillet with a crispy browned butter bottom.
instructions: Adjust oven rack to center position and preheat oven to 425°F.
Place butter in a 10-inch cast iron skillet and heat in the oven until well browned, 10 to 15 minutes.
Pour browned butter into a heatproof bowl, leaving about 1 tablespoon in the skillet.
Combine cornmeal, flour, sugar, salt, baking powder, and baking soda in a large bowl.
Whisk eggs, sour cream, and buttermilk together in a second bowl, then slowly drizzle in the browned butter while whisking constantly.
Fold wet ingredients into dry until just combined.
Pour batter into the skillet and smooth the top, then bake until golden and a skewer comes out clean, 20 to 25 minutes.
Let cool 10 minutes and serve warm with honey and butter.

name: Soft Dinner Rolls
description: Pillowy homemade dinner rolls with a buttery crust, perfect for any occasion.
ingredients: 1/4 tsp flaky sea salt, for topping
instructions: Combine warm milk, sugar, and yeast in a large bowl and let stand until foamy, about 5 minutes.
Add egg, softened butter, and salt and stir to combine.
Add flour and mix until a shaggy dough forms, then knead on a lightly floured surface until smooth, about 8 minutes.
Place in a greased bowl, cover with plastic wrap, and let rise until doubled, about 1 hour.
Punch down dough and divide into 12 equal pieces. Shape each into a smooth ball and arrange in a greased 9x13-inch baking pan.
Cover and let rise until puffy, about 45 minutes. Preheat oven to 375°F.
Brush rolls with melted butter and sprinkle with flaky salt. Bake 16 to 18 minutes until golden brown.
Brush again with melted butter and serve warm.

name: Garlic Herb Roasted Baby Potatoes
description: Crispy-edged baby potatoes tossed with garlic, rosemary, and thyme and roasted until golden.
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F and line a large baking sheet with parchment paper.
Toss halved potatoes with olive oil, garlic, rosemary, thyme, salt, and pepper until evenly coated.
Spread cut-side down on the baking sheet in a single layer.
Roast for 25 to 30 minutes, without stirring, until cut sides are deeply golden and crispy.
Remove from oven, immediately sprinkle with Parmesan, and toss gently.
Garnish with parsley and serve hot.

name: Brown Butter Green Beans with Almonds
description: Tender-crisp green beans blanched and finished in nutty brown butter with toasted almonds.
instructions: Bring a large pot of generously salted water to a boil.
Blanch green beans until crisp-tender, about 4 minutes. Drain and plunge into ice water to stop cooking, then drain and pat dry.
In a large skillet over medium heat, melt butter and cook, swirling often, until foam subsides and butter turns golden brown and nutty, about 3 to 4 minutes.
Add almonds and garlic and cook until almonds are lightly toasted, about 1 minute.
Add green beans and toss to coat, heating through for 2 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper, squeeze lemon juice over the top, and serve immediately.

name: Balsamic Brussels Sprouts with Bacon
description: Brussels sprouts roasted with crispy bacon and finished with a sweet balsamic glaze.
ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs Brussels sprouts, trimmed and halved
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F and line a large baking sheet with foil.
Spread Brussels sprouts and bacon pieces on the baking sheet. Drizzle with olive oil, season with salt, pepper, and red pepper flakes, and toss to combine.
Arrange cut-side down in a single layer.
Roast for 20 minutes until sprouts are beginning to brown.
Whisk balsamic vinegar and maple syrup together, then drizzle over the pan and toss.
Return to oven and roast 8 to 10 minutes more until sprouts are caramelized and bacon is crispy.
Serve immediately.

name: Reverse-Sear Ribeye
description: Thick ribeye slow-roasted in a low oven then seared in a screaming-hot cast iron for a perfect crust.
instructions: Season steaks generously with salt and pepper; place on a wire rack set over a baking sheet and refrigerate uncovered at least 1 hour or overnight.
Preheat oven to 250°F. Place rack with steaks in oven.
Cook until an instant-read thermometer reads 115°F for medium-rare, about 45-60 minutes.
Remove steaks from oven. Heat oil in a cast iron skillet over high heat until smoking.
Add steaks and sear, pressing down firmly, for 45-60 seconds per side until deeply browned.
Add butter, thyme, and garlic; baste steaks for 30 seconds.
Serve immediately — no resting needed with reverse sear.

name: Pan-Seared Filet Mignon
description: Butter-basted tenderloin medallions with a golden crust and rosy pink center cooked to perfection.
ingredients: 2 6-oz filet mignon steaks about 1.5 inches thick
instructions: Remove steaks from fridge 30 minutes before cooking. Pat dry and season all over with salt and pepper.
Heat oil in a cast iron skillet over high heat until just smoking.
Add steaks and sear without moving for 3 minutes until a deep brown crust forms.
Flip steaks; add butter, thyme, garlic, and shallot to the pan.
Tilt pan and baste steaks continuously with the foaming butter for 2 minutes.
Check temperature — pull at 120°F for medium-rare.
Rest steaks on a cutting board for 5 minutes before serving.

name: Grilled New York Strip
description: Classic charcoal-grilled strip steaks seasoned simply with salt and finished with garlic compound butter.
ingredients: 2 12-oz New York strip steaks 1.25 inches thick
instructions: One hour before cooking season steaks generously with salt; let rest at room temperature.
Mix butter with garlic, thyme, and Worcestershire; set aside as compound butter.
Prepare grill for high direct heat; clean and oil grates.
Place steaks on hot grill at 45 degrees; cook 2-3 minutes. Rotate 90 degrees, cook 2 more minutes.
Flip steaks and repeat on the second side, cooking to 130°F internal for medium-rare.
Transfer to a cutting board and top immediately with compound butter.
Rest 8-10 minutes before serving.

name: Skirt Steak Fajitas
description: Sizzling marinated skirt steak with charred peppers and onions served in warm flour tortillas.
instructions: Cut skirt steak into 3 equal pieces; combine olive oil, lime juice, soy sauce, salt, chile powder, and cumin in a bowl. Reserve 1/4 cup marinade; pour rest over steak in a bag. Marinate 30 minutes.
Sear marinated steaks in canola oil in a hot cast iron skillet 2-3 minutes per side; rest and slice against the grain.
In the same skillet cook peppers and onions until softened, 5-6 minutes.
Return sliced steak to the skillet with reserved marinade for a final sizzle.
Serve immediately in warm tortillas with guacamole, pico de gallo, and sour cream.

name: Steak au Poivre
description: Classic French pepper-crusted steak with a rich cognac and cream pan sauce for a restaurant-worthy dinner.
instructions: Pat steaks dry with paper towels and season with salt. Press crushed peppercorns firmly onto both sides of each steak.
Heat oil in a large stainless or cast iron pan over medium-high heat until shimmering. Add steaks; cook 4 minutes per side for medium-rare (120-125°F). Rest on a plate tented with foil.
Pour off excess fat from pan; add shallot and a pinch of salt; cook 2 minutes until soft.
Remove pan from heat; add cognac. Return to medium-high heat; cook until nearly evaporated, 2 minutes.
Add cream; simmer until sauce coats the back of a spoon, 2-3 minutes. Add green peppercorns.
Season sauce with salt; whisk in cold butter off heat.
Plate steaks and spoon sauce over top.

name: Sous Vide Ribeye
description: Precisely temperature-controlled ribeye cooked in a water bath for edge-to-edge perfection then flash-seared.
instructions: Season steaks with salt and pepper. Seal each steak in a separate vacuum or zip-top bag with a rosemary sprig and 1 tbsp butter.
Set sous vide circulator to 130°F for medium-rare. Submerge bags and cook for 2 hours.
Remove steaks from bags and pat completely dry with paper towels. Discard liquid.
Heat oil in a cast iron skillet over the highest heat until smoking.
Sear steaks 1 minute per side, pressing down for full contact; also sear the fat cap on the edges.
Add garlic and remaining butter for the last 30 seconds; baste quickly.
Serve immediately — no resting required.

name: Chimichurri Flank Steak
description: Grilled flank steak sliced against the grain and topped with vibrant garlicky Argentine herb sauce.
instructions: Make chimichurri: pulse parsley, oregano, garlic, and red pepper flakes in a food processor until finely chopped. Transfer to a bowl; stir in vinegar, salt, and olive oil. Set aside 1 hour.
Pat flank steak dry; season with salt and pepper. Let sit at room temperature 30 minutes.
Heat a grill or cast iron skillet to very high heat; oil the grates or pan.
Cook steak 4-5 minutes per side for medium-rare (125°F internal).
Rest steak on a cutting board for 5-10 minutes.
Slice thinly against the grain at a slight diagonal.
Plate and spoon chimichurri generously over the top.

name: Korean Bulgogi Beef
description: Sweet and savory thinly sliced beef marinated in soy sauce and pear then grilled over high heat.
ingredients: 1 lb beef ribeye or sirloin thinly sliced
instructions: In a bowl mix together pear puree, onion puree, garlic, ginger, green onion, soy sauce, brown sugar, and black pepper.
Add thinly sliced beef and mix gently, massaging marinade into the meat. Stir in sesame oil last.
Cover and refrigerate at least 30 minutes, or overnight for best flavor.
Heat a grill pan or skillet over medium-high heat; add cooking oil until shimmering.
Add beef in a single layer; cook 3-5 minutes until cooked through and slightly caramelized.
Sprinkle with sesame seeds.
Serve over steamed rice with kimchi and ssam vegetables.

name: Hanger Steak with Herb Marinade
description: Deeply flavorful butcher's cut marinated in herbs and garlic then pan-seared to medium-rare perfection.
ingredients: 1.5 lbs hanger steak center sinew removed
instructions: Combine olive oil, garlic, shallot, thyme, rosemary, and parsley in a bowl. Add steak, turning to coat. Marinate 6 hours or overnight in the fridge.
Remove steak from marinade; pat dry. Season with salt and pepper.
Heat a heavy skillet over medium-high heat until nearly smoking.
Sear steak, flipping every 1-2 minutes, until deeply browned and internal temperature reaches 100°F.
Add butter and aromatics; baste steak until it reaches 120°F.
Transfer to a cutting board and rest 5 minutes.
Slice thinly against the grain, finishing with flaky sea salt.

name: Tomahawk Steak Reverse Sear
description: Dramatic bone-in cowboy ribeye slow-cooked then finished on a screaming hot grill for a spectacular crust.
instructions: Season tomahawk generously with salt, pepper, and garlic powder on all sides. Refrigerate uncovered on a rack overnight.
Preheat oven to 225°F; place steak on a wire rack over a sheet pan and insert a probe thermometer.
Roast until the internal temperature reaches 100°F, about 60-75 minutes.
Preheat a grill or grill pan to the highest possible heat (550°F+).
Sear tomahawk on all sides including the fat cap, 2-3 minutes per side, until charred grill marks form and internal temperature reaches 125°F.
Rest on a cutting board for 10 minutes.
Slice off the bone, then cut against the grain; finish with herb butter.

name: Steak Frites
description: Classic brasserie-style pan-seared strip steak alongside double-fried golden crispy French fries.
ingredients: 1.5 lbs russet potatoes cut into 1/4-inch fries
instructions: Parboil fries in 300°F oil for 3 minutes; drain and let cool on a sheet pan (can hold several hours).
Season steaks with salt and pepper. Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large skillet over high heat until smoking.
Add steaks; press down firmly. Cook 2-3 minutes per side until deep brown crust forms. Add butter, thyme, and garlic; baste 1-2 minutes until reaching 120°F.
Rest steaks on a cutting board 5 minutes while you finish the fries.
Heat frying oil to 350°F; fry potatoes in batches 3-5 minutes until deep golden and crispy. Drain and salt immediately.
Slice steaks or serve whole alongside the crispy fries.
Top with herb butter and serve at once.

name: Philly Cheesesteak
description: Thinly shaved ribeye with caramelized onions and melted provolone piled into a toasted hoagie roll.
ingredients: 1 lb ribeye steak trimmed and thinly sliced
instructions: Place ribeye in the freezer for 30 minutes; once firm, slice as thinly as possible.
Mix butter with pressed garlic; spread onto cut sides of hoagie rolls and toast on a skillet until golden. Set aside.
Add 1 tbsp oil to the pan over medium heat; sauté onion until caramelized, about 8-10 minutes. Season with salt; transfer to a bowl.
Increase heat to high; add remaining oil. Spread sliced ribeye in a single even layer; let brown 2 minutes undisturbed.
Season steak with salt and pepper; flip and stir in caramelized onions. Divide into 4 portions.
Lay 2 slices provolone over each portion; cover pan briefly to melt the cheese.
Spread mayo on toasted rolls; scoop cheesy steak into each roll with a spatula and serve immediately.

name: Carne Asada Tacos
description: Citrus and chile marinated grilled flank steak sliced thin and served in warm corn tortillas with fresh salsa.
ingredients: 2 lbs flank steak or skirt steak
instructions: Whisk together cilantro, olive oil, soy sauce, orange juice, lime juice, garlic, jalapeno, chili powder, cumin, and salt in a bowl. Reserve 1/4 cup; pour rest over steak in a large bag. Marinate 2-4 hours.
Preheat outdoor grill to high heat (450-500°F). Remove steak from marinade; pat dry and drizzle with a little olive oil.
Grill steak with lid closed 4-6 minutes per side for skirt steak or 7-8 minutes for flank, until 130-135°F internal.
Rest steak 5 minutes on a cutting board.
Slice thinly against the grain.
Serve in warm corn tortillas with pico de gallo and avocado.

name: Steak and Arugula Salad
description: Sliced grilled sirloin over peppery arugula with shaved Parmesan and bright lemon vinaigrette.
instructions: Pat steak dry and season generously with salt and pepper. Let sit at room temperature 20 minutes.
Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a cast iron skillet over high heat until nearly smoking.
Sear steak 4-5 minutes per side for medium-rare. Rest 5-10 minutes then slice thinly.
Whisk together lemon juice, mustard, shallot, and olive oil to make vinaigrette; season with salt and pepper.
Toss arugula and cherry tomatoes with just enough vinaigrette to lightly coat.
Plate salad; arrange sliced steak on top.
Scatter shaved Parmesan over the salad and drizzle with remaining vinaigrette.

name: Flank Steak with Soy-Ginger Marinade
description: Overnight-marinated flank steak grilled to medium-rare with a deeply savory umami-rich glaze.
instructions: Whisk together soy sauce, olive oil, honey, sesame oil, garlic, ginger, rice vinegar, and red pepper flakes.
Place flank steak in a resealable bag; pour marinade over it. Marinate at least 4 hours or overnight in the refrigerator.
Remove steak from fridge 30 minutes before cooking.
Preheat grill to high heat. Remove steak from marinade; discard marinade.
Grill 5-6 minutes per side for medium-rare, basting with a little reserved marinade once.
Rest steak 10 minutes, then slice thinly against the grain at a diagonal.
Garnish with sliced scallions and sesame seeds.

name: Skirt Steak with Salsa Verde
description: Grilled skirt steak served with bright Italian herb salsa verde packed with capers and anchovies.
instructions: Make salsa verde: pulse parsley, basil, capers, anchovies, and garlic in a food processor until roughly chopped. Add lemon juice; slowly drizzle in olive oil until combined but still textured. Season with salt.
Pat skirt steak dry and season with salt and pepper. Let rest at room temperature 20 minutes.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a cast iron skillet or grill over very high heat until smoking.
Sear skirt steak 2-3 minutes per side for medium-rare — it cooks fast.
Rest steak 5 minutes on a cutting board.
Slice thinly against the grain.
Plate and spoon salsa verde generously over the sliced steak.

name: Cowboy Ribeye with Herb Butter
description: Thick bone-in cowboy-cut ribeye grilled over charcoal with a smoky crust and melting compound butter.
instructions: Season ribeye liberally with salt and pepper; let rest at room temperature for 45 minutes.
Mix softened butter with chives, parsley, garlic powder, smoked paprika, and lemon zest; shape into a log in plastic wrap and refrigerate.
Prepare charcoal grill for two-zone fire; grill grates should be very hot.
Sear steak directly over coals 3-4 minutes per side until deeply charred.
Move to indirect heat; cook with lid closed until internal temperature reaches 125°F for medium-rare.
Rest steak 10 minutes loosely tented with foil.
Top with a generous slice of herb butter and serve.

name: Japanese Teppanyaki Sirloin
description: Tender sirloin seared on a hot iron griddle with garlic butter and soy sauce in Japanese style.
ingredients: 2 cups mixed vegetables zucchini and mushrooms
instructions: Pat steaks dry and season with salt and pepper. Slice into 1-inch strips if desired for faster cooking.
Heat a flat iron griddle or large heavy skillet over very high heat until smoking. Add oil.
Sear steaks or steak strips 2-3 minutes per side until browned. Remove and set aside.
Add butter and garlic to the griddle; cook 30 seconds until fragrant. Add vegetables and stir-fry 3-4 minutes until tender-crisp.
Whisk together soy sauce, mirin, sesame oil, and sugar; pour over the vegetables and toss.
Return steak to the griddle; toss with sauce for 30 seconds.
Serve immediately over steamed rice with extra soy sauce on the side.

name: T-Bone Steak on the Grill
description: Classic grilled T-bone featuring both the strip and tenderloin sides cooked to simultaneous perfection.
instructions: Season T-bone steaks on all sides with salt, pepper, and garlic powder at least 30 minutes before cooking.
Prepare grill for high direct heat. Brush grates with oil.
Place steaks on grill with the strip side toward the hotter part of the grill.
Cook 4-5 minutes per side, rotating 90 degrees once per side for crosshatch grill marks.
Check temperature in the strip side — pull at 125°F for medium-rare.
In a small saucepan melt butter with rosemary and garlic until fragrant.
Rest steaks 5-8 minutes; drizzle with garlic-rosemary butter before serving.

name: Steak Diane
description: Retro tableside-style seared steak with mushrooms, Worcestershire, brandy, and cream in a classic pan sauce.
ingredients: 2 6-oz filet mignon or sirloin steaks pounded to 1/2 inch
instructions: Pound steaks to about 1/2-inch thickness. Season with salt and pepper.
Heat butter and oil in a skillet over high heat until foaming; sear steaks 2 minutes per side. Remove and rest.
Reduce heat to medium; cook shallots and mushrooms in the same pan 3-4 minutes until golden.
Remove pan from heat; add brandy. Return to heat; cook until almost evaporated, 1 minute.
Stir in Worcestershire sauce and Dijon mustard; add beef stock and simmer 3-4 minutes.
Stir in heavy cream; simmer until sauce thickens, 2-3 minutes.
Return steaks to pan; coat in sauce; garnish with parsley and serve immediately.

name: Porterhouse for Two
description: Massive bone-in porterhouse shared for two, seared in cast iron then finished in the oven with herbs.
ingredients: 1 porterhouse steak 2 to 2.5 inches thick about 2 lbs
instructions: Season porterhouse generously with salt and pepper on all sides. Let rest at room temperature 45 minutes.
Preheat oven to 400°F. Heat oil in a large oven-safe cast iron skillet over high heat until smoking.
Sear steak 3-4 minutes per side until deeply browned, also searing the edges.
Add butter, garlic, thyme, and rosemary to the pan; baste steak for 1-2 minutes.
Transfer pan to oven; roast until an instant-read thermometer in the strip side reads 120°F, about 8-12 minutes.
Remove from oven and rest 10 minutes.
Cut strip and tenderloin sections off the bone; slice each against the grain and reassemble around the bone to serve.

name: Bistro-Style Entrecote
description: French-style pan-seared boneless ribeye with a classic shallot and red wine reduction finished with butter.
ingredients: 3 tbsp cold unsalted butter cut into cubes
instructions: Pat steaks dry and season with salt and pepper. Let rest 20 minutes at room temperature.
Heat oil in a heavy skillet over high heat until smoking. Sear steaks 3-4 minutes per side for medium-rare. Rest on a plate tented with foil.
Reduce heat to medium; add shallots to the pan and cook 2 minutes until softened.
Add red wine; scrape up any fond and reduce by half.
Add beef stock and thyme; simmer until sauce is reduced by half and slightly syrupy, about 8 minutes.
Remove from heat; whisk in cold butter cubes one at a time until glossy. Discard thyme.
Plate steaks and spoon red wine sauce over; garnish with parsley.

name: Beef Bulgogi Bowl
description: Korean BBQ sirloin over steamed rice with pickled cucumbers and sesame — a satisfying weeknight bowl.
instructions: Whisk together soy sauce, sesame oil, brown sugar, garlic, ginger, grated pear, and gochujang if using.
Toss beef slices in marinade; set aside 15-20 minutes or up to overnight.
Heat vegetable oil in a wide skillet over high heat until smoking.
Cook beef in batches in a single layer, 2-3 minutes per batch, until caramelized; do not crowd the pan.
Toss sliced cucumbers with rice vinegar, sugar, and salt; rest 15 minutes for quick pickles.
Serve beef over steamed rice with pickled cucumbers and scallions.
Finish with sesame seeds and a drizzle of sesame oil.

name: Garlic Butter Steak Bites
description: Tender cubed sirloin seared in a screaming hot skillet and tossed in a garlic and herb butter sauce.
ingredients: 1.5 lbs sirloin steak cut into 1-inch cubes
instructions: Pat steak cubes dry and season with salt, pepper, and garlic powder.
Heat a large heavy skillet over the highest heat until nearly smoking; add oil.
Add steak cubes in a single layer, working in batches to avoid crowding; sear 1-2 minutes per side until deep brown crust forms. Transfer to a plate.
Reduce heat to medium; add butter and minced garlic; cook 1 minute until fragrant and golden.
Add Worcestershire sauce and fresh thyme; stir to combine.
Return steak bites to the pan; toss to coat in garlic butter. Cook 30 seconds more.
Garnish with parsley and serve immediately with crusty bread or over mashed potatoes.

name: Tri-Tip with Santa Maria Rub
description: California barbecue classic: roasted tri-tip with a bold garlic-herb dry rub and smoky char.
instructions: Mix salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, smoked paprika, oregano, and thyme to make the Santa Maria rub. Coat the tri-tip on all sides; let rest at room temperature 30 minutes or refrigerate up to overnight.
Prepare grill for two-zone fire; heat one side to high and leave the other off.
Sear tri-tip over direct heat 4-5 minutes per side until charred.
Move to indirect heat and cook, lid closed, until internal temperature reaches 130°F for medium-rare, about 25-35 minutes.
Rest on a cutting board 10 minutes.
Identify the grain direction (which changes across the tri-tip); slice against the grain into thin pieces.
Serve with grilled bread and salsa.

name: Flank Steak with Red Wine Marinade
description: Tender marinated flank steak infused with red wine, herbs, and garlic for an elegant weeknight dinner.
instructions: Combine red wine, olive oil, balsamic vinegar, garlic, rosemary, thyme, salt, and pepper in a baking dish. Add flank steak; turn to coat. Marinate at least 2 hours or overnight in the refrigerator.
Remove steak from marinade; pat very dry with paper towels. Discard marinade.
Heat a cast iron skillet or grill pan over very high heat until smoking; add oil.
Sear steak 4-6 minutes per side until nicely browned (125°F internal for medium-rare).
Transfer to a cutting board; rest 10 minutes.
Slice thinly against the grain at a sharp diagonal.
Serve with roasted vegetables or a simple green salad.

name: Pepper-Crusted Sirloin with Blue Cheese Butter
description: Coarsely crusted sirloin steaks topped with rich and pungent blue cheese compound butter for bold flavor.
instructions: Mix softened butter with blue cheese, chives, Worcestershire sauce, and garlic until well combined. Roll into a log in plastic wrap; refrigerate at least 30 minutes.
Pat steaks dry; press cracked pepper firmly onto both sides of each steak. Season with salt.
Heat oil in a cast iron skillet over high heat until smoking.
Sear steaks 3-4 minutes per side until 120-125°F internal for medium-rare.
Rest steaks 5 minutes on a cutting board.
Top each steak with a thick slice of blue cheese butter immediately before serving.
Let the butter melt over the hot steak and serve with roasted potatoes.

name: Teriyaki Flank Steak
description: Flank steak marinated in homemade teriyaki sauce then grilled and glazed until caramelized and sticky.
ingredients: 1 tbsp cornstarch mixed with 1 tbsp water
instructions: Combine soy sauce, mirin, brown sugar, sake, garlic, and ginger in a saucepan; bring to a simmer. Stir in cornstarch slurry; cook 2 minutes until thickened. Cool completely.
Reserve 1/4 cup teriyaki sauce; pour the rest over the flank steak in a zip-top bag. Marinate 2-4 hours in the refrigerator.
Remove steak from marinade; discard marinade. Pat lightly dry.
Grill or pan-sear steak over high heat 5-6 minutes per side for medium-rare, brushing with reserved sauce in the last 2 minutes to caramelize.
Rest steak 5-10 minutes.
Slice thinly against the grain.
Serve over steamed rice, garnished with scallions and sesame seeds.

name: Steak Salad with Shallot Vinaigrette
description: Seared sirloin over mixed greens with blue cheese, cherry tomatoes, and a tangy shallot vinaigrette.
instructions: Season sirloin with salt and pepper. Heat olive oil in a cast iron skillet over high heat until smoking; sear steak 4-5 minutes per side for medium-rare. Rest 8 minutes then slice thinly.
Whisk shallot, red wine vinegar, Dijon, and a pinch of sugar together; slowly whisk in olive oil to emulsify. Season with salt and pepper.
In a large bowl toss greens, cherry tomatoes, and red onion with half the vinaigrette.
Divide dressed salad among 4 plates.
Fan sliced steak over each salad.
Crumble blue cheese over the top.
Drizzle with remaining vinaigrette and serve immediately.

name: Steak with Compound Herb Butter
description: Simply seasoned grilled strip steak finished with a luxurious garlic and fresh herb compound butter.
instructions: Mix softened butter with garlic, parsley, chives, thyme, lemon zest, and cayenne until smooth. Roll into a log in plastic wrap; refrigerate until firm.
Season strip steaks generously with salt and pepper on all sides. Let rest 30 minutes at room temperature.
Heat oil in a cast iron skillet over high heat until smoking.
Sear steaks 3-4 minutes per side without moving until deeply browned.
Stand steaks on their fat caps with tongs; render the fat 1-2 minutes until golden.
Rest steaks 5 minutes.
Top each steak with a generous slice of compound butter and serve as butter melts over the hot steak.

name: Almond Butter Tofu Stir-Fry
description: Baked tofu and crisp vegetables tossed in a spicy-sweet almond butter sauce over rice.
ingredients: 14 oz extra-firm tofu pressed and cubed
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Toss tofu cubes with 1 tbsp tamari and spread on sheet; bake 25-30 minutes until golden and firm.
Whisk together almond butter, remaining tamari, maple syrup, lime juice, sesame oil, and chili garlic sauce to make sauce.
Marinate baked tofu in half the sauce for 5 minutes.
Heat a skillet over medium-high and sear tofu until caramelized, about 4 minutes; remove and set aside.
Add green beans and bell pepper to the same skillet with remaining sauce; cover and cook 4-5 minutes until tender-crisp.
Return tofu to the pan and toss everything together; serve over rice and garnish with sesame seeds.

name: Easy Vegan Ramen
description: Savory mushroom miso broth with ramen noodles crispy tofu and miso-glazed vegetables.
instructions: Heat a large pot over medium-high heat; add oil, garlic, ginger, and onion and sauté 5-8 minutes until browned at edges.
Add 1 cup broth to deglaze, scraping up browned bits.
Add remaining broth, tamari, and dried mushrooms; bring to a simmer, cover, and cook on low for at least 1 hour.
Stir in miso paste and sesame oil; taste and adjust seasoning.
Pan-fry tofu cubes in a little oil until golden on all sides, about 6 minutes; set aside.
Cook ramen noodles according to package directions; drain and divide among bowls.
Strain broth and ladle over noodles; top with tofu, bok choy, and green onion.

name: Spicy Red Lentil Curry
description: Fragrant red lentils simmered in coconut milk and red curry paste for a bold weeknight dinner.
instructions: Rinse lentils thoroughly and set aside.
Heat a large rimmed skillet over medium heat; add coconut oil, garlic, ginger, and carrots and sauté for 2 minutes.
Add curry paste and sauté for 2 more minutes stirring frequently.
Add tomato paste, broth, and water; stir to combine.
Add lentils, coconut sugar, and turmeric; stir and bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer uncovered for 20 minutes until lentils are tender, stirring often.
Stir in coconut milk, taste and adjust seasoning, and serve garnished with cilantro.

name: Easy Grillable Veggie Burgers
description: Hearty black bean and walnut patties seasoned with smoked spices and perfect for grilling.
ingredients: 1 15-oz can black beans drained and dried
2 tbsp BBQ sauce plus more if needed
instructions: Toast walnuts in a skillet over medium heat 5-7 minutes until golden; let cool.
Sauté onion in oil with salt and pepper until soft and translucent, 3-4 minutes; set aside.
Blend cooled walnuts with chili powder, cumin, paprika, salt, pepper, and coconut sugar in a food processor until a fine meal forms.
Mash black beans in a large bowl leaving some whole for texture.
Add rice, walnut spice mix, sautéed onion, panko, and BBQ sauce; mix until a moldable dough forms, adding more panko if too wet.
Form into 5 patties using a 1/2-cup measure; press to about 3/4-inch thick.
Cook on an oiled grill or skillet over medium heat 3-4 minutes per side until well browned; serve on toasted buns.

name: Roasted Buddha Bowl
description: Roasted broccoli cauliflower and crispy chickpeas drizzled with a creamy cashew-nutritional yeast dressing.
instructions: Soak cashews in water overnight or for at least 45 minutes in boiling water; drain.
Preheat oven to 400°F and line two large baking sheets with parchment paper.
Toss broccoli and cauliflower with 1 tbsp oil, salt, and pepper; spread on one sheet and roast.
Pat chickpeas dry, toss with 1 tsp oil and salt, spread on second sheet, and roast both for 25-30 minutes until golden.
Blend all dressing ingredients on high until smooth, adding more water to thin as needed.
Divide cooked quinoa into bowls; top with roasted vegetables and chickpeas.
Drizzle with cashew dressing and season to taste.

name: Homemade Vegetarian Chili
description: A thick hearty chili loaded with black beans pinto beans and vegetables with smoky spices.
ingredients: 28 oz can diced tomatoes with juices
2 15-oz cans black beans rinsed and drained
1 15-oz can pinto beans rinsed and drained
instructions: Warm olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat; add onion, bell pepper, carrots, celery, and 1/4 tsp salt and cook 7-10 minutes until softened.
Add garlic, chili powder, cumin, paprika, and oregano and cook 1 minute until fragrant.
Add diced tomatoes with juices, black and pinto beans, broth, and bay leaf; stir and bring to a simmer.
Cook uncovered at a gentle simmer for 30 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Remove bay leaf and blend 1.5 cups of chili until smooth; return to pot and stir.
Stir in cilantro and vinegar to taste; season with remaining salt.
Serve with desired garnishes such as avocado, tortilla chips, or cilantro.

name: 30-Minute Cashew Alfredo
description: Silky cashew-based Alfredo sauce tossed with pasta for a rich and indulgent vegan dinner.
ingredients: 1.25 cups raw cashews soaked 20 minutes in hot water
1 to 2 cups unsweetened plain almond milk
instructions: Soak cashews in very hot water for 20 minutes; drain.
Add drained cashews, arrowroot starch, nutritional yeast, garlic, salt, vegan parmesan, and 1 cup almond milk to a high-speed blender; blend until completely smooth.
Transfer to a rimmed skillet and cook over medium-low heat for 5 minutes, whisking frequently until thickened and bubbling.
Add more almond milk as needed to reach a pourable sauce consistency.
Cook pasta according to package directions; drain.
Toss pasta with cashew Alfredo sauce until well coated.
Serve immediately garnished with parsley and additional vegan parmesan.

name: Easy Vegan Jackfruit Tacos
description: Pulled jackfruit seasoned with smoky spices and served in warm tortillas with fresh toppings.
ingredients: 2 20-oz cans green jackfruit in water drained rinsed and chopped
instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat; sauté onion and garlic for 5 minutes until softened.
Add chopped jackfruit, broth, agave, lime juice, chili powder, paprika, and salt; stir to combine.
Cover and simmer on medium-low heat for 5 minutes until jackfruit softens.
Use a potato masher to shred the jackfruit until it has a pulled texture.
If mixture is too wet, cook uncovered a few minutes more to reduce liquid.
Warm tortillas in a dry skillet or directly over a flame until pliable.
Fill tortillas with jackfruit and top with sliced avocado, red onion, and cilantro.

name: Vegan Mac and Cheese
description: Baked pasta smothered in a creamy cashew and vegetable cheese sauce topped with crispy breadcrumbs.
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F and lightly grease a casserole dish.
Boil potato, carrot, and onion in a pot until tender, about 15 minutes; drain and reserve.
Process cashews in a food processor until fine crumbs form; add almond milk, garlic, lemon juice, salt, nutritional yeast, pepper, and mustard and blend until smooth.
Add cooked vegetables to the food processor and blend the cheese sauce until completely smooth.
Cook pasta according to package directions; drain and rinse with cold water.
Mix pasta with cheese sauce in a large bowl; scoop into casserole dish and top with breadcrumbs and paprika.
Bake at 350°F for 30 minutes; cool 10 minutes before serving.

name: Creamy Vegan Pink Pasta
description: Penne in a luscious tomato-cashew cream sauce with a silky rose-pink hue and fresh basil.
instructions: Cover cashews with water and soak while you prepare the sauce.
Cook pasta in well-salted boiling water to al dente; reserve 1/2 cup pasta water and drain.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat; sauté onion 4-5 minutes until tender.
Add garlic and red pepper flakes and cook 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add crushed tomatoes, tomato paste, and salt; simmer covered on low for 10 minutes.
Drain cashews and blend with nutritional yeast and 1 cup water until completely smooth; stir into tomato sauce.
Add pasta and reserved pasta water until sauce is thick and pourable; garnish with basil.

name: Summer Glow Buddha Bowl
description: A vibrant quinoa bowl with sautéed summer vegetables spiralized beets and a lemon-Dijon vinaigrette.
instructions: Cook quinoa in 2.25 cups water: bring to a boil, reduce heat, cover, and simmer 13-16 minutes until absorbed; fluff and season.
Shake together vinegar, lemon juice, Dijon, garlic, maple syrup, salt, pepper, and olive oil in a mason jar until emulsified; set aside.
Sauté green beans, snap peas, and zucchini in 2 tbsp olive oil over medium-high heat for about 10 minutes until tender-crisp.
Stir spinach into the skillet and cook until wilted, 2 minutes; remove from heat.
Add cooked quinoa to the skillet and toss to combine; warm through.
Portion quinoa-veggie mixture into large shallow bowls.
Top with carrot, beet, avocado, and pepitas; drizzle generously with vinaigrette.

name: Marinated Peanut Tempeh
description: Crispy oven-baked tempeh marinated in a spicy-sweet peanut and tamari sauce.
instructions: Steam tempeh in a skillet with 1 inch of water over medium heat for 10-12 minutes flipping once; rinse, pat dry, and cut into small triangles.
Whisk together chili, sesame oil, peanut butter, tamari, lime juice, and maple syrup to make marinade.
Add tempeh to marinade and toss to coat; refrigerate at least 2 hours or up to 24 hours.
Preheat oven to 375°F and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Arrange tempeh on baking sheet and bake 22-30 minutes until caramelized and deep golden brown.
Brush with any remaining marinade immediately after removing from oven.
Serve over rice garnished with cilantro.

name: Easy 1-Pot Tikka Masala
description: Warming chickpea tikka masala simmered in a spiced tomato-coconut sauce ready in one pot.
instructions: Heat a large pot over medium heat; add oil, onion, cumin, and 1/3 tsp salt and sauté 2-3 minutes.
Add garlic, ginger, bell pepper, and green chili; sauté 2-3 minutes more.
Add coriander, chili flake, turmeric, and paprika; stir and cook 3 minutes.
Add diced tomatoes, chickpeas, garam masala, coconut sugar, and remaining salt; stir to combine.
Bring to a rolling simmer, then reduce heat and cook uncovered 15-20 minutes until thick and stew-like.
Stir in coconut milk and simmer 5 more minutes; taste and adjust seasoning.
Serve over rice garnished with fresh cilantro.

name: Sesame Tempeh Bowls
description: Sticky sesame-glazed tempeh over jasmine rice with steamed broccoli for a quick meal-prep bowl.
instructions: Whisk together soy sauce, water, sesame oil, brown sugar, rice vinegar, ginger, garlic, sesame seeds, and cornstarch until smooth; set sauce aside.
Cut tempeh into 8 squares then slice each diagonally into thin triangles.
Place tempeh in a large skillet with 1/2 cup water; simmer over medium-high heat until all water evaporates, flipping a few times, about 5-8 minutes.
Reduce heat to medium and pour in sesame sauce; stir and cook 1-2 minutes until sauce thickens and coats the tempeh.
Remove from heat immediately to prevent over-thickening.
Divide rice into four bowls; top with sesame tempeh, broccoli, and green onion.
Serve warm; great for meal prep stored in the fridge up to 4 days.

name: Vegan Lentil Stew
description: A hearty one-pot lentil and potato stew with rosemary thyme and Dijon for a comforting meal.
instructions: Sauté onion and garlic in olive oil in a large pot over medium heat until softened.
Add celery and carrots and continue to cook a few minutes more while stirring.
Add potatoes, lentils, rosemary, thyme, Dijon, soy sauce, brown sugar, and vegetable broth; stir to combine.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat, cover, and simmer on low for 30 minutes stirring occasionally.
Toward the end of simmering, mash some of the potatoes as you stir to thicken the stew.
Stir in frozen peas and cook until heated through.
Taste and adjust seasoning with salt if needed; serve hot.

name: 1-Pot Black Bean Soup
description: Smoky chipotle black bean soup with vegan dark chocolate for depth ready in under 30 minutes.
ingredients: lime wedges and avocado for serving
instructions: Heat a large pot over medium heat; add oil, onion, and garlic with a pinch each of salt and pepper and sauté 4-5 minutes.
Add black beans, broth, cumin, chili powder, coriander, chipotle peppers, and dark chocolate and stir to combine.
Bring to a simmer and cook uncovered on low for 15-20 minutes letting flavors develop.
Taste and adjust seasoning adding more chipotle for heat or cumin for smokiness.
Using an immersion blender, partially blend the soup for a creamier texture while leaving some beans whole.
Serve in bowls topped with fresh lime juice, avocado, and cilantro.
Store in the fridge up to 5-7 days or freeze up to 1 month.

name: Chickpea Shakshuka
description: Spiced tomato sauce studded with chickpeas and fragrant warm spices for a satisfying one-pan meal.
ingredients: fresh lemon juice and cilantro for garnish
instructions: Heat a large rimmed skillet over medium heat; add oil, onion, bell pepper, and garlic and sauté 4-5 minutes until soft.
Add crushed tomatoes, tomato paste, coconut sugar, salt, paprika, cumin, chili powder, cinnamon, and cayenne; stir to combine.
Bring to a simmer and cook 2-3 minutes stirring frequently.
Add chickpeas and stir to incorporate; reduce heat to medium-low.
Simmer uncovered for 15-20 minutes until sauce thickens and flavors meld.
Taste and adjust seasoning as needed.
Serve directly from the skillet garnished with lemon juice and cilantro alongside crusty bread.

name: Sweet Potato Black Bean Tacos
description: Roasted sweet potato and spiced black beans in corn tortillas with a creamy avocado-pepita dip.
ingredients: 2 lbs sweet potatoes peeled and cut into 1-inch chunks
2 15-oz cans black beans rinsed and drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F; toss sweet potatoes with 2 tbsp olive oil, cayenne, and salt; roast on a parchment-lined sheet 30-40 minutes tossing halfway until caramelized.
Sauté onion in 1 tbsp oil with a pinch of salt 5-8 minutes; add cumin and chili powder and cook 30 seconds.
Add black beans and water; cover and simmer 5 minutes then mash half the beans; season with lime juice, salt, and pepper.
Toast pepitas in a dry skillet 5 minutes until fragrant; set aside a few for garnish.
Blend avocados, cilantro, jalapeño, garlic, lime juice, water, and salt until smooth; fold in most of the pepitas.
Warm tortillas in a skillet or over a flame.
Assemble tacos with black beans, sweet potatoes, and avocado-pepita dip; garnish with reserved pepitas.

name: Blissed-Out Thai Salad with Peanut Tempeh
description: A rainbow noodle salad with crunchy vegetables marinated peanut tempeh and a bold peanut dressing.
instructions: Cook rice noodles according to package instructions; rinse, drain, and set aside to cool.
Combine noodles, carrots, green onions, cilantro, mint, spinach, cabbage, and bell pepper in a large serving bowl.
Whisk together peanut butter, tamari, maple syrup, chili garlic sauce, and lime juice in a small bowl; thin with water until pourable.
Taste dressing and adjust seasoning as needed.
Add half the tempeh and half the dressing to the salad; toss gently to combine.
Top with remaining tempeh and drizzle remaining dressing over the top.
Serve immediately or store components separately for make-ahead lunches.

name: Glowing Spiced Lentil Soup
description: A golden lentil soup with coconut milk warming spices spinach and a bright squeeze of lime.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat; add onion and garlic with a pinch of salt and sauté 4-5 minutes until softened.
Stir in turmeric, cumin, cinnamon, and cardamom and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add diced tomatoes with juices, entire can of coconut milk, red lentils, broth, salt, and pepper; stir to combine.
Bring to a low boil, then reduce heat and simmer uncovered 18-22 minutes until lentils are fluffy and tender.
Turn off heat and stir in spinach until wilted.
Stir in lime juice to taste and adjust salt and pepper.
Ladle into bowls and serve with toasted bread and lime wedges.

name: Coconut Curry Vegan Ramen
description: A rich coconut curry broth with ramen noodles sautéed portobello mushrooms and fresh green onion.
instructions: Heat a large pot over medium-high; sauté sesame oil, ginger, garlic, and onion 5-8 minutes until browned at edges.
Add curry paste and sauté 1-2 minutes stirring frequently.
Add broth and coconut milk; deglaze the pan and bring to a simmer.
Cover and cook on low for at least 1 hour up to 3 hours for maximum flavor.
Just before serving, dissolve miso paste in 1/2 cup hot broth then stir back into pot.
Sauté sliced portobello mushrooms in sesame oil with tamari and maple syrup until golden, 5-7 minutes.
Divide noodles among bowls, ladle broth over top, and garnish with mushrooms and green onion.

name: Warming Chickpea Curry
description: A vindaloo-inspired chickpea curry with tomatoes bell pepper and warm whole spices over basmati rice.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat; sauté onion 2-3 minutes then add bell pepper and cook 3-4 minutes until softened.
Add garlic, ginger, and cumin seeds and sauté 1 minute until fragrant.
Add chopped tomatoes and cook 5-7 minutes until they begin to break down.
Stir in tomato paste, red pepper flakes, coriander, cinnamon, and cloves and cook 1 minute.
Add chickpeas, broth, salt, vinegar, and coconut sugar; bring to a simmer, cover, and cook on low for 20-25 minutes to thicken.
Remove lid and simmer 5-10 minutes more until thick and saucy; stir in spinach until wilted.
Serve over basmati rice garnished with coconut yogurt and cilantro.

name: Vegan Miso Mushroom Risotto
description: Creamy Arborio risotto enriched with miso butter and topped with sautéed golden mushrooms.
ingredients: 1 lb mixed mushrooms cremini shiitake oyster
2 leeks white and light green parts sliced
instructions: Cream softened vegan butter and miso together in a small bowl with a fork; set aside.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan over medium-high; add mushrooms and cook undisturbed 3-4 minutes to develop browning then stir and cook 4-5 minutes more.
Add half the garlic and thyme; season with salt and cook 2-3 minutes; stir in miso butter to coat mushrooms; set aside.
Heat remaining oil in a Dutch oven over medium; sauté leeks and remaining garlic 2-3 minutes until just softened.
Add Arborio rice and stir until grains are coated and slightly toasty, 60-90 seconds; pour in wine and stir until nearly absorbed.
Ladle warm broth into rice one cup at a time stirring every 30 seconds and allowing absorption before each addition for about 20 minutes total.
Stir in mushrooms to combine; taste for seasoning; garnish with parsley and vegan parmesan.

name: Easy Tempeh Stir-Fry
description: Browned tempeh with crisp bell pepper broccoli and carrots in a rich savory stir-fry sauce.
ingredients: 1/2 tsp vegetable bouillon dissolved in 1/2 cup boiling water
instructions: Whisk together cornstarch, bouillon water, soy sauce, sesame oil, and rice vinegar in a medium bowl until smooth; set sauce aside.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large high-sided skillet over medium-high; add tempeh in a single layer and cook 3-5 minutes per side without moving until evenly browned; remove and set aside.
Add remaining oil to the pan with bell pepper, broccoli, and carrots; stir-fry 5 minutes until tender-crisp.
Add garlic and ginger and stir-fry 2-3 minutes until fragrant.
Return tempeh to the pan; pour in stir-fry sauce and stir often until sauce thickens, about 5 minutes.
Remove from heat and garnish with green onion and sesame seeds.
Serve over cooked rice.

name: Roasted Mushrooms with Herbed Quinoa
description: Juicy oven-roasted mushrooms over fluffy quinoa tossed with lemon parsley and pepitas.
ingredients: 1.5 lbs mixed mushrooms quartered or halved
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F and line a large rimmed baking sheet with parchment paper.
Toss mushrooms with 2 tbsp olive oil and salt; spread on the baking sheet and roast 15-18 minutes tossing halfway until tender and condensed.
Meanwhile combine rinsed quinoa and water in a saucepan; bring to a boil then reduce heat and simmer 15-20 minutes until water is absorbed.
Remove quinoa from heat, cover, and let steam for 5 minutes; fluff with a fork.
Stir parsley, green onions, garlic, lemon juice, salt, olive oil, and pepper into the quinoa.
Pour quinoa into a serving bowl and top with roasted mushrooms and their juices.
Scatter pepitas over the top and finish with a light drizzle of olive oil.

name: Butternut Squash Mac and Cheese
description: Silky butternut squash cheese sauce with miso and nutritional yeast tossed with pasta.
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F; brush squash halves with oil, season with salt and pepper, and place cut-side down on a lined baking sheet; roast 35-50 minutes until fork-tender.
Let squash cool slightly then scoop out flesh; measure out 1 lightly packed cup for the sauce.
Cook pasta according to package directions; drain.

Add vegan butter, plant milk, arrowroot starch, nutritional yeast, Dijon, garlic powder, onion powder, lemon juice, miso, salt, and pepper to a blender with the 1 cup of squash; blend on high until smooth.
Return drained pasta to the pot over medium heat; pour in all the cheese sauce and stir to coat.
Cook until heated through and sauce has thickened, about 3-5 minutes; add more milk if needed.
Taste and adjust salt and pepper; chop remaining roasted squash into cubes and stir in.

name: Chunky Lentil Vegetable Soup
description: A budget-friendly lentil and black bean soup with smoky spices and hearty vegetables.
instructions: Mince garlic and dice onion; sauté in olive oil in a large pot over medium heat until onions are tender.
Slice celery and carrots; add to pot and sauté about 5 minutes more.
Add drained black beans, diced tomatoes with juices, dry lentils, cumin, oregano, smoked paprika, cayenne, and freshly cracked black pepper.
Add vegetable broth and stir to combine; increase heat to medium-high and bring to a boil.
Once boiling, turn heat to low, place lid on top, and simmer for 30 minutes.
Test lentils for tenderness; continue simmering if needed.
Taste and add salt as needed; serve hot with crusty bread.

name: BBQ Jackfruit Sandwiches
description: Shredded jackfruit cooked in tangy BBQ sauce served on buns with crisp red cabbage slaw.
ingredients: 15 oz can jackfruit drained and shredded
instructions: Using your fingers or two forks, shred the drained jackfruit and remove any tough pieces.
Heat oil in a large pan over medium-high heat; add onion and bell pepper and sauté 3-4 minutes until tender.
Add shredded jackfruit and cook for 8-10 minutes, adding BBQ sauce halfway through.
Stir and press jackfruit gently to help it absorb the sauce and develop caramelized edges.
Taste and add more BBQ sauce if desired.
Divide jackfruit mixture evenly among the four bun halves.
Top with shredded red cabbage and close the buns; serve immediately.

name: Creamy Vegan Mushroom Stroganoff
description: Hearty pasta in a creamy mushroom sauce made with coconut milk tahini and nutritional yeast.
ingredients: 2 leeks white and light green parts sliced and rinsed
1 lb mixed mushrooms cremini shiitake oyster sliced
instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high; add leeks and mushrooms spreading them out; cook undisturbed until browned, about 5 minutes then stir and cook 4-5 minutes more.
Add garlic and thyme; cook 2 minutes stirring frequently.
Set aside half the mushroom mixture for topping; keep remaining in pan.
Pour in wine and deglaze the pan with a wooden spoon; add broth whisked with flour, tamari, and Worcestershire.
Stir in coconut milk, tahini, nutritional yeast, and paprika; simmer 5 minutes until sauce thickens.
Add cooked pasta and toss to coat; taste and adjust seasoning.
Serve topped with reserved crispy mushrooms and fresh dill.

name: Vegan Black Bean Chili
description: A smoky one-pot chipotle black bean chili with fire-roasted tomatoes and bell pepper.
ingredients: avocado and tortilla chips for serving
instructions: Heat a large pot over medium heat; add oil, onion, and bell pepper and cook 4-5 minutes until softened.
Add garlic, smoked paprika, cumin, and salt; cook 1 minute until fragrant.
Add broth, fire-roasted tomatoes, chipotle peppers, adobo sauce, and drained black beans; stir well.
Bring to a gentle boil then reduce heat and cook uncovered at a gentle boil for 20-25 minutes stirring occasionally until thickened.
Taste and adjust with more salt, adobo sauce for smokiness, or chipotle for heat.
For a creamier texture, partially blend with an immersion blender.
Serve topped with diced avocado, tortilla chips, and cilantro.

name: Simple Eggplant Parmesan
description: Roasted eggplant layered with marinara and melted mozzarella for a satisfying Italian classic.
instructions: Salt eggplant slices and let sit 30 minutes then blot dry.
Coat a baking sheet with 3 tbsp olive oil and arrange eggplant in one layer; drizzle with 2 more tbsp oil.
Roast at 425°F for 20-25 minutes until browned; flip and roast 10 more minutes. Reduce oven to 375°F.
Make sauce: sauté onion in 2 tbsp olive oil 8 minutes; add garlic and pepper flakes 1 minute; add crushed tomatoes and oregano; simmer 10 minutes; stir in basil.
Spread 1/2 cup sauce in a 1.5-quart baking dish. Layer half the eggplant then more sauce; repeat with remaining eggplant and sauce.
Top with mozzarella and parmesan and bake 30 minutes until cheese is melted and bubbling.
Rest 15 minutes before serving.

name: Shakshuka
description: Eggs poached in a spiced tomato and pepper sauce and finished with crumbled feta.
ingredients: 2 jalapeño or Fresno chiles thinly sliced
instructions: Heat olive oil in a deep 12-inch skillet over medium-high.
Cook chiles and onion until soft and golden about 6 minutes.
Add garlic cumin and paprika; cook 2 more minutes.
Add tomatoes (crushed by hand) and their liquid plus 1/2 cup water.
Reduce heat to medium and simmer sauce until slightly thickened about 15 minutes; season with salt.
Make 6 divots in the sauce and crack an egg into each; cover and cook until yolks are just set about 5 minutes.
Baste whites with sauce then sprinkle with feta and parsley; serve with pita.

name: Potato and Broccolini Frittata
description: Hearty stovetop-to-broiler frittata packed with tender potatoes and broccolini and finished with parmesan.
ingredients: 1.5 lbs Yukon Gold potatoes thinly sliced
instructions: Place potatoes and broth in a 12-inch ovenproof skillet; bring to a boil and simmer 10 minutes until tender and broth is absorbed.
Add olive oil broccolini and onion; cook over medium heat 1 minute then cover and cook 3-4 minutes until broccolini is tender.
Heat broiler.
Beat eggs with half the parmesan plus salt and pepper; pour over vegetables.
Cover and cook over medium heat until eggs are mostly set about 5 minutes.
Sprinkle remaining parmesan over top; broil until golden and eggs are just set throughout about 5 minutes.
Cool slightly then slice into wedges.

name: Leek and Mushroom Quiche
description: Classic French-inspired quiche with silky leeks and earthy mushrooms baked in a buttery pastry shell.
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F.
Braise leeks in a covered saucepan with 1/2 cup water 2 tbsp butter and 1 tsp salt for 30 minutes over low heat until very tender; remove to bowl.
Melt remaining butter in pan; add mushrooms and port; cover and cook 8 minutes then uncover and boil until liquid evaporates; stir into leeks.
Beat eggs milk salt pepper and nutmeg together.
Stir leek-mushroom mixture into egg custard.
Pour into pre-baked shell; scatter Swiss cheese on top.
Bake in upper third of oven 25-30 minutes until puffed and browned; serve warm.

name: Arugula and Cremini Quiche
description: Savory quiche with wilted arugula mushrooms and creamy goat cheese in a gluten-free almond meal crust.
ingredients: 1/3 cup olive oil plus more for pan
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F; grease a 10-inch cast iron skillet.
Mix almond meal garlic thyme salt pepper olive oil and water; press into skillet up the sides.
Bake crust 15-20 minutes until golden and firm.
Sauté mushrooms in olive oil until tender; add arugula and wilt 30 seconds; transfer to plate to cool.
Whisk eggs milk salt and red pepper flakes together; stir in goat cheese and cooled vegetable mixture.
Pour into baked crust and bake 30 minutes until center is firm.
Cool 5-10 minutes before slicing and serving.

name: Halloumi Fajita Bowls
description: Roasted peppers and onions topped with baked golden halloumi over cilantro lime rice.
ingredients: 8 oz halloumi cheese sliced into 1-inch pieces
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F; line two baking sheets with parchment.
Toss peppers and onion with 1.5 tbsp olive oil chili powder cumin garlic powder salt and pepper; spread on one sheet and bake 15 minutes.
Toss halloumi with remaining olive oil; spread on second sheet and add to oven.
After 10 minutes flip halloumi and check peppers; return to oven 5 more minutes until halloumi is golden and peppers are caramelized.
Drizzle lime juice over peppers while hot.
Cook rice according to package; fluff with fork and stir in cilantro and lime juice.
Serve halloumi and peppers over cilantro rice.

name: Chopped Greek Salad
description: Crisp romaine with feta olives cucumber and tomatoes tossed in a bold Greek vinaigrette.
instructions: Combine romaine tomatoes cucumber bell pepper red onion parsley olives and feta in a large bowl.
Whisk together olive oil red wine vinegar garlic oregano honey salt and pepper until combined.
Taste dressing and adjust acidity and sweetness as needed.
Drizzle dressing over salad and toss to combine or store separately if making ahead.
Serve immediately for best texture.

name: Spinach and Ricotta Gnudi
description: Pillowy ricotta and spinach dumplings pan-browned in sage brown butter for a simple elegant dinner.
ingredients: 1/2 cup grated parmesan plus more to serve
instructions: Squeeze all excess water from thawed spinach in small fistfuls; finely chop on a cutting board.
Combine spinach ricotta egg parmesan nutmeg salt pepper and flour in a bowl; stir to form a thick dough.
Scoop into 1.5-tablespoon balls and arrange on a plate.
Bring a pot of salted water to a gentle boil; simmer gnudi in batches until they float about 3 minutes; remove with a slotted spoon.
Melt butter in a large skillet over medium heat; add sage leaves.
Add gnudi in batches and brown on both sides turning gently.
Transfer to a serving plate; drizzle with browned butter and finish with extra parmesan and black pepper.

name: Roasted Tomato Feta Orzo
description: Burst roasted cherry tomatoes tossed with herbed orzo crumbled feta and toasted nuts.
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Combine cherry tomatoes garlic thyme chili powder 1 tsp honey 3 tbsp olive oil salt and pepper in a roasting pan; roast 20-25 minutes until tomatoes burst.
Bring a large pot of salted water to boil; cook orzo until al dente and drain.
In a large bowl whisk together 4 tbsp olive oil red wine vinegar 2 tsp honey shallot and a pinch of red pepper flakes salt and pepper.
Add hot orzo and fresh herbs; toss to combine.
Add burst tomatoes with all their juices feta and toasted pine nuts; toss gently.
Serve warm or chilled.

name: Winter Squash and Spinach Pasta Bake
description: Creamy ricotta and fontina pasta bake layered with butternut squash and spinach for a hearty one-dish dinner.
ingredients: 1.25 lb butternut squash peeled and thinly sliced
8 oz dried pasta broken into pieces
instructions: Heat oven to 350°F; line a 9-inch springform pan with parchment.
Whisk egg and ricotta in a large bowl; stir in half the parmesan fontina water 2 tbsp olive oil salt nutmeg pepper and red pepper flakes.
Stir in garlic squash spinach and sage then add dry pasta and stir to coat.
Pour into prepared pan pressing into an even layer; sprinkle with remaining parmesan.
Cover tightly with foil and bake on a sheet for 1 hour.
Remove foil drizzle with remaining 1 tbsp olive oil and return to oven uncovered 30 minutes until top is crisp.
Cool 30 minutes before removing springform ring; cut into wedges and serve.

name: Pesto Pasta Genovese
description: Fresh basil pesto tossed with your favorite pasta and served with white beans cherry tomatoes and bocconcini.
ingredients: 2 oz aged parmesan plus more to serve
instructions: Bring a large pot of well-salted water to boil and cook pasta until al dente; drain.
Make pesto: grind parmesan in food processor until powdery; add garlic and pulse until chopped; add pine nuts and pulse to small pieces.
Add salt pepper and basil; run machine until finely chopped then drizzle in olive oil with machine running.
Stir in remaining parmesan; taste and season with more salt.
Transfer pasta to a large bowl and let cool slightly.
Add half the pesto and toss then add more a spoonful at a time until pasta is well coated.
Serve with white beans cherry tomatoes and bocconcini alongside with extra parmesan.

name: Four Cheese Butternut Squash Rigatoni
description: Rich butternut squash and ricotta puree with rigatoni baked under a melting gouda and fontina crust.
ingredients: 1.5 lbs butternut squash peeled and cubed
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F; toss squash shallots garlic oregano red pepper flakes oil salt and pepper on a baking sheet and roast 25 minutes until tender.
Purée roasted squash with garlic and ricotta in a blender until smooth; season with salt.
In a large oven-safe skillet bring 3 cups water to a boil; add rigatoni and cook until just al dente do not drain.
Stir in squash purée spinach sun-dried tomatoes gouda and parmesan.
Top with fontina; transfer to oven and bake 15-20 minutes until cheese is melted and bubbling.
Serve hot directly from the pan.

name: Spinach Ricotta Stuffed Shells
description: Jumbo pasta shells filled with creamy ricotta and spinach baked in marinara with pecorino on top.
ingredients: 1/4 cup grated pecorino cheese plus more
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F.
Steam spinach 1 minute until wilted; transfer to strainer squeeze dry and chop.
Cook shells in salted water 10 minutes until al dente; drain and drizzle with olive oil.
Mix spinach with ricotta pecorino garlic oregano lemon zest red pepper flakes salt and pepper.
Spread marinara over bottom of a 9x13 baking dish.
Fill each shell with ricotta mixture and arrange in dish.
Cover with foil and bake 20 minutes; serve with extra marinara and parsley.

name: Caprese Salad
description: Heirloom tomatoes fresh mozzarella and fragrant basil drizzled with olive oil and balsamic reduction.
instructions: Arrange tomato and mozzarella slices alternately on a large platter overlapping slightly.
Tuck fresh basil leaves between the slices.
Drizzle generously with olive oil and balsamic reduction.
Season with flaky sea salt and several grinds of black pepper.
Serve immediately at room temperature.

name: Palak Paneer
description: Creamy spiced spinach sauce with tender paneer cubes served over basmati rice or with naan.
instructions: Place spinach in a Dutch oven over low heat with 2 tbsp water; cover and cook until wilted 10-12 minutes; transfer to blender with onion ginger and garlic and blend until smooth.
Heat 1 tbsp ghee in the same pot; add cinnamon coriander garam masala cumin and cayenne; sauté 30-45 seconds until fragrant.
Add spinach purée and dried fenugreek; bring to a boil then reduce and simmer 5 minutes.
Remove from heat and whisk in yogurt; return to low heat and simmer.
Fold in paneer and simmer 1-2 minutes until paneer is soft; season with salt.
Top with remaining 1 tbsp ghee and serve hot with rice or naan.

name: Mushroom Risotto
description: Velvety Arborio rice cooked with sautéed mushrooms white wine and finished with butter and parmesan.
instructions: Heat 1 tbsp oil and half the butter in a large pot over high heat; sauté half the mushrooms until golden about 4 minutes; add half the garlic season with salt and pepper and cook until browned another 1.5 minutes; remove to bowl and repeat with remaining mushrooms.
Reduce heat to medium; in the same pot melt remaining butter and cook remaining garlic and onion 2 minutes until translucent.
Add wine and simmer rapidly 2 minutes until mostly evaporated.
Add rice and stir 1 minute until semi-translucent.
Add stock 1.5 cups at a time stirring occasionally until absorbed about 10 minutes total.
Stir in cream and remaining butter vigorously to make it creamy then stir in parmesan; season with salt and pepper.
Stir through half the mushrooms; serve topped with reserved mushrooms and thyme.

name: Spanakopita
description: Traditional Greek spinach and feta pie wrapped in crispy layered phyllo dough.
instructions: Place spinach in a large colander; sprinkle with salt and let sit 10 minutes; wring out in a tea towel to remove excess water.
In a large bowl combine spinach feta scallions garlic eggs dill and black pepper; mix well.
Brush a 9x13 baking dish with olive oil.
Layer 8 sheets of phyllo in the dish brushing each with olive oil.
Spread filling over phyllo in an even layer.
Top with remaining 8 sheets of phyllo brushing each layer with oil; sprinkle sesame seeds on top.
Score top with a sharp knife and bake at 375°F for 45 minutes until golden brown; cool before serving.

name: Skillet Mac and Cheese
description: Rich stovetop-to-oven mac and cheese with a three-cheese sauce and golden toasted breadcrumb crust.
instructions: Soak dry pasta in a large bowl of hot tap water for 10 minutes then drain.
Heat oven to 375°F; melt 2 tbsp butter in a 10-inch ovenproof skillet; add breadcrumbs and toast stirring until light golden; remove to a small bowl.
Melt remaining butter in the same skillet over medium-high heat; whisk in flour until smooth; add milk 1/2 cup at a time whisking after each addition.
Season with salt cayenne nutmeg and black pepper; cook stirring until simmering and slightly thickened 2-3 minutes.
Remove from heat; stir in all but 2/3 cup cheese until melted.
Add drained pasta; stir to coat; sprinkle with reserved cheese then top with toasted breadcrumbs.
Bake 30 minutes until pasta is cooked through and top is golden.

name: Paneer Tikka Masala
description: Charred marinated paneer in a rich tomato cream sauce seasoned with garam masala and kasuri methi.
instructions: Marinate paneer in yogurt red chili powder garam masala ginger-garlic paste turmeric kasuri methi oil lemon juice and salt for 20 minutes.
Grill or broil paneer on a baking tray at 430°F for 8-10 minutes turning once until golden.
Sauté onions in oil over medium heat until golden; add tomatoes cashews sugar and salt; cook until tomatoes are mushy.
Cool and blend to a smooth purée; return to pan with remaining oil and whole spices; cook 2 minutes.
Pour in purée and cook covered until thick about 10 minutes until oil surfaces.
Stir in cream and grilled paneer; simmer 2 minutes; garnish with coriander.
Serve with naan or basmati rice.

name: Baked Ziti with Ricotta
description: Tube pasta baked in a rich tomato sauce with pools of ricotta mozzarella and parmesan throughout.
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F; boil ziti in well-salted water until 2 minutes shy of al dente; drain reserving 1/2 cup pasta water.
Mix ricotta egg Italian seasoning red pepper flakes salt and pepper in a bowl; stir in 1/4 cup each mozzarella and parmesan.
Combine hot pasta with marinara; add pasta water if sauce seems thick.
Spread a thin layer of pasta in a 9x13 baking dish; dollop half the ricotta mixture over the pasta.
Add remaining pasta; dollop remaining ricotta over top.
Cover with remaining mozzarella and parmesan; cover dish with foil.
Bake covered 20 minutes then uncover and bake 15-20 minutes until cheese is golden and bubbling; rest 10 minutes before serving with basil.

name: Cheese Blintzes with Sour Cream
description: Thin crêpes filled with sweetened farmer's cheese and pan-fried to a golden crisp served with sour cream.
ingredients: 2 tbsp unsalted butter melted plus more for frying
1 lb farmer's cheese or dry ricotta
sour cream and jam to serve
instructions: Blend flour milk eggs melted butter and a pinch of salt until smooth; rest batter 30 minutes.
Cook 6-inch crêpes in a buttered pan pouring in about 3 tbsp batter per crêpe; cook until edges lift and bottom is light golden; flip 30 seconds; stack on a plate.
Beat farmer's cheese cream cheese sugar vanilla lemon zest and salt until smooth.
Place 3 tbsp filling near one edge of each crêpe; fold in sides and roll up tightly.
Melt butter in a skillet over medium heat; fry blintzes seam-side down until golden about 3 minutes per side.
Serve warm with sour cream and fruit jam.

name: Margherita Pizza
description: Hand-stretched pizza dough with San Marzano tomato sauce fresh mozzarella and basil baked at high heat.
instructions: Preheat oven with a pizza stone or cast iron skillet to 550°F for at least 45 minutes.
Season crushed tomatoes with salt.
On a floured surface stretch dough into a 12-inch round.
Spread tomato sauce over dough leaving a 1-inch border; scatter mozzarella over top and drizzle with olive oil.
Transfer pizza to hot stone or skillet.
Bake until crust is charred in spots and cheese is bubbling about 10-12 minutes.
Top with fresh basil and a pinch of flaky sea salt; serve immediately.

name: Over-the-Top Mushroom Quiche
description: Luxurious deep-dish quiche loaded with sautéed mushrooms Gruyère and a rich egg cream custard.
ingredients: 2 lbs mixed mushrooms oyster cremini button
instructions: Make pastry: mix 1 cup flour with all salt in a stand mixer; add butter until combined; add remaining flour; add ice water; wrap dough and chill at least 1 hour.
Roll dough into a 16-inch round and press into a 9-inch springform; par-bake with weights 30-40 minutes at 375°F then remove weights and bake 10-15 more minutes until richly brown; cool.
Sauté mushrooms in oil over high heat until golden; add butter shallots and thyme; cook until tender 12 minutes; cool.
Scatter 1/4 cup Gruyère and half the mushrooms in shell; blend half the milk cream and eggs with salt pepper and nutmeg; pour into shell.
Add remaining 1/4 cup Gruyère and remaining mushrooms; repeat custard with remaining milk cream and eggs; pour in.
Sprinkle top with remaining Gruyère; bake at 375°F for 1.5 hours until just set.
Cool slightly; remove springform ring and serve warm.

name: Shakshuka with Chickpeas and Kale
description: Hearty one-pan eggs poached in a smoky spiced tomato sauce with chickpeas and wilted kale.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large deep skillet over medium-high heat; cook onion until softened about 5 minutes.
Add garlic cumin paprika and harissa; cook 2 minutes until fragrant.
Pour in crushed tomatoes; stir in chickpeas; season with salt and pepper; simmer 10 minutes.
Stir in kale and cook until wilted about 3 minutes.
Make 6 wells in the sauce and crack an egg into each; cover and cook 6-8 minutes until whites are set but yolks remain runny.
Sprinkle with crumbled feta and serve straight from the pan with crusty bread.

name: Butternut Squash and Goat Cheese Tart
description: Flaky puff pastry topped with creamy goat cheese caramelized butternut squash and fresh thyme.
ingredients: 1.5 lbs butternut squash peeled and thinly sliced
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F; line a baking sheet with parchment.
Toss squash slices with olive oil thyme salt and pepper; spread on another baking sheet and roast 20 minutes until just tender.
Roll out puff pastry on prepared baking sheet and score a 1-inch border around the edge with a knife; prick inside with a fork.
Mix goat cheese cream garlic salt and pepper until smooth; spread over pastry inside the border.
Arrange roasted squash over cheese in overlapping layers; drizzle with maple syrup.
Bake 20-25 minutes until pastry is golden and puffed.
Serve warm topped with fresh arugula.

name: Greek Frittata with Feta and Olives
description: Mediterranean-style oven frittata with crumbled feta Kalamata olives roasted peppers and herbs.
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F.
Whisk eggs and milk together; season with salt and pepper.
Stir in half the feta olives roasted red pepper oregano and scallions.
Heat olive oil in a 10-inch oven-proof skillet over medium heat; swirl to coat sides.
Pour in egg mixture; cook without stirring until edges begin to set about 3-4 minutes.
Scatter remaining feta over the top; transfer to oven and bake 12-15 minutes until center is just set and edges are golden.
Finish with fresh dill; slide onto a plate and cut into wedges.

name: Tzatziki with Warm Pita
description: Thick Greek yogurt sauce with cucumber garlic fresh dill and lemon served with warm grilled pita.
instructions: Grate cucumber and squeeze out all moisture in a clean kitchen towel.
In a bowl combine Greek yogurt cucumber garlic dill lemon juice olive oil salt and pepper; stir well.
Taste and adjust seasoning; refrigerate at least 15 minutes to meld flavors.
Heat a grill pan or skillet over medium-high heat; brush pita with olive oil.
Grill pita 1-2 minutes per side until warm and lightly charred.
Transfer tzatziki to a serving bowl and drizzle with olive oil.
Serve tzatziki alongside warm pita for dipping.

name: Halloumi and Watermelon Salad
description: Salty grilled halloumi with juicy watermelon cucumber fresh mint and a honey lime dressing.
instructions: Heat a grill pan or skillet over medium-high heat; brush halloumi slices with olive oil.
Grill halloumi 2-3 minutes per side until golden grill marks form; set aside to cool slightly.
Whisk together lime juice honey red pepper flakes and olive oil until combined; season with salt and pepper.
Arrange watermelon and cucumber on a large platter.
Place grilled halloumi over the salad.
Drizzle dressing over everything and scatter fresh mint leaves on top.
Finish with flaky sea salt and serve immediately.

name: Baked Brie with Honey and Nuts
description: Whole wheel of Brie baked until molten and topped with toasted walnuts honey and fresh thyme.
ingredients: crackers or sliced baguette to serve
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F.
Place Brie on a parchment-lined baking sheet or in a small oven-safe dish; score the top rind with a knife in a crosshatch pattern.
Toast walnuts in butter in a small skillet over medium heat 2-3 minutes until fragrant and golden.
Arrange toasted walnuts over the Brie and drizzle with honey.
Sprinkle with thyme leaves flaky sea salt and red pepper flakes.
Bake 12-15 minutes until Brie is molten and soft throughout.
Serve immediately with crackers or sliced baguette for spreading.

name: Cacio e Pepe
description: Roman pasta dish with just pecorino romano parmesan and freshly cracked black pepper in a silky sauce.
ingredients: 1 tsp freshly cracked black pepper plus more to taste
instructions: Bring a pot of well-salted water to boil; cook pasta until al dente reserving 1/2 cup pasta water.
Toast cracked black pepper in a dry large skillet over medium heat until fragrant about 1 minute.
Add 2 tbsp pasta water to the skillet and let it reduce.
Add drained pasta and toss to coat in the peppery liquid.
Remove from heat and add combined cheeses a handful at a time tossing constantly and adding pasta water a splash at a time to create a creamy emulsified sauce.
Plate immediately and finish with extra grated pecorino and freshly cracked pepper.

name: Greek Sheet Pan Chicken
description: Juicy chicken thighs roasted with potatoes and asparagus in a bright lemon-garlic-oregano marinade.
ingredients: 1.5 lbs boneless skinless chicken thighs cut into 1-inch pieces
0.5 lb small yellow potatoes cut into wedges
instructions: Heat oven to 425°F conventional with rack in upper-middle position and lightly grease a rimmed baking sheet.
In a large bowl whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, salt, oregano, and pepper.
Add chicken and potatoes to the bowl and toss to coat; transfer to the prepared baking sheet.
Toss asparagus in the bowl to coat with remaining marinade and arrange in a single layer on the sheet alongside lemon wedges.
Bake 15 minutes then rotate pan 180° and switch oven to broil.
Broil 3 to 5 minutes until chicken is cooked through and vegetables have golden spots.
Remove from oven and sprinkle with parsley; squeeze charred lemon over everything before serving.

name: Sheet Pan Italian Chicken
description: Tender chicken thighs roasted with green beans, cherry tomatoes, olives, and a balsamic drizzle.
ingredients: 1.5 lbs boneless skinless chicken thighs cut into 1.5-inch cubes
1 small red onion cut into wedges
2 tbsp fresh basil or parsley minced
instructions: Heat oven to 450°F conventional with rack in the middle position.
Spread chicken, green beans, tomatoes, olives, onion, and garlic on a large rimmed baking sheet.
Sprinkle with salt and drizzle with olive oil; toss to coat and spread into a single layer.
Roast 15 to 25 minutes rotating the tray halfway through until chicken reaches 165°F and green beans are blistered.
Drizzle balsamic vinegar over everything; sprinkle fresh herbs and serve immediately.

name: Sheet Pan Cashew Chicken
description: Savory chicken and vegetables tossed in a compliant stir-fry sauce with crunchy cashews on one pan.
ingredients: 1.5 lbs boneless skinless chicken breasts cut into bite-sized pieces
2 cups sugar snap peas strings removed
instructions: Heat oven to 450°F conventional with rack in upper-middle position and lightly grease a large rimmed baking sheet.
Toss chicken with 1 tbsp arrowroot, salt, and 1 tbsp oil; transfer to sheet pan.
Toss carrots and celery with 1.5 tsp oil; add to pan and arrange in a single layer.
Bake 10 minutes until mostly cooked through.
