Whisk coconut aminos, garlic, ginger, and remaining 1 tsp arrowroot in a small bowl.
Remove pan from oven and switch to broiler; add snap peas and cashews, pour sauce over everything, and toss.
Broil on high 3 to 5 minutes until sauce thickens and snap peas are tender-crisp.
Toss to coat, garnish with scallions, and serve.

name: Egg Roll in a Bowl
description: A deconstructed egg roll with pork, napa cabbage, and umami-rich coconut aminos in one skillet.
ingredients: 2 medium carrots peeled and finely diced
0.25 lb shiitake mushrooms stemmed and sliced
instructions: In a large skillet over medium heat melt ghee and sauté carrots, shallots, and mushrooms with a pinch of salt for 3 to 5 minutes until softened.
Add garlic and ginger; stir 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add ground pork with a pinch of salt, increase heat to medium-high, and cook about 5 minutes until no longer pink.
Transfer pork with a slotted spoon to a plate, leaving liquid in the pan.
Add cabbage with a pinch of salt and sauté 3 to 5 minutes until wilted.
Return pork to the pan and stir to combine.
Season with coconut aminos, rice vinegar, and fish sauce; taste and adjust.
Remove from heat, drizzle with sesame oil, and top with scallions. Serve over cauliflower rice.

name: Spaghetti Squash Bolognese
description: Hearty meat sauce with bacon and ground beef served over tender roasted spaghetti squash strands.
ingredients: 1 large spaghetti squash halved and seeded
sea salt and black pepper to taste
fresh parsley or basil for garnish
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F and line a baking sheet with parchment. Brush squash halves with oil, season with salt and pepper, and place cut-side down.
Roast squash 20 to 25 minutes until tender when pressed.
Meanwhile heat garlic oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and sauté carrot and celery until tender, about 3 minutes.
Add bacon and cook until three-quarters done; drain excess fat if desired.
Crumble ground beef into skillet, season with salt, pepper, and oregano, and brown completely.
Stir in marinara and coconut milk if using; bring to a boil then simmer 5 to 10 minutes to thicken.
Use a fork to scrape squash strands into bowls, top with bolognese, and garnish with parsley.

name: Paleo Beef Stew
description: A rich and warming stew with tender beef chuck, mushrooms, carrots, and potatoes in savory broth.
ingredients: 2 lbs beef chuck roast cut into 2-inch cubes
sea salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Pat beef dry and season generously with salt and pepper.
Heat oil in a large stock pot over medium heat. Brown beef in batches on all sides, about 2 to 3 minutes per side; remove and set aside.
Add mushrooms to the pot and cook until browned, about 3 minutes. Add onions, carrots, and celery; cook 3 to 5 minutes.
Add garlic and cook 1 minute until fragrant.
Stir in tomato paste, broth, thyme, and bay leaves. Return beef to the pot.
Bring to a boil, reduce to a simmer, cover, and cook 40 minutes.
Add potatoes and continue simmering uncovered 20 minutes until potatoes and beef are tender.
Remove bay leaves, taste for seasoning, and serve hot.

name: Quick Beanless Chili
description: A fast stovetop ground beef chili loaded with peppers, fire-roasted tomatoes, and bold spices.
ingredients: sliced avocado and cilantro for garnish
instructions: Heat oil in a large stock pot over medium-high heat. Add ground beef with salt and pepper and cook until three-quarters browned.
Add onion and bell pepper; cook until beef is fully browned and vegetables soften.
Add jalapeños and garlic; cook 1 minute.
Add diced tomatoes, tomato paste, broth, and all spices. Stir to combine.
Bring to a boil, cover, and reduce to a simmer for 15 to 20 minutes.
Serve hot topped with sliced avocado, cilantro, and lime wedges.

name: Sausage Tomato Basil Frittata
description: A protein-packed oven frittata with Italian sausage, spinach, and sliced tomatoes on top.
ingredients: 1 lb Italian pork sausage casings removed
2 large handfuls fresh spinach roughly chopped
2 tbsp fresh basil chopped plus more for garnish
sea salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F.
Heat coconut oil in an oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat. Crumble sausage into the pan and cook, breaking up lumps, until browned.
Add spinach and stir until wilted; remove from heat. Sprinkle with basil.
Whisk eggs with onion powder and salt; pour slowly over sausage mixture in the skillet.
Top with sliced tomatoes; season with salt and pepper.
Bake 20 to 25 minutes until eggs are set and edges are golden.
Garnish with fresh basil and serve warm or at room temperature.

name: Paleo Skillet Meatballs in Marinara
description: Juicy almond-flour meatballs simmered in compliant marinara sauce for a quick weeknight dinner.
instructions: In a large bowl combine beef, pork, egg, almond flour, and seasonings. Mix gently with hands.
Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Roll meat into 1.5-inch balls and place in the pan.
Brown meatballs on all sides about 2 to 3 minutes per side.
Pour marinara over meatballs and bring to a boil.
Cover and reduce to a simmer for 5 to 8 minutes until cooked through.
Uncover and simmer an additional 10 minutes if a thicker sauce is desired.
Garnish with parsley and serve over zucchini noodles or spaghetti squash.

name: Slow Cooker Sweet Potato Chili
description: A veggie-loaded slow cooker chili with ground beef, sweet potato, and fire-roasted tomatoes.
ingredients: 1 large sweet potato peeled and diced into 0.5-inch cubes
2 cans (28 oz each) fire-roasted diced tomatoes
instructions: In a skillet over medium-high heat, brown ground beef until cooked through; drain excess fat.
Transfer browned beef to a slow cooker. Add sweet potato, onion, garlic, tomatoes, green chiles, tomato paste, spices, salt, pepper, and broth.
Stir well to combine, cover, and cook on high for 4 hours or low for 6 to 8 hours until sweet potato is tender.
Taste and adjust seasonings. Serve with cilantro, lime, or sliced avocado.

name: Whole30 Pot Roast
description: Fork-tender Dutch oven pot roast braised with potatoes, carrots, and a savory herb-mustard sauce.
ingredients: kosher salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 275°F. Pat beef dry and season generously with salt and pepper. Dust with arrowroot flour to coat.
Heat oil in a Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Sear roast until golden on all sides, about 4 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate.
Reduce heat to medium and sauté onions, carrots, celery, and garlic until onions soften, about 4 minutes.
Stir in mustard, tomato paste, paprika, bay leaves, and thyme. Add apple cider vinegar and cook until reduced by half.
Pour in 0.75 cup broth and stir. Bring to a boil. Nestle roast back in, scatter potatoes around it, and pour in remaining broth.
Cover tightly and roast 4 to 5 hours until beef is completely tender.
Rest 10 minutes before serving; season to taste.

name: Instant Pot Barbacoa Beef
description: Boldly spiced shredded beef with chipotle and cumin cooked in the Instant Pot in 90 minutes.
ingredients: 4 lbs boneless beef chuck roast cut into 5 to 6 pieces
instructions: Season beef generously with salt. Set Instant Pot to Sauté and heat oil. Sear meat in batches on all sides about 3 minutes per side; set aside.
Add onions to the pot with 1 tbsp more oil and sauté 4 minutes. Hit Cancel.
Nestle all beef back into the pot. Whisk together broth, tomato paste, vinegar, chipotle powder, cumin, garlic, and oregano; pour over meat. Add bay leaves.
Seal lid, select Manual, and set to 90 minutes.
When done, carefully quick-release pressure. Transfer meat to a rimmed pan and shred with two forks.
Serve immediately with cauliflower rice, salsa, and guacamole.

name: Whole30 Chicken Lettuce Cups
description: Savory ground chicken in a coconut aminos sauce served in crisp butter lettuce cups.
instructions: Heat avocado oil and sesame oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add shallots and bell pepper; sauté 3 minutes.
Add garlic and ground chicken, breaking up the meat. Season with salt and pepper; cook through, about 7 minutes.
Whisk together coconut aminos, rice vinegar, crushed red pepper, ginger, and arrowroot in a small bowl.
Pour sauce into the skillet along with water chestnuts, mushrooms, and green onions. Cook 3 to 5 minutes until mushrooms are tender and sauce thickens.
Serve mixture in butter lettuce cups.

name: Blackened Pan-Seared Salmon
description: Salmon fillets crusted with smoky blackened seasoning and seared to a crispy golden crust.
instructions: Combine all spices in a small bowl and stir to mix.
Evenly divide seasoning mixture among the salmon fillets and rub gently into the flesh side.
Heat avocado oil in a nonstick skillet over medium-high heat until hot but not smoking.
Place salmon flesh-side down and sear until a deep blackened crust forms, about 3 minutes.
Flip to skin side and cook until salmon flakes easily, 2 to 3 more minutes.
Serve immediately with lemon wedges.

name: Tex-Mex Sweet Potato Breakfast Hash
description: A colorful skillet breakfast hash with sweet potato, bell pepper, mushrooms, and taco-seasoned meat.
ingredients: 2 medium sweet potatoes peeled and diced
1 lb ground beef cooked with taco seasoning
instructions: Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large cast iron skillet over medium heat. Add sweet potatoes, season with salt and pepper, and sauté 10 to 15 minutes until nearly cooked through.
Add remaining 0.5 tbsp oil along with onion, bell pepper, and mushrooms. Sauté 3 minutes until tender.
Fold in spinach and cooked taco meat; cook until spinach is wilted and everything is heated through.
Season with garlic powder, cumin, salt, and pepper.
If desired, create wells and crack in eggs; cover and cook until whites are set.
Serve hot directly from the skillet.

name: Paleo Shrimp Tacos in Lettuce Cups
description: Lime-marinated roasted shrimp in butter lettuce cups drizzled with creamy avocado crema.
instructions: Combine oil, oregano, garlic, and lime zest in a bowl. Add shrimp and toss to coat. Refrigerate 30 minutes.
Make avocado crema: blend avocado, coconut milk, cilantro, lime juice, and a pinch of salt until smooth. Refrigerate until ready.
Preheat oven to 400°F. Season marinated shrimp with salt and pepper and arrange on a parchment-lined baking sheet.
Roast 6 to 8 minutes until pink and cooked through.
Combine diced onion and remaining cilantro in a small bowl.
Arrange shrimp in lettuce leaves, top with onion-cilantro mixture, drizzle with avocado crema, and serve with lime wedges.

name: Chicken Cauliflower Fried Rice
description: A satisfying grain-free fried rice with diced chicken, scrambled eggs, carrots, and coconut aminos.
ingredients: 1.5 lbs boneless skinless chicken thighs diced
instructions: Season chicken with 0.5 tsp salt and 1 tsp oil; set aside.
Heat pan over medium heat and swirl in 2 tsp oil. Pour in egg and fish sauce mixture and scramble gently into soft curds. Transfer to a plate.
Wipe skillet; add 2 tsp oil and sauté onion and carrots with a pinch of salt for 3 to 5 minutes.
Add chicken and cook stirring until cooked through. Transfer everything to a platter.
Add remaining oil to the pan, add garlic, then cauliflower rice. Cook 3 to 4 minutes until tender.
Return chicken and veggies to the pan. Add coconut aminos and white pepper; toss well.
Remove from heat, drizzle with sesame oil, and top with scallions.

name: Whole30 Beef Stew
description: A hearty whole30 beef stew with tender vegetables and a rich broth cooked on the stovetop or Instant Pot.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium-high heat. Season stew meat with salt and pepper. Add meat and cook 5 minutes until browned.
Add all remaining ingredients to the pot and stir to combine.
STOVETOP: Bring to a boil, reduce to a simmer, cover, and cook 40 minutes until veggies are tender. INSTANT POT: Select Stew and cook 35 minutes. SLOW COOKER: Cook on low 8 hours or high 4 hours.
Optional: blend 1 cup cooked potatoes with 1 cup broth and stir back in for a thicker stew.
Remove bay leaves and serve.

name: Pizza Stuffed Bell Peppers
description: Bell peppers stuffed with Italian ground beef and marinara topped with a creamy cashew drizzle.
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F. Place pepper halves face-up in a greased baking dish; pour 0.5 cup water into the bottom of the dish.
Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Sauté onion until translucent then add mushrooms until softened.
Crumble beef into the skillet, season with salt, pepper, and oregano, and brown completely. Stir in sauce and pepperoni if using; cook 1 minute.
Spoon filling into pepper halves. Bake 20 minutes until peppers are slightly tender.
Meanwhile blend cashews, lemon juice, water, garlic powder, and salt until smooth to make the cashew cream.
Remove peppers from oven, drizzle with cashew cream, and serve.

name: Whole30 Beef Tacos in Lettuce Wraps
description: Richly seasoned Instant Pot ground beef taco meat served in crisp butter lettuce leaves with avocado.
ingredients: salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Set Instant Pot to Sauté. Add beef and cook 5 minutes breaking up meat until browned. Season with salt and pepper.
Add onion, bell pepper, garlic, and jalapeño. Cook stirring until vegetables soften, about 5 minutes.
Stir in paprika, chili powder, coriander, and cumin. Add coconut aminos and crushed tomatoes; scrape up any browned bits.
Lock lid and select Meat/Stew; cook 10 minutes. Natural release 10 minutes then quick release.
Serve meat mixture in lettuce leaves topped with avocado slices and cilantro.

name: Cracklin Chicken Thighs
description: Crispy-skinned chicken thighs cooked low and slow in a cast iron skillet for maximum crunch.
ingredients: fresh thyme or parsley for garnish
instructions: Pat chicken thighs completely dry with paper towels. Season all over with salt, pepper, garlic powder, and paprika.
Place chicken skin-side down in a cold cast iron skillet. Turn heat to medium-low.
Cook undisturbed 25 to 30 minutes until skin is deeply golden and crispy, slowly rendering the fat.
Flip chicken and cook 5 to 8 more minutes until cooked through and an instant-read thermometer reads 165°F.
Transfer to a plate, rest 5 minutes, and serve with lemon wedges and fresh herbs.

name: Zucchini Noodles with Meat Sauce
description: Spiralized zucchini noodles topped with a rich ground beef and tomato meat sauce.
ingredients: salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat. Crumble in ground beef, season with salt and pepper, and cook until browned about 8 minutes.
Drain excess fat. Add onion and garlic; cook 3 minutes until softened.
Stir in marinara, basil, oregano, and red pepper flakes. Simmer uncovered 15 minutes until sauce thickens.
Meanwhile heat olive oil in a separate skillet over medium heat. Add zucchini noodles and toss 2 to 3 minutes until just tender.
Season zucchini with salt. Divide into bowls and top with meat sauce and fresh basil.

name: Chicken Vegetable Soup
description: A comforting classic chicken soup with tender thighs, potatoes, carrots, and herbed broth.
ingredients: 1.5 lbs boneless skinless chicken thighs diced into 1-inch pieces
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large stock pot over medium-high heat. Season chicken with salt and pepper, add to pot, and cook on high heat 6 minutes until browned. Remove and set aside.
Add onion, celery, carrot, and garlic to the pot. Cook 4 to 5 minutes until onion softens, scraping up browned bits.
Whisk arrowroot with 1 cup broth until dissolved; pour into pot.
Add chicken back along with remaining broth, potatoes, parsley, rosemary, and bay leaves. Stir to combine.
Bring to a simmer, cover, reduce heat to medium, and cook 30 minutes until potatoes and carrots are soft.
Discard bay leaves, taste for seasoning, and serve hot.

name: Ground Beef and Sweet Potato Skillet
description: A hearty one-pan dinner with seasoned ground beef, sweet potato, and spinach ready in 30 minutes.
ingredients: 2 medium sweet potatoes peeled and diced small
salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add sweet potatoes and cook stirring occasionally 10 to 12 minutes until golden and fork-tender. Remove and set aside.
Add ground beef to the skillet and cook breaking it up until browned. Drain excess fat if desired.
Add onion and garlic to the beef; cook 3 minutes until softened.
Season with smoked paprika, cumin, chili powder, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and pepper.
Return sweet potatoes to the skillet, stir to combine, and cook 2 minutes to heat through.
Fold in spinach until wilted. Garnish with parsley and serve.

name: Baked Chicken Thighs with Roasted Vegetables
description: Juicy oven-baked chicken thighs seasoned with herbs over a colorful medley of roasted vegetables.
ingredients: 1 medium red onion cut into wedges
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F. Toss all vegetables with 2 tbsp olive oil, garlic, salt, and pepper; spread on a large rimmed baking sheet.
Pat chicken thighs dry and rub with remaining 1 tbsp olive oil, Italian herbs, paprika, salt, and pepper.
Nestle chicken thighs among the vegetables skin-side up.
Roast 35 to 40 minutes until chicken is golden and reads 165°F and vegetables are caramelized.
Rest 5 minutes, garnish with fresh basil, and serve.

name: Paleo Shrimp Stir-Fry
description: A saucy whole30 shrimp stir-fry with snap peas, carrots, and zucchini in a coconut aminos sauce.
instructions: In a large skillet over medium heat heat 1 tbsp oil. Add garlic and ginger; cook until fragrant. Add shrimp with salt and pepper; cook 4 minutes per side until done. Remove and set aside.
Add 1 tbsp oil to the pan and sauté zucchini until fork-tender. Remove and set aside.
Add remaining 1 tbsp oil to the pan. Add onion, bell pepper, carrots, and snap peas; stir-fry 6 to 8 minutes until crisp-tender.
Whisk coconut aminos and broth together; pour into pan and stir.
Return shrimp and zucchini to the pan and cook 2 minutes until heated through and sauce thickens.
Garnish with sesame seeds and green onion; serve.

name: Turkey Stuffed Acorn Squash
description: Roasted acorn squash halves filled with seasoned ground turkey and sautéed vegetables.
ingredients: 2 medium acorn squash halved and seeded
14 oz can fire-roasted diced tomatoes drained
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F. Brush squash cut sides with 1 tbsp oil, season with salt and pepper, and place cut-side down on a baking sheet. Roast 25 to 30 minutes until tender.
Meanwhile heat remaining oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Sauté onion, bell pepper, and celery 4 minutes until softened.
Add garlic and cook 1 minute. Add ground turkey and brown breaking it up, about 8 minutes.
Season with cumin, paprika, chili powder, salt, and pepper. Stir in drained tomatoes and cook 3 minutes to combine.
Flip roasted squash halves cut-side up. Fill each half generously with turkey mixture.
Return to oven and bake 10 more minutes. Garnish with cilantro and serve.

name: Whole30 Egg and Veggie Breakfast Casserole
description: A make-ahead frittata-style casserole with eggs, sausage, and colorful vegetables perfect for meal prep.
ingredients: salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F. Grease a 9x13 baking dish with avocado oil.
Heat a large skillet over medium heat. Brown sausage breaking it up until cooked; remove with a slotted spoon and place in baking dish.
In the same skillet sauté onion in the remaining fat for 2 minutes. Add garlic and bell pepper; cook 3 minutes. Stir in spinach until wilted. Transfer to baking dish.
Whisk eggs with garlic powder, onion powder, oregano, salt, and pepper. Pour over sausage and vegetable mixture.
Bake 25 to 30 minutes until eggs are fully set and edges are golden.
Cool slightly, slice into portions, and serve. Store leftovers in the fridge up to 5 days.

name: Coconut Lime Baked Chicken
description: Tender baked chicken thighs marinated in coconut milk, lime, and garlic with a hint of ginger.
ingredients: fresh cilantro and lime wedges for serving
instructions: In a bowl whisk coconut milk, lime juice, lime zest, garlic, ginger, fish sauce, coconut aminos, turmeric, cumin, and cayenne.
Add chicken to the marinade and toss to coat. Refrigerate at least 30 minutes and up to overnight.
Preheat oven to 400°F. Transfer chicken and marinade to a baking dish in a single layer.
Bake 30 to 35 minutes until chicken reads 165°F and the sauce is bubbling.
Broil for 2 to 3 minutes to caramelize the top.
Garnish with fresh cilantro and serve with lime wedges and cauliflower rice.

name: Pumpkin Chili
description: A cozy ground beef and pork chili enriched with pumpkin puree that adds body and subtle warmth.
instructions: Heat a Dutch oven over medium-high heat and add oil. Add beef and pork, season with salt and pepper, and brown while breaking up the meat.
Once two-thirds browned add onion and bell pepper. Cook 2 minutes until beef is fully browned. Do not drain all the fat.
Add garlic and jalapeño; stir and cook 1 minute.
Lower heat and add crushed tomatoes, diced tomatoes, pumpkin puree, salt, and all spices. Stir to combine well.
Raise heat to bring to a boil then lower to a slow simmer. Cover and simmer at least 15 minutes and up to 45 minutes for deeper flavor.
Serve topped with cilantro, sliced avocado, and a squeeze of lime.

name: Spatchcock Roast Chicken
description: Butterflied whole chicken roasted at high heat for ultra-crispy skin and juicy meat in under an hour.
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°F. Place chicken breast-side down and cut along both sides of backbone with kitchen shears to remove it.
Flip chicken breast-side up and press firmly on breastbone to flatten. Pat dry with paper towels.
Mix butter, garlic, thyme, rosemary, salt, and pepper. Slide butter mixture under the skin over breasts and thighs.
Rub outside of chicken with olive oil and season with salt and pepper. Place on a rimmed baking sheet.
Roast at 450°F for 40–45 minutes until thickest part of thigh reads 160°F. Rest 10 minutes before carving.
Squeeze lemon over carved chicken before serving.

name: Classic Roast Chicken with Pan Jus
description: Timeless whole roast chicken with herb butter and a rich pan sauce made from drippings.
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F. Pat chicken dry and let sit at room temperature 30 minutes.
Mix butter, garlic, thyme, parsley, lemon zest, salt, and pepper. Slide most of the herb butter under the skin. Rub remaining on outside.
Stuff cavity with lemon halves and onion. Tie legs with twine.
Place carrots and onion in roasting pan. Set chicken on top. Roast 60–70 minutes until thigh reads 165°F.
Rest chicken 15 minutes on a cutting board.
Deglaze roasting pan with chicken stock, scraping up browned bits. Simmer 3 minutes for pan jus. Serve with carved chicken.

name: Buttermilk Fried Chicken
description: Crispy-crunchy buttermilk-brined fried chicken with a perfectly seasoned double-dredged coating.
instructions: Combine buttermilk and hot sauce in a large bowl. Add chicken, cover, and refrigerate at least 4 hours or overnight.
Mix flour, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, cayenne, salt, pepper, and baking powder in a shallow dish.
Remove chicken from marinade, letting excess drip off. Dredge in seasoned flour, pressing firmly. Dip back in remaining buttermilk then dredge again in flour.
Heat 3 inches of vegetable oil in a Dutch oven to 350°F.
Fry chicken in batches, maintaining oil at 325°F, 12–15 minutes for breasts and wings, 14–18 minutes for thighs and legs until deeply golden and 165°F internal.
Drain on wire rack and season with salt immediately.

name: Nashville Hot Chicken
description: Fiery spiced fried chicken slathered in cayenne-laced hot oil and served over white bread with pickles.
instructions: Whisk buttermilk, pickle brine, and egg together. Add chicken, cover, and marinate 2–4 hours in refrigerator.
Mix flour and salt in a shallow dish. Remove chicken from marinade and blot dry. Dredge in flour, return to marinade, then dredge again in flour. Rest on rack 15 minutes.
Melt butter and lard in a small saucepan. Add cayenne, brown sugar, paprika, and garlic powder. Stir until combined. Keep warm.
Heat vegetable oil in a cast iron skillet to 350°F. Fry chicken 10–12 minutes per side until 165°F internal.
Transfer to rack. Brush hot sauce all over each piece.
Serve chicken on slices of white bread with pickle slices.

name: Korean Fried Chicken
description: Double-fried chicken wings tossed in a sweet and spicy gochujang glaze with sesame seeds.
ingredients: 3 lbs chicken wings cut at joint
instructions: Pat wings dry. Toss in mixture of potato starch, flour, salt, and pepper. Rest on a rack for 15 minutes.
Heat oil in large pot to 325°F. Fry wings in batches 8–10 minutes until lightly golden but not fully cooked. Drain on rack.
Raise oil temperature to 400°F. Fry wings again 2–3 minutes until deep golden and very crispy.
Make glaze: combine gochujang, soy sauce, honey, rice vinegar, sesame oil, garlic, and ginger in a small saucepan. Simmer 2 minutes.
Toss hot fried wings in glaze until fully coated.
Transfer to platter, sprinkle with sesame seeds and green onions. Serve immediately.

name: Chicken Pot Pie
description: Creamy chicken and vegetable filling encased in a flaky double-crust pie shell for ultimate comfort.
ingredients: 2 lbs boneless skinless chicken breast diced
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F. Cook chicken in simmering broth until done, about 12 minutes. Remove chicken; reserve broth. Shred or dice chicken.
Melt butter in large saucepan over medium heat. Sauté onion, carrots, celery, and garlic until softened, 5–6 minutes.
Stir in flour; cook 1 minute. Gradually whisk in reserved broth and milk. Simmer until thickened, about 5 minutes.
Add peas, cooked chicken, thyme, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine.
Fit one pie crust into a 9-inch pie dish. Pour in filling. Top with second crust, crimp edges, and cut vents. Brush with egg wash.
Bake 35–40 minutes until crust is golden brown. Rest 10 minutes before serving.

name: Chicken Parmesan
description: Breaded and pan-fried chicken cutlets topped with marinara and melted mozzarella, baked to perfection.
ingredients: 2 large boneless skinless chicken breasts about 1.5 lbs
instructions: Slice chicken breasts in half horizontally to create 4 thin cutlets. Pound to 1/4-inch thickness. Season with salt and pepper.
Set up breading stations: flour in one shallow dish, beaten eggs in a second, panko mixed with Parmesan, garlic powder, and Italian seasoning in a third.
Dredge cutlets in flour, then egg, then panko-Parmesan mixture, pressing to adhere.
Heat olive oil in an oven-safe skillet over medium-high. Cook cutlets 2–3 minutes per side until golden.
Transfer to a baking dish. Spoon marinara over each cutlet. Top with mozzarella.
Bake at 400°F for 10–12 minutes until cheese is melted and bubbly. Garnish with fresh basil.

name: Chicken Marsala
description: Tender pan-seared chicken cutlets in a rich Marsala wine and mushroom cream sauce.
ingredients: 2 large boneless skinless chicken breasts about 1.5 lbs
instructions: Slice chicken breasts in half horizontally. Pound to 1/4-inch thickness. Season with salt and pepper, then dredge lightly in flour.
Heat olive oil and 1 tbsp butter in a large skillet over medium-high. Cook cutlets 2–3 minutes per side until golden. Remove to a plate.
Add remaining butter to skillet. Sauté mushrooms 4–5 minutes until browned. Add shallots and garlic; cook 1 minute.
Pour in Marsala wine, scraping up browned bits. Simmer 2 minutes. Add chicken broth; simmer another 2 minutes.
Stir in heavy cream and thyme. Simmer until sauce thickens slightly, about 3 minutes.
Return chicken to pan and warm through 2 minutes. Serve garnished with parsley.

name: Chicken Piccata
description: Thin chicken cutlets in a bright lemon-butter-caper pan sauce that comes together in under 30 minutes.
ingredients: 2 large boneless skinless chicken breasts about 1.5 lbs
instructions: Slice chicken breasts horizontally in half. Place in a zip-lock bag and pound to 1/4-inch thickness. Season with salt and pepper.
Dredge cutlets in flour, dip in egg, then press into breadcrumbs to coat.
Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high. Cook cutlets 2–3 minutes per side until golden. Transfer to a baking sheet and keep warm in 350°F oven.
Discard excess oil. Add chicken broth and lemon juice to skillet. Bring to a boil, scraping up browned bits. Simmer 2 minutes until slightly reduced.
Remove from heat. Swirl in 2 tbsp butter and capers. Taste and season.
Plate chicken, spoon sauce over top, and garnish with parsley.

name: Chicken Cacciatore
description: Rustic Italian braised chicken with tomatoes, mushrooms, peppers, and olives in a rich wine sauce.
instructions: Season chicken with salt and pepper. Heat olive oil in a large heavy pot over high heat. Sear chicken skin-side down 6 minutes until deep golden. Flip and cook 1 minute. Remove to a plate.
Reduce heat to medium. Sauté onion and rosemary 3 minutes. Add garlic, anchovies (if using), and cook 1 minute.
Add bell pepper and mushrooms; cook 5 minutes. Add tomato paste and cook 2 minutes.
Pour in red wine and simmer until reduced by 75%. Add crushed tomatoes, stock, and oregano. Stir to combine.
Return chicken skin-side up to pot. Cover and simmer 20 minutes. Remove lid, add olives, and simmer uncovered 10 minutes until sauce thickens.
Discard rosemary sprigs. Serve over mashed potatoes or polenta.

name: Butter Chicken
description: Tender yogurt-marinated chicken simmered in a velvety spiced tomato-cream sauce.
ingredients: 1.5 lbs boneless skinless chicken thighs cubed
instructions: Mix yogurt, tandoori masala, and lemon juice. Add chicken, coat well. Marinate at least 3 hours or overnight.
Heat 1 tbsp ghee in a skillet over high heat. Cook chicken 3–4 minutes per side until charred at edges. Remove and set aside.
Heat remaining ghee over medium heat. Sauté onion until golden, 8 minutes. Add garlic and ginger; cook 1 minute.
Add chili powder, coriander, and cumin; cook 1 minute. Add crushed tomatoes and simmer 10 minutes. Blend sauce smooth with an immersion blender.
Return to heat. Add cream, sugar, and salt. Simmer 5 minutes. Add cooked chicken and heat through.
Stir in garam masala. Serve over basmati rice topped with fresh cilantro.

name: Chicken Tikka Masala
description: Charred tandoori chicken in a rich, aromatic tomato-cream masala sauce — a global comfort classic.
instructions: Mix yogurt, half the garam masala, 1 tsp cumin, paprika, and turmeric. Add chicken; marinate 3 hours to overnight.
Broil marinated chicken on high, 5–6 minutes per side until charred at edges and cooked through. Cut into chunks.
Melt ghee in a large pan over medium heat. Sauté onion 8 minutes until golden. Add garlic and ginger; cook 2 minutes.
Add remaining spices and cook 1 minute. Add crushed tomatoes; simmer covered 10 minutes. Blend until smooth.
Stir in cream and sugar. Simmer 5 minutes. Add chicken chunks and remaining garam masala.
Cook 3 minutes until heated through. Serve over basmati rice with cilantro.

name: Coq au Vin
description: Classic French braised chicken with red wine, bacon, pearl onions, and earthy mushrooms.
instructions: Marinate chicken overnight in red wine with thyme, bay leaves, and garlic. Drain; reserve wine. Pat chicken dry.
Render bacon lardons in a Dutch oven over medium heat until crisp. Remove. Brown chicken on all sides in bacon fat. Remove.
Sauté pearl onions until golden. Remove. Add mushrooms; cook 5 minutes. Remove. Add garlic and tomato paste; cook 1 minute.
Add flour; stir 1 minute. Pour in reserved wine (reduced by half) and chicken broth. Bring to a simmer.
Return chicken, bacon, and onions to pot. Cover and cook in 325°F oven 45 minutes.
Add mushrooms and simmer uncovered 10 minutes to thicken sauce. Serve garnished with parsley.

name: Filipino Chicken Adobo
description: Chicken braised in soy sauce and vinegar with garlic and bay leaves until the sauce reduces to a sticky glaze.
ingredients: 3 cloves garlic minced plus 3 cloves for cooking
instructions: Combine chicken, soy sauce, vinegar, 3 minced garlic cloves, and bay leaves in a bowl. Marinate at least 20 minutes.
Heat oil in a large skillet over high heat. Remove chicken from marinade (reserve marinade); sear 1 minute per side until browned. Remove.
Sauté remaining garlic and onion in same pan 1.5 minutes.
Add reserved marinade, water, brown sugar, and peppercorns. Bring to a simmer.
Add chicken smooth-side down. Simmer uncovered 20–25 minutes, turning at 15 minutes, until sauce reduces to a thick syrupy glaze.
Serve over steamed rice, garnished with green onions.

name: Chicken and Dumplings
description: Hearty chicken soup with tender vegetables and fluffy herb-flecked dumplings cooked directly in the broth.
instructions: In a large pot over medium heat, melt butter. Whisk in 1/3 cup flour and garlic to form a roux; cook 5 minutes.
Add thyme, sage, onion, celery, and carrots. Pour in broth and season with salt and pepper. Add chicken breasts whole. Cover and simmer 20 minutes until chicken is cooked through.
Remove chicken and shred with two forks. Stir in 2 cups milk. Return shredded chicken to pot.
Make dumplings: combine 1.5 cups flour, baking powder, sage, and pepper. Add 3/4 cup milk; mix until just combined.
Drop heaping tablespoons of dumpling dough into simmering soup. Cover and cook on low heat 15–20 minutes until dumplings are cooked through and puffy.
Ladle into bowls with dumplings and garnish with thyme.

name: Thai Green Curry Chicken
description: Fragrant chicken simmered in coconut milk with green curry paste, eggplant, and Thai basil.
ingredients: 1.25 lbs boneless skinless chicken thighs sliced
instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat. Add green curry paste and cook, stirring, 2–3 minutes until fragrant and dried out.
Add chicken broth and coconut milk. Stir to dissolve paste. Add kaffir lime leaves, fish sauce, and sugar. Bring to a simmer.
Add sliced chicken thighs; stir and reduce heat to medium. Cook 7 minutes.
Add eggplant slices; cook 5 minutes until softened.
Taste and adjust seasoning with fish sauce or sugar as needed.
Add snow peas and cook 2 minutes. Stir in basil leaves and lime juice. Serve over jasmine rice.

name: Jerk Chicken
description: Boldly spiced Caribbean chicken marinated in scotch bonnet peppers and allspice, then grilled to charred perfection.
ingredients: 4 scotch bonnet or habanero peppers seeded
instructions: Blend scotch bonnets, soy sauce, brown sugar, garlic, allspice, thyme, cinnamon, nutmeg, oil, lime juice, green onions, and ginger until smooth. Reserve 3 tbsp for serving.
Score chicken pieces deeply. Rub marinade all over and into cuts. Cover and refrigerate at least 4 hours, preferably overnight.
Preheat grill to medium (350°F). Clean and lightly oil grates.
Grill chicken over medium heat, lid closed, 10–12 minutes per side. Move to indirect heat if flaring.
Cook until thickest parts register 165°F and skin is deeply charred in spots.
Rest 5 minutes. Serve with reserved jerk sauce, rice and peas, and grilled corn.

name: Chicken Shawarma
description: Middle Eastern spiced chicken thighs marinated in warm spices and served in flatbread with creamy yogurt sauce.
instructions: Combine garlic, coriander, cumin, cardamom, cayenne, paprika, salt, pepper, lemon juice, and olive oil in a zip-lock bag. Add chicken thighs; massage to coat. Marinate 3 hours to overnight.
Mix yogurt, garlic, and lemon juice for sauce. Refrigerate.
Heat a large skillet or grill pan over high heat. Cook chicken 4–5 minutes per side until nicely charred and cooked through.
Rest chicken 3 minutes, then slice thinly on a cutting board.
Warm flatbreads briefly in a dry skillet.
Spread yogurt sauce on flatbread. Top with chicken slices, lettuce, tomato, and onion. Roll up and serve.

name: Moroccan Chicken Tagine
description: Tender braised chicken with chickpeas, dried apricots, and ras el hanout in a warmly spiced North African stew.
ingredients: 1/2 cup dried apricots halved and soaked
instructions: Season chicken thighs with salt. Heat olive oil in a large wide pan over high heat. Sear chicken skin-side down 8–10 minutes until deep golden. Turn and sear flesh side 1 minute. Remove to a plate.
Reduce heat to medium. Sauté onion 3 minutes. Add garlic; cook 1 minute. Add ras el hanout, cumin, and turmeric; stir 30 seconds.
Add crushed tomatoes, broth, chickpeas, apricots, cinnamon stick, and honey. Stir and bring to a simmer.
Place chicken on top skin-side up. Cover and simmer 5 minutes.
Remove lid; simmer uncovered 20 minutes until chicken is cooked through and sauce reduces.
Stir in preserved lemon. Garnish with cilantro. Serve over couscous.

name: Lemon Herb Roast Chicken Thighs
description: Sheet-pan chicken thighs roasted with potatoes, chickpeas, and bright lemon in an oregano-scented marinade.
ingredients: 4 bone-in skin-on chicken thighs about 2.25 lbs
2 lemons one zested and juiced one thinly sliced
1 large onion halved and thinly sliced
3/4 lb Yukon Gold potatoes cut into wedges
instructions: Whisk lemon juice, half the oregano, and 1 tsp salt. Add chicken thighs and toss to coat. Marinate 20 minutes or up to overnight.
Preheat oven to 450°F.
In a 9×13-inch baking dish, combine lemon slices, olive oil, onion, garlic, remaining oregano, salt, and pepper. Add potato wedges and chickpeas; toss to coat.
Place chicken thighs on top of potato mixture, skin-side up. Drizzle skin with a little extra olive oil.
Roast 45 minutes until chicken is cooked through and skin is crisp.
Transfer chicken to a plate. Return pan to oven 10–15 minutes to further brown potatoes. Serve chicken over potato-chickpea mixture, garnished with parsley.

name: Vietnamese Chicken Pho
description: Crystal-clear aromatic chicken broth with rice noodles, tender poached chicken, and fresh herbs.
ingredients: Hoisin sauce and sriracha for serving
instructions: Char onion and ginger halves cut-side down in a dry skillet over high heat until blackened, about 4 minutes.
In a large pot, combine chicken, charred onion and ginger, star anise, cloves, cinnamon stick, and coriander seeds with 8 cups water. Bring to a simmer.
Skim foam from surface. Simmer very gently with lid ajar for 1.5 hours.
Remove chicken; let cool. Strain broth; return to pot. Season with fish sauce, sugar, and salt. The broth should be slightly salty.
Shred chicken meat from carcass; discard skin and bones. Prepare noodles per package directions; drain.
Divide noodles into bowls. Top with shredded chicken. Ladle hot broth over. Serve with bean sprouts, herbs, lime, and condiments.

name: Chicken Tortilla Soup
description: Smoky, creamy chicken soup loaded with peppers and melted cheddar, topped with crunchy tortilla chips.
ingredients: Avocado and sour cream for topping
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat. Sauté onion 5 minutes until fragrant. Add poblano, jalapeños, cumin, and taco seasoning. Cook 5 minutes.
Add chicken breasts, salsa verde, canned chiles, and broth. Season with salt and pepper. Partially cover and simmer over medium-low 20 minutes until chicken is cooked through.
Remove chicken; shred with two forks.
Microwave cream cheese 15 seconds to soften. Whisk into soup until smooth. Stir in shredded chicken and cheddar cheese.
Simmer 5 minutes until cheese is fully melted. Stir in lime juice and cilantro.
Ladle into bowls. Top with tortilla chips, avocado, and sour cream.

name: Chicken Enchiladas
description: Corn tortillas filled with seasoned shredded chicken, rolled in enchilada sauce, and baked under a blanket of melted cheese.
ingredients: Sour cream cilantro and lime for serving
instructions: Sprinkle chicken with cumin and chili powder. Heat oil in skillet over medium-high; cook chicken 5 minutes per side. Cool and shred with forks.
In same skillet, cook onion, bell pepper, and garlic until softened, 6 minutes. Combine with shredded chicken and 1 cup enchilada sauce, 1 cup cheddar, and 1 cup Jack cheese. Season with salt.
Preheat oven to 350°F. Spread 1 cup enchilada sauce in bottom of a 9×13 inch baking dish.
Warm tortillas one at a time over a gas burner or in a dry skillet. Spoon 1/3 cup filling down center of each tortilla. Roll up and place seam-side down in baking dish.
Pour remaining 1 cup enchilada sauce over top. Sprinkle with remaining cheeses.
Bake 20–25 minutes until cheese is melted and bubbly. Serve with sour cream, cilantro, and lime.

name: BBQ Chicken Thighs
description: Juicy bone-in chicken thighs grilled to perfection and glazed with smoky-sweet BBQ sauce.
ingredients: 4 large bone-in skin-on chicken thighs about 2 lbs
instructions: Pat chicken thighs dry. Rub with olive oil then season all over with garlic powder, paprika, onion powder, cayenne, salt, and pepper.
Preheat grill to medium-high (400°F). Clean and oil grates.
Place thighs skin-side down on grill. Cook 6–8 minutes until skin releases easily and is marked. Flip and cook another 6–8 minutes.
Reduce heat to medium or move to indirect heat. Brush thighs generously with BBQ sauce. Cook 2 minutes. Flip, brush again, and cook 2 minutes more.
Repeat glazing once more. Cook until thickest part registers 165°F.
Rest 5 minutes before serving with extra BBQ sauce on the side.

name: Grilled Lemon Garlic Chicken Thighs
description: Boneless chicken thighs marinated in lemon, garlic, and herbs then grilled until golden and juicy.
instructions: Whisk garlic, lemon juice, olive oil, oregano, thyme, paprika, salt, and pepper in a bowl. Add chicken thighs and toss to coat. Marinate at least 2 hours or overnight.
Preheat grill to medium-high heat (400°F). Oil the grates.
Remove chicken from marinade, letting excess drip off. Place thighs on grill.
Grill 5–7 minutes per side until cooked through (165°F internal) and nicely charred in spots.
Transfer to a plate and rest 3 minutes.
Serve garnished with parsley and lemon wedges.

name: Chicken Florentine
description: Pan-seared chicken in a creamy white wine and lemon sauce with wilted spinach and Parmesan.
ingredients: 2 large boneless skinless chicken breasts about 1.5 lbs
Salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Slice chicken breasts in half horizontally. Season with salt and pepper. Coat evenly in flour.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a skillet over medium-high. Cook chicken 4–5 minutes per side until golden and just cooked through. Remove to a plate.
Add remaining oil and butter to pan. Cook garlic and shallots 1 minute.
Add wine and cook until reduced by half. Add lemon zest and bell pepper; cook 2 minutes. Stir in cream; bring to a simmer.
Add spinach in batches, stirring until wilted. Season sauce with salt and pepper.
Return chicken to pan; simmer 3–4 minutes until heated through. Serve with freshly grated Parmesan.

name: Chicken Cordon Bleu
description: Rolled chicken breasts stuffed with ham and Swiss cheese, breaded and pan-fried to crispy golden perfection.
instructions: Slice chicken breasts in half widthwise. Pound each piece to 1/4-inch thickness. Season with salt and pepper.
Layer 1 slice ham and 1 slice Swiss cheese on each pounded piece, leaving a border. Roll tightly, folding in the sides. Secure with toothpicks.
Set up breading stations: flour, egg whisked with milk, and panko. Dredge each roll in flour, then egg wash, then panko, pressing to coat.
Heat oil in a large oven-safe skillet over medium heat. Brown chicken rolls 3–4 minutes on each side until golden all around.
Transfer to 375°F oven and bake 15–20 minutes until internal temp reaches 165°F.
For Dijon cream sauce: melt butter, whisk in flour, add broth; simmer until thick. Stir in mustard and cream. Remove toothpicks from chicken. Slice and serve with sauce.

name: Chicken Katsu
description: Japanese-style panko-breaded chicken cutlets fried until ultra-crispy and served with tonkatsu sauce.
ingredients: 2 large boneless skinless chicken breasts about 1.5 lbs
instructions: Slice chicken breasts horizontally to create 4 cutlets. Pound each to 1/4-inch thickness. Season with salt and pepper.
Set up three bowls: flour, beaten eggs, and panko. Dredge each cutlet in flour, then egg, then press firmly into panko to adhere on all sides.
Fill a large skillet with 1/3 inch of vegetable oil. Heat to 350°F (175°C).
Fry cutlets 2 pieces at a time, swirling pan for even browning, 1.5 minutes per side until set. Continue cooking, flipping occasionally, about 3 minutes more until deep golden.
Drain on a paper towel-lined rack. Season with salt immediately.
Slice katsu into strips. Serve over rice alongside shredded cabbage, lemon wedges, and tonkatsu sauce.

name: Chicken Karaage
description: Double-fried Japanese chicken thigh morsels marinated in ginger and soy, impossibly crispy outside and juicy inside.
instructions: Cut chicken thighs into 2-inch pieces. Season with salt and pepper.
Combine grated ginger, garlic, soy sauce, sake, and sesame oil in a bowl. Add chicken; toss to coat. Cover and marinate in refrigerator 30 minutes.
Heat 3–4 cups vegetable oil in a heavy pot to 325°F (160°C).
Dredge each piece of marinated chicken in flour, shake off excess, then dredge in potato starch.
First fry: in batches of 3–5 pieces, fry 90 seconds until lightly golden. Transfer to a rack. Raise oil to 350°F.
Second fry: return chicken to hot oil in batches for 45 seconds until deep golden and very crispy. Drain on rack. Serve immediately with lemon and Japanese mayo.

name: Chicken Biryani
description: Fragrant layered rice dish with spiced marinated chicken, caramelized onions, and saffron-infused basmati rice.
ingredients: Pinch saffron dissolved in 2 tbsp warm milk
instructions: Combine yogurt, tomato paste, garlic, ginger, and all spices. Add chicken; coat well. Marinate 2 hours to overnight.
Fry sliced onions in 4 tbsp oil over medium-high heat until deep golden and crisp, 20 minutes. Drain on paper towels. Reserve half for garnish.
Par-cook basmati rice in heavily salted boiling water for 5–6 minutes until 70% cooked. Drain.
In a heavy pot, place marinated chicken as the base layer. Top with half the caramelized onions, half the herbs, and all of the par-cooked rice.
Drizzle saffron milk over rice. Scatter remaining onions and herbs on top. Cover tightly and cook over low heat 35–40 minutes (dum cooking).
Serve by scooping deep to get all layers — yellow saffron rice, white rice, curry-stained rice, and chicken together.

name: Baked Chicken Nuggets
description: Crispy whole grain panko-crusted chicken nuggets baked golden without frying.
instructions: Preheat oven to 425F and spray a baking sheet with olive oil spray.
Cut chicken into bite-sized pieces.
Mix breadcrumbs, panko, Parmesan, garlic powder, paprika, and salt in a bowl.
Toss chicken pieces with olive oil to coat.
Press chicken into breadcrumb mixture to coat all sides.
Arrange on baking sheet and spray tops with olive oil spray.
Bake 8-10 minutes, flip, then bake another 4-5 minutes until golden and cooked through.

name: Sheet Pan Chicken Nuggets with Veggies
description: One-pan baked nuggets alongside colorful roasted vegetables for a balanced meal.
instructions: Preheat oven to 425F and line a large baking sheet with parchment paper.
Cut chicken into bite-sized nuggets.
Whisk egg in a bowl; mix panko with garlic powder, onion powder, salt in another bowl.
Dip chicken in egg then coat in panko mixture; place on one side of baking sheet.
Toss broccoli and peppers with olive oil and black pepper; spread on other side of baking sheet.
Spray nuggets with cooking spray.
Bake 18-20 minutes, flipping nuggets halfway, until chicken is cooked through and veggies are tender-crisp.

name: Turkey Meatballs with Hidden Vegetables
description: Tender turkey meatballs packed with grated zucchini, carrot, and spinach in marinara sauce.
instructions: Preheat oven to 375F.
Combine turkey, zucchini, carrot, spinach, egg, breadcrumbs, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and pepper in a bowl; mix until combined.
Roll into 1-inch balls and place in a 9x13 baking dish.
Pour marinara sauce over meatballs and cover dish with foil.
Bake 25-30 minutes until meatballs are cooked through.
Serve over whole wheat pasta or zucchini noodles.

name: Whole Wheat Pasta with Hidden Veggie Marinara
description: Whole wheat penne with a blended marinara sauce loaded with pureed carrots and spinach.
instructions: Cook pasta according to package directions; drain and reserve 1/4 cup pasta water.
While pasta cooks, heat olive oil in a saucepan over medium heat and sauté onion and carrot until soft, about 8 minutes.
Add garlic and spinach; cook 2 minutes until spinach wilts.
Add marinara sauce and simmer 5 minutes.
Use an immersion blender to blend sauce until smooth.
Toss pasta with veggie marinara, adding pasta water as needed for consistency.
Serve topped with Parmesan cheese.

name: Cauliflower Crust Pizza
description: Low-carb pizza with a cheesy cauliflower crust topped with marinara and melted mozzarella.
instructions: Preheat oven to 375F and line two baking sheets with parchment paper; spray with oil.
Rice cauliflower in a food processor; microwave in a bowl 5 minutes until tender.
Transfer to a clean towel and squeeze out all liquid very well.
Mix cauliflower with egg, 3/4 cup mozzarella, Parmesan, oregano, and garlic powder.
Press into four thin 7-inch rounds on prepared pans.
Bake 15 minutes, flip carefully, and bake 5-7 minutes more until golden.
Top each crust with marinara and remaining mozzarella; bake 3-4 minutes until cheese melts.

name: Whole Grain Quesadillas with Beans and Cheese
description: Crispy whole wheat tortillas filled with black beans, veggies, and melted cheese.
ingredients: 1 can (15 oz) black beans (drained and rinsed)
1 1/2 cups low-fat shredded Mexican cheese blend
instructions: Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat; sauté onion and bell pepper 5 minutes until soft.
Add beans, spinach, cumin, and chili powder; cook 2 minutes until spinach wilts.
Remove filling from skillet.
Place a tortilla in the skillet over medium-high heat; top half with cheese and filling then fold.
Cook until golden brown on one side, about 2 minutes, then flip and cook the other side.
Repeat with remaining tortillas.
Cut into wedges and serve with salsa.

name: Greek Yogurt Mac and Cheese
description: Creamy high-protein mac and cheese made with Greek yogurt and real cheddar for a healthier twist.
instructions: Cook macaroni according to package directions; drain.
In a saucepan, melt butter over medium heat; whisk in flour and cook 1 minute.
Slowly whisk in milk until smooth; cook until slightly thickened, about 3 minutes.
Remove from heat; stir in Greek yogurt, cheddar cheese, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and pepper until melted and smooth.
Toss hot pasta with cheese sauce; adjust seasoning.
Serve warm immediately.

name: Salmon Teriyaki Bites
description: Juicy bite-sized salmon cubes glazed with a simple honey-soy teriyaki sauce.
instructions: Whisk soy sauce, honey, rice vinegar, sesame oil, garlic, and ginger together in a bowl.
Add salmon cubes and marinate 15-30 minutes in the refrigerator.
Heat a nonstick skillet over medium-high heat; add salmon cubes in a single layer reserving marinade.
Cook 2-3 minutes per side until cooked through and caramelized.
Pour reserved marinade into a small pan; simmer until thickened, 2-3 minutes.
Drizzle sauce over salmon bites; garnish with sesame seeds and scallions.
Serve with steamed rice or on toothpicks as finger food.

name: Mini Whole Wheat Veggie Muffins
description: Tender bite-sized whole wheat muffins loaded with grated carrot and zucchini for little hands.
instructions: Preheat oven to 350F and spray a mini muffin tin with nonstick spray.
Whisk flour, baking soda, cinnamon, and salt in a bowl.
In another bowl, stir together butter, maple syrup, egg, and vanilla.
Add flour mixture to wet ingredients and stir just until combined.
Fold in zucchini, carrot, and raisins.
Fill mini muffin cups 3/4 full.
Bake 15-20 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean.
Cool in pan 5 minutes before removing.

name: Banana Oat Pancakes
description: Fluffy whole wheat and oat pancakes naturally sweetened with ripe bananas and cinnamon.
instructions: Mash bananas until smooth in a large bowl.
Add eggs, milk, vanilla, and melted butter to the bananas; stir to combine.
Add flour, oats, baking powder, and cinnamon; gently stir until just combined.
Heat a nonstick skillet over medium heat; melt a small bit of butter.
Pour 1/4 cup batter per pancake; cook 2-3 minutes until bubbles form on surface.
Flip and cook another 2 minutes.
Serve warm with fresh fruit or maple syrup.

name: Chicken and Veggie Skewers
description: Tender grilled chicken cubes and colorful vegetables on skewers kids love to eat.
ingredients: 1 lb boneless skinless chicken breast (cut into 1-inch cubes)
instructions: Whisk olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, oregano, salt, and pepper in a bowl.
Add chicken cubes and toss to coat; marinate 30 minutes if time allows.
Thread chicken, peppers, zucchini, and tomatoes alternately onto skewers.
Preheat grill or grill pan over medium-high heat; oil grates lightly.
Grill skewers 10-12 minutes, turning every 3-4 minutes, until chicken reaches 165F.
Serve immediately.

name: Whole Grain Pita Pizzas
description: Mini whole wheat pita pizzas with marinara and mozzarella ready in under 15 minutes.
instructions: Preheat oven to 400F and line a baking sheet with foil.
Mix marinara with garlic powder and Italian seasoning.
Spread 1/4 cup sauce on each pita.
Top each with 1/4 cup mozzarella, olives, and bell peppers.
Bake 10 minutes until cheese is melted and bubbly.
Cut into wedges and serve warm.

name: Baked Sweet Potato Fries
description: Oven-baked sweet potato sticks seasoned with garlic and paprika for a nutritious side.
ingredients: 4 medium sweet potatoes (peeled and cut into 1/4-inch sticks)
instructions: Preheat oven to 415F and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Mix salt, garlic powder, paprika, and pepper in a small bowl.
Spread sweet potatoes in a single layer on baking sheet; drizzle with olive oil and sprinkle with seasoning mix.
Toss to coat evenly.
Bake 15 minutes, flip, then bake another 10-15 minutes until crispy on edges.
Serve hot with ketchup or yogurt dip.

name: Veggie-Packed Mini Frittatas
description: Bite-sized egg muffins filled with colorful vegetables and melted cheese for easy snacking.
ingredients: 1 cup minced broccoli (or spinach or grated zucchini)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350F and spray a 12-cup mini muffin tin very well with nonstick spray.
Lightly beat eggs in a bowl.
Stir in cottage cheese, cheddar, broccoli, grated onion, Parmesan, flour, onion powder, and salt until combined.
Spoon mixture into muffin cups, filling to the brim.
Bake 18-20 minutes until firm to the touch and golden around the edges.
Let cool 5 minutes before loosening edges with a knife.
Serve warm or at room temperature.

name: Lentil Bolognese
description: Rich meat-free bolognese with green lentils and vegetables over whole wheat pasta.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat; sauté onion, carrots, and mushrooms until soft, about 8-10 minutes.
Add garlic and tomato paste; stir and cook 5 minutes until paste darkens.
Add lentils, crushed tomatoes, broth, Italian seasoning, and salt; stir to combine.
Increase heat to medium-high until nearly boiling; reduce to medium-low.
Cover and simmer 35-40 minutes until lentils are tender.
Meanwhile cook pasta according to package directions; drain.
Serve bolognese over pasta topped with Parmesan.

name: Black Bean Brownies
description: Fudgy flourless brownies made with black beans and cocoa for a secretly nutritious treat.
ingredients: 1 can (15 oz) black beans (rinsed and drained)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350F and line a 12-cup muffin tin with liners; spray inside with nonstick spray.
Blend black beans and 1 egg in a food processor until very smooth.
Add remaining eggs, maple syrup, coconut oil, and vanilla; process until smooth.
Add cocoa powder, baking powder, and salt; process once more until smooth.
Fold in 1/3 cup chocolate chips.
Divide batter evenly among muffin cups; sprinkle 2 tbsp chocolate chips on top.
Bake 25 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean.
Cool 10 minutes before removing.

name: Avocado Egg Toast Fingers
description: Fun finger-food toast strips topped with creamy avocado and a fried egg for growing kids.
instructions: Toast bread slices until golden.
Halve avocado, remove pit, and mash flesh with lime juice, garlic powder, salt, and pepper.
Spray a small skillet with nonstick spray over medium heat; fry eggs to desired doneness.
Spread avocado on toast slices.
Cut toast into finger-width strips.
Top each serving with a fried egg.
Serve immediately.

name: Mini Turkey Burger Sliders on Whole Grain Buns
description: Juicy lean ground turkey mini burgers on whole grain slider buns with kid-friendly toppings.
instructions: Mix ground turkey, breadcrumbs, egg, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and pepper in a bowl.
Form into 8 small patties about 1/2 inch thick.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat; spray with oil.
Cook patties 4-5 minutes per side until cooked through (internal temp 165F).
Add cheese in last minute of cooking.
Serve on slider buns with ketchup and lettuce.

name: Chicken and Veggie Cauliflower Fried Rice
description: Low-carb cauliflower fried rice with tender chicken, peas, carrots, and scrambled egg.
instructions: Rice cauliflower in a food processor; squeeze out excess moisture with a towel.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large wok or skillet over medium-high heat; sauté onion, garlic, and carrots until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add frozen peas and cauliflower rice; cover and cook 5 minutes until slightly tender.
Push mixture to the side; add remaining oil and scramble eggs in the center until set.
Add chicken and stir everything together.
Add soy sauce and sesame oil; toss to combine.
Garnish with scallions and serve.

name: Healthy Chicken Pot Pie with Whole Grain Crust
description: Classic comfort chicken pot pie with a tender whole wheat crust and vegetable-packed filling.
instructions: Make crust: mix WW flour and salt; cut in cold butter until pea-sized. Add ice water 1 tbsp at a time until dough comes together. Refrigerate 15 minutes.
Preheat oven to 375F. Heat oil in an oven-safe skillet; cook chicken 5 minutes until no longer pink; remove.
In same skillet, cook onion and carrots 3 minutes; stir in WW flour to coat.
Gradually whisk in broth and milk; add potatoes, peas, thyme, and salt; simmer until thickened, 5 minutes.
Stir in chicken; remove from heat.
Roll out dough and place over filling; press edges to seal and cut slits for steam. Brush with egg wash.
Bake 45-55 minutes until crust is golden.

name: Veggie-Loaded Chili
description: Mild kid-friendly turkey chili packed with beans, corn, and bell pepper.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium-high heat; brown ground turkey breaking up into pieces, about 5 minutes.
Add onion, bell pepper, and garlic; cook 4 minutes until softened.
Stir in kidney beans, black beans, diced tomatoes, corn, broth, cumin, chili powder, paprika, and salt.
Bring to a boil, reduce heat to medium-low, and simmer 20-25 minutes until flavors meld.
Taste and adjust seasoning.
Serve in bowls topped with shredded cheddar.

name: Greek Yogurt Fruit Dip with Whole Grain Crackers
description: Creamy honey-vanilla Greek yogurt dip served with fresh fruit and whole grain crackers.
ingredients: 1 cup plain whole milk Greek yogurt
2 cups assorted sliced fresh fruit (strawberries, apple, grapes)
instructions: Add Greek yogurt, almond butter, honey, and vanilla to a medium bowl.
Stir together well until smooth and creamy.
Chill in refrigerator at least 15 minutes if time allows.
Arrange sliced fruit and crackers on a platter.
Serve dip alongside fruit and crackers for dipping.

name: Apple Peanut Butter Sandwiches
description: Crisp apple rings sandwiched with creamy natural peanut butter for a fun wholesome snack.
instructions: Core apples and cut into 1/4-inch rounds.
Spread 1 tablespoon peanut butter on half the apple rounds.
Sprinkle granola and a pinch of cinnamon on the peanut butter.
Drizzle lightly with honey.
Top each with another apple round to make sandwiches.
Serve immediately.

name: Quinoa-Stuffed Bell Peppers
description: Colorful bell peppers stuffed with seasoned quinoa, black beans, and melted cheese.
instructions: Preheat oven to 425F and place pepper halves on a parchment-lined baking sheet.
Drizzle peppers with olive oil and bake 20-25 minutes until tender and slightly blistered.
Meanwhile cook quinoa in broth per package directions; fluff with a fork.
Mix quinoa with black beans, tomatoes, corn, cumin, chili powder, salt, and lime juice.
Stuff roasted pepper halves with quinoa mixture and top with cheese.
Bake another 12 minutes until cheese is golden.
Garnish with cilantro and serve.

name: Healthy Baked Fish Sticks with Whole Grain Breadcrumbs
description: Crispy oven-baked cod fish sticks coated in seasoned whole grain panko breadcrumbs.
instructions: Preheat oven to 400F; coat a large baking sheet with cooking spray.
Toast panko on the baking sheet for 2 minutes; stir and bake 2 more minutes until golden brown.
Transfer toasted panko to a bowl; mix in paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and pepper.
Pat cod dry and cut into 1-inch sticks about 3 inches long.
Whisk eggs and milk together in a shallow bowl.
Dip each fish stick in egg mixture then press into panko to coat; place on baking rack over baking sheet.
Spray tops with olive oil spray; bake 15-20 minutes until cooked through and golden.

name: Strawberry Banana Smoothie Bowl
description: Thick blended strawberry banana smoothie bowl topped with granola and fresh fruit for kids.
instructions: Place frozen strawberries, banana, Greek yogurt, almond milk, and honey in a high-powered blender.
Blend until very thick and smooth, using the tamper to help blend. Add almond milk 1 tbsp at a time if needed.
Spoon thick smoothie into two bowls.
Top each bowl with granola, fresh berries, and banana slices.
Serve immediately.

name: Whole Wheat Banana Bread
description: Moist honey-sweetened whole wheat banana bread with cinnamon that kids adore.
instructions: Preheat oven to 325F and grease a 9x5 inch loaf pan.
In a large bowl, whisk coconut oil and honey together.
Beat in eggs, then stir in mashed bananas, milk, and vanilla.
Add baking soda, salt, and cinnamon; stir to combine.
Fold in flour just until combined (a few lumps are ok).
Pour batter into loaf pan and sprinkle lightly with extra cinnamon.
Bake 55-60 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean.
Cool in pan 10 minutes then transfer to a wire rack.

name: Mini Whole Grain French Toast Sticks
description: Golden whole grain bread fingers dipped in a cinnamon egg custard and pan-toasted.
instructions: Whisk eggs, milk, honey, cinnamon, and vanilla in a shallow bowl.
Cut each bread slice into 3 finger-width sticks.
Melt butter in a large nonstick skillet over medium heat.
Dip bread sticks in egg mixture coating each side well.
Cook in batches 1.5-2 minutes per side until golden brown.
Add more butter as needed between batches.
Serve warm with maple syrup for dipping.

name: Chickpea Pasta with Veggie Sauce
description: High-protein chickpea pasta tossed with a blended tomato sauce packed with hidden vegetables.
instructions: Cook chickpea pasta per package directions; drain reserving 1/4 cup pasta water.
Heat olive oil in a saucepan over medium heat; sauté onion, carrot, and zucchini until soft, 8 minutes.
Add garlic and cook 1 minute.
Pour in crushed tomatoes and Italian seasoning; simmer 10 minutes.
Blend sauce with an immersion blender until smooth.
Toss pasta with sauce, adding pasta water to loosen if needed.
Serve topped with Parmesan and fresh basil.

name: Carrot Zucchini Muffins
description: Moist mini muffins with grated carrot and zucchini sweetened with maple syrup in a whole wheat base.
instructions: Preheat oven to 350F and spray a mini muffin pan with nonstick spray.
Whisk flour, baking soda, cinnamon, and salt in a bowl.
In a large bowl, stir together melted butter, maple syrup, egg, and vanilla.
Add flour mixture to wet ingredients and stir just until combined.
Gently fold in zucchini, carrot, and raisins.
Fill mini muffin cups about 3/4 full using a small cookie scoop.
Bake 15-20 minutes until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean.
Cool in pan 5 minutes before removing.

name: Classic Chicken Noodle Soup
description: A comforting, golden chicken broth loaded with tender shredded chicken, egg noodles, and vegetables.
ingredients: salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add onion, carrots, and celery and cook until softened, about 6 minutes. Add garlic and cook 1 minute more.
Add chicken broth, chicken thighs, bay leaf, thyme, and parsley. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 35 minutes.
Remove chicken thighs, shred the meat, and discard bones. Return shredded chicken to the pot.
Add egg noodles and cook until tender, about 8 minutes. Remove bay leaf, season with salt and pepper, and serve.

name: French Onion Soup
description: Deeply caramelized onions in a rich beef broth topped with toasted baguette and melted Gruyere cheese.
ingredients: salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Melt butter with olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Add onions and sugar, season with salt. Cook, stirring often, until deeply caramelized and golden, about 60 minutes.
Add sherry and scrape up any browned bits. Cook until reduced by half, about 2 minutes.
Add beef broth, Worcestershire, and thyme. Simmer for 20 minutes. Season with salt and pepper.
Ladle soup into oven-safe bowls. Top each with a baguette slice and a generous handful of Gruyere. Broil until cheese is bubbly and golden, 2 to 3 minutes. Serve immediately.

name: All-American Beef Stew
description: Hearty beef chuck braised with potatoes, carrots, and celery in a deeply savory red wine broth.
ingredients: 2 lbs beef chuck, cut into 1.5-inch pieces
salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Pat beef dry, season with salt and pepper, and dust with flour. Heat oil in a Dutch oven over high heat. Sear beef in batches until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes per batch. Transfer to a plate.
Reduce heat to medium. Add onion, carrots, and celery; cook 5 minutes. Add garlic and tomato paste; cook 1 minute.
Add red wine and scrape up browned bits. Simmer 2 minutes. Add broth, Worcestershire, thyme, bay leaves, and seared beef. Bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer 1 hour. Add potatoes and cook until tender, about 30 minutes more. Remove bay leaves, season to taste, and serve.

name: Tomato Basil Soup
description: Velvety roasted tomato soup blended smooth with fresh basil and a swirl of cream.
ingredients: salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F. Toss tomatoes, onion, and garlic with 2 tbsp olive oil on a baking sheet. Roast until caramelized, about 25 minutes. Squeeze garlic from skins.
Transfer roasted vegetables to a large pot. Add broth and bring to a simmer over medium heat for 10 minutes.
Add basil and blend with an immersion blender until smooth. Stir in heavy cream and sugar. Season with salt and pepper.
Serve hot with crusty bread or a grilled cheese sandwich.

name: Chili Con Carne
description: Bold and smoky ground beef chili with dried chiles, kidney beans, and deep Tex-Mex spices.
ingredients: 2 cans (15 oz each) kidney beans, drained
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium-high heat. Add onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes. Add garlic and cook 1 minute.
Add ground beef and cook, breaking it up, until browned. Drain excess fat.
Stir in chili powder, cumin, paprika, oregano, and cayenne. Cook for 1 minute. Add tomatoes, broth, and kidney beans.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer uncovered for 45 minutes, stirring occasionally, until thickened. Season with salt and serve with sour cream, cheddar, and scallions.

name: White Chicken Chili
description: Creamy and mildly spiced white bean chicken chili with green chiles, cumin, and Monterey Jack.
ingredients: 2 cans (15 oz each) white cannellini beans, drained
2 cans (4 oz each) diced green chiles
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add onion and cook 5 minutes. Add garlic, cumin, oregano, and chili powder; cook 1 minute.
Add chicken breasts, broth, beans, and green chiles. Bring to a boil, then simmer 20 minutes until chicken is cooked through.
Remove chicken and shred with two forks. Return to pot.
Stir in cream cheese and sour cream until melted and smooth. Season with salt and pepper. Serve with lime wedges, cilantro, and tortilla chips.

name: Classic Minestrone
description: A hearty Italian vegetable soup brimming with beans, seasonal vegetables, pasta, and fresh herbs.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add onion, carrots, and celery; cook 8 minutes until softened. Add garlic, oregano, and basil; cook 1 minute.
Stir in diced tomatoes, broth, water, and kidney beans. Bring to a boil, then simmer covered for 20 minutes.
Add zucchini and ditalini pasta. Cook uncovered, stirring occasionally, for 10 minutes until pasta is al dente.
Season with salt and pepper. Serve topped with grated Parmesan.

name: Italian Wedding Soup
description: Savory chicken broth with tender pork and beef mini-meatballs, orzo pasta, and wilted spinach.
instructions: Mix ground pork, beef, breadcrumbs, egg, Parmesan, garlic, Italian seasoning, salt, and pepper in a bowl. Roll into 1-inch meatballs and place on a baking sheet. Bake at 375°F for 15 minutes.
Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add onion and carrots; cook 6 minutes until softened.
Pour in chicken broth and bring to a boil. Add orzo and cook for 8 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add meatballs and spinach. Simmer 3 minutes until spinach is wilted. Season with salt and pepper. Serve with extra Parmesan.

name: Pasta e Fagioli
description: Classic Italian pasta and bean soup with a rich tomato base, rosemary, and a drizzle of olive oil.
ingredients: 2 cans (15 oz each) cannellini beans, drained
salt and red pepper flakes to taste
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add onion, celery, and carrots; cook 8 minutes until soft. Add garlic and rosemary; cook 1 minute.
Add crushed tomatoes, broth, and one can of beans. Mash the other can of beans roughly with a fork and add to pot. Bring to a simmer.
Cook covered for 20 minutes. Remove rosemary sprigs. Add ditalini pasta and cook 10 minutes until al dente.
Season with salt and red pepper flakes. Ladle into bowls, drizzle with olive oil, and top with Parmesan.

name: Tuscan White Bean Soup
description: A Ribollita-inspired Tuscan soup with cannellini beans, kale, Italian sausage, and sun-dried tomatoes.
ingredients: 1 lb Italian sausage, removed from casing
2 cans (15 oz each) cannellini beans, drained
3 cups kale, stems removed, roughly chopped
1/3 cup sun-dried tomatoes in oil, chopped
instructions: Heat sun-dried tomato oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Add sausage and onion; cook, breaking up meat, until browned, about 6 minutes.
Add garlic, shallots, carrots, celery, and Italian seasoning. Cook 5 minutes until vegetables begin to soften.
Add broth and simmer for 10 minutes. Stir in kale, sun-dried tomatoes, and cannellini beans. Simmer 5 more minutes.
Stir in heavy cream and Parmesan. Season with salt and pepper. Serve with crusty bread.

name: Corn Chowder with Bacon
description: Thick, creamy corn chowder with smoky bacon, Yukon gold potatoes, and sweet summer corn.
ingredients: 6 ears fresh corn, kernels cut off (or 4 cups frozen corn)
instructions: Cook bacon in a large pot over medium heat until crispy. Remove with a slotted spoon and set aside, leaving fat in pot.
Add butter, onion, and garlic to pot; cook 5 minutes. Add flour and stir to coat.
Pour in broth, milk, potatoes, paprika, and thyme. Bring to a boil, then simmer 15 minutes until potatoes are tender.
Add corn and heavy cream. Simmer 5 minutes. Using an immersion blender, partially blend for a creamy but chunky texture. Season with salt and pepper. Serve topped with bacon and green onions.

name: Broccoli Cheddar Soup
description: Velvety cheddar soup with roasted broccoli and a rich, cheesy base that tastes deeply of broccoli.
ingredients: 1 large head broccoli (about 1.5 lbs), cut into florets
salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F. Toss half the broccoli florets with 1 tbsp olive oil, salt, and pepper on a baking sheet. Roast 15 minutes until browned.
Melt butter in a large pot over medium heat. Add onion and cook 5 minutes. Add garlic and flour; stir 1 minute. Gradually whisk in broth, then milk.
Add the remaining raw broccoli to the pot. Simmer 12 minutes until tender. Blend until smooth with immersion blender.
Stir in heavy cream and cheddar until melted and smooth. Season with nutmeg, salt, and pepper. Top with roasted broccoli and serve.

name: Butternut Squash Soup
description: Silky roasted butternut squash soup with warming spices, apple, and a touch of cream.
ingredients: 1 large butternut squash (about 3 lbs), peeled and cubed
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F. Toss squash and apple with 2 tbsp olive oil, salt, and pepper. Roast for 25 minutes until caramelized and tender.
Heat remaining olive oil in a large pot. Add onion and cook 5 minutes. Add garlic, cinnamon, nutmeg, and ginger; cook 1 minute.
Add broth and roasted squash and apple. Bring to a simmer and cook for 10 minutes.
Blend until smooth with an immersion blender. Stir in heavy cream and maple syrup. Season and serve with a swirl of cream and pumpkin seeds.

name: Split Pea and Ham Soup
description: Hearty, thick green split pea soup cooked with a smoky ham hock and aromatic vegetables.
ingredients: 1 lb dried green split peas, rinsed
salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add onion, carrots, and celery; cook 6 minutes. Add garlic and thyme; cook 1 minute.
Add split peas, ham hock, broth, and bay leaves. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to a bare simmer. Cover and cook 60 minutes, stirring occasionally, until peas break down completely.
Remove ham hock; strip meat from bone and chop. Remove bay leaves. Add chopped ham back to pot along with the diced ham.
Season with salt and pepper. Serve hot with crusty bread.

name: Red Lentil Soup
description: A warming, spiced red lentil soup with cumin, turmeric, and a bright lemon finish.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add onion and carrots; cook 6 minutes. Add garlic, cumin, turmeric, paprika, and cayenne; stir 1 minute until fragrant.
Add lentils, diced tomatoes, and broth. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer uncovered for 20 minutes until lentils are completely soft.
Use an immersion blender to partially blend the soup for a creamy yet textured consistency.
Stir in lemon juice, season with salt and pepper, and serve drizzled with olive oil.

name: Spiced Black Bean Soup
description: Smoky, earthy black bean soup seasoned with cumin and chipotle, finished with lime and cilantro.
ingredients: 3 cans (15 oz each) black beans, drained
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add onion, jalapeño, and a pinch of salt. Cook until softened, about 8 minutes. Add garlic, cumin, paprika, and chipotle; cook 1 minute.
Add black beans and broth. Bring to a boil, then simmer for 20 minutes.
Transfer about half the soup to a blender and puree until smooth, then return to pot (or use immersion blender partially).
Stir in lime juice and cilantro. Season with salt. Serve with sour cream, avocado, and warm tortillas.

name: Homemade Miso Soup
description: Traditional Japanese miso soup with dashi broth, silken tofu, wakame seaweed, and scallions.
ingredients: 4 cups dashi stock (or water with 1 tbsp dashi powder)
6 oz silken tofu, cut into small cubes
instructions: Soak wakame in cold water for 5 minutes, then drain and gently squeeze out excess water.
Bring dashi to a gentle simmer in a medium saucepan over medium heat. Do not boil.
Place miso paste in a small bowl, ladle some hot dashi over it, and whisk until dissolved. Stir miso mixture back into the pot.
Add tofu and wakame; heat gently for 2 minutes. Do not boil after adding miso. Divide into bowls and garnish with green onions and sesame oil.

name: Tonkotsu Ramen Broth
description: Rich, cloudy pork bone broth for ramen, served with noodles, chashu pork, and a soft-boiled egg.
instructions: Blanch pork bones in boiling water for 5 minutes, drain, and rinse. Return to pot, cover with cold water, add ginger and garlic. Boil vigorously for 3 to 4 hours until broth is milky white and rich.
Roll pork belly tightly, tie with twine, and braise in soy sauce, mirin, sake, and 1 cup water for 2 hours until tender. Cool and slice into rounds.
Soft-boil eggs for 7 minutes, shock in ice water, peel, and marinate in leftover chashu braising liquid for 4 hours.
Cook ramen noodles per package. Divide broth into bowls, add noodles, sliced chashu, halved eggs, nori, green onions, sesame seeds, and sesame oil.

name: Hot and Sour Soup
description: Classic Chinese hot and sour soup with wood ear mushrooms, tofu, bamboo shoots, and silky egg ribbons.
ingredients: 6 oz firm tofu, cut into thin strips
3 tbsp cornstarch mixed with 3 tbsp water
1/2 cup rehydrated wood ear mushrooms, sliced
instructions: Bring broth to a simmer in a large pot over medium heat. Add soy sauce, sugar, and white pepper.
Add shiitake mushrooms, wood ear mushrooms, bamboo shoots, and tofu. Simmer 5 minutes.
Stir in cornstarch slurry and cook until broth thickens, about 2 minutes. Reduce heat to low.
Add rice vinegar and sesame oil. Slowly pour beaten eggs into soup in a thin stream while stirring gently to form egg ribbons. Serve garnished with green onions.

name: Tom Yum Goong
description: Fragrant Thai hot and sour prawn soup with lemongrass, kaffir lime, galangal, and chili.
ingredients: 1 lb large shrimp, peeled and deveined
2 stalks lemongrass, bruised and cut into pieces
instructions: Bring broth to a boil in a large pot. Add lemongrass, kaffir lime leaves, galangal, and Thai chiles. Simmer 5 minutes to infuse.
Add mushrooms and simmer 3 minutes. Add shrimp and cook just until pink, about 2 minutes.
Season with fish sauce, lime juice, and sugar. Adjust to your taste — it should be hot, sour, and savory.
Ladle into bowls, garnish with green onions and cilantro, and serve with steamed rice.

name: Andalusian Gazpacho
description: Chilled Spanish tomato soup blended with cucumber, bell pepper, garlic, and sherry vinegar.
ingredients: 2 lbs ripe tomatoes, cored and roughly chopped
1 red bell pepper, cored and seeded
2 slices stale white bread, crusts removed
instructions: Soak bread in cold water for 5 minutes, then squeeze dry.
Combine tomatoes, cucumber, bell pepper, bread, and garlic in a blender. Blend until smooth.
With the blender running, drizzle in olive oil. Add sherry vinegar, salt, and sugar. Blend until completely smooth and emulsified.
Add cold water to adjust consistency. Season to taste, then refrigerate for at least 2 hours until very cold. Serve in chilled bowls with a drizzle of olive oil.

name: Vichyssoise
description: A classic French cold cream soup made with sautéed leeks and potatoes, served chilled.
