name: Classic American Potato Salad
description: Creamy old-fashioned potato salad with hard-boiled eggs, dill pickles and a tangy mayo dressing.
ingredients: 3 lb Yukon Gold potatoes cut into 1-inch chunks
1/4 cup fresh dill and parsley chopped
instructions: Boil potato chunks in well-salted water until just fork-tender, 12-15 minutes. Drain; return to pot and let steam dry 2 minutes. Transfer to a large bowl.
Separate egg yolks from whites. In a bowl, mash yolks with mayonnaise, sour cream, mustard, pickle juice, salt and pepper until smooth.
Chop egg whites and add to bowl with potatoes along with celery, red onion, pickles and half the herbs.
Pour dressing over and gently fold to combine keeping some potato chunks intact. Taste and adjust seasoning.
Sprinkle with remaining fresh herbs and a dusting of smoked paprika. Refrigerate at least 2 hours before serving.

name: Classic Peach Cobbler
description: Golden crispy-topped peach cobbler with a sweet biscuit batter baked right over the fruit.
ingredients: 4.5 lb fresh ripe peaches pitted and cut into chunks
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F. Line a rimmed baking sheet with foil. Place peaches in a 9x13-inch baking dish; toss with lemon zest and juice.
Beat butter and 1 cup sugar until sandy. Add flour, baking powder and salt; beat until combined. Mix in milk on low for 2 minutes until light.
Drop batter in large blobs over peaches; spread evenly to about 1/2-inch thick. Sprinkle remaining 1/2 cup sugar evenly over batter.
Drizzle hot water evenly over the sugared batter (this creates the crackly crust).
Place dish on foil-lined baking sheet to catch drips. Bake 60-70 minutes until top is cracked and golden and a toothpick comes out clean.
Let cool at least 30 minutes before serving. Drizzle cream over each serving.

name: Mardi Gras Jambalaya
description: A festive one-pot Cajun jambalaya with andouille sausage, chicken and shrimp for a crowd.
ingredients: 1.5 lb boneless chicken thighs cut into 1-inch pieces
1 lb large shrimp peeled and deveined
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F. Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Sear sausage slices until browned, 3 minutes; remove. Brown chicken until golden; remove. Sear shrimp 1.5 minutes per side; set aside separately.
Add butter, onion, bell pepper, celery and garlic; cook 3-4 minutes until softened.
Add rice; stir to coat grains in oil, 1-2 minutes. Add broth, tomatoes, tomato paste, paprika, thyme, cayenne and sausage and chicken. Stir well; bring to a boil.
Cover and transfer to oven; bake 25-30 minutes until rice is just cooked.
Add shrimp and green onions; quickly stir through; cover and return to oven 3 minutes until shrimp are just pink.
Fluff gently; taste and adjust seasoning. Serve immediately.

name: St. Patrick's Day Corned Beef and Cabbage
description: Classic Irish-American boiled corned beef with cabbage, potatoes and carrots in a savory broth.
ingredients: 4 lb flat-cut corned beef brisket with spice packet
1 small head green cabbage cut into wedges
6 medium carrots peeled and cut into chunks
Dijon mustard or horseradish for serving
instructions: Place corned beef fat-side up in a large Dutch oven. Sprinkle over spice packet contents and add bay leaf. Add onion. Cover with water until just submerged. Bring to a boil, skim any foam, reduce heat and cover. Simmer gently for 3 hours until fork-tender.
Transfer beef to a cutting board; tent with foil. Bring braising liquid to a boil.
Add potatoes and carrots to the boiling liquid; cook covered 10 minutes. Add cabbage wedges; cover and cook 10 more minutes until vegetables are fork-tender.
Drain vegetables; toss potatoes and carrots with butter, salt, pepper and parsley.
Slice corned beef against the grain into thin slices. Serve with vegetables, some braising liquid ladled over top and Dijon mustard.

name: St. Patrick's Day Shepherd's Pie
description: Hearty Irish shepherd's pie with a savory ground lamb filling and creamy mashed potato topping.
ingredients: 3 lb Yukon Gold potatoes peeled and quartered
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F. Cook potatoes in boiling salted water until tender, 15 minutes. Drain; mash with butter, warm milk, salt and pepper until smooth. Set aside.
Brown lamb in a large oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat, breaking up with a spoon, 8 minutes. Drain excess fat. Add onion, carrots and celery; cook 5 minutes. Add garlic; cook 1 minute.
Stir in tomato paste; cook until darkened, 2 minutes. Add Worcestershire, broth, thyme and rosemary. Simmer 5 minutes until slightly thickened. Stir in peas. Season with salt and pepper.
Dollop mashed potatoes evenly over filling; spread into a uniform layer. Run a fork over the surface to create ridges.
Bake 25-30 minutes until filling is bubbling. Broil 2 minutes until top begins to brown. Rest 10 minutes before serving.

name: Mother's Day Brunch Quiche
description: A classic quiche Lorraine with caramelized leeks, ham and Swiss cheese in a buttery pastry shell.
ingredients: 3/4 cup diced leeks white and light green parts
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F. Sauté leeks in olive oil over low heat 25-30 minutes until caramelized; let cool.
Refrigerate pie shell 30 minutes. Spread leeks over the base; scatter ham and Swiss cheese on top.
Whisk eggs, heavy cream and sour cream until smooth; season with nutmeg, salt and pepper. Pour into pie shell.
Place on a baking sheet. Bake until puffed and golden, 25-35 minutes. A knife inserted near center should come out mostly clean.
Cool on a rack 10 minutes. Slice and serve warm or at room temperature.

name: Cinco de Mayo Carnitas Tacos
description: Slow-braised crispy pork carnitas in corn tortillas with roasted jalapeño avocado for a crowd.
ingredients: 3 lb boneless pork shoulder cut into 3-inch pieces
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°F. Arrange pork in a large Dutch oven. Add garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, cumin, oregano and salt; rub all over pork. Pour over orange juice, lime juice and water.
Cover and roast for 2.5-3 hours until very tender and falling apart.
Increase oven to 425°F. Uncover and roast 10 more minutes until pork is deeply caramelized on top. Remove pork and shred with two forks.
Char or roast jalapeños over open flame or under broiler until blackened. Remove some charred skin; finely chop. Mash with avocado, cilantro and a pinch of salt.
Warm corn tortillas in a dry skillet or microwave. Fill each with carnitas and top with jalapeño avocado and cilantro. Serve with lime wedges.

name: Classic Buffalo Wings
description: Crispy baked chicken wings tossed in buttery Frank's RedHot sauce with blue cheese dip on the side.
ingredients: 4 lbs chicken wings drumettes and flats
instructions: Pat wings dry and toss with baking powder and salt in a zip-top bag.
Spread on a wire rack over a foil-lined baking sheet and refrigerate uncovered 8 hours or overnight.
Preheat oven to 250°F. Bake wings on lower rack 30 minutes.
Increase oven to 425°F and move wings to upper rack. Bake 40-50 minutes, rotating halfway, until skin is very crispy and deep golden.
Whisk together melted butter, hot sauce, and brown sugar. Toss hot wings in sauce.
Make blue cheese dip by mashing blue cheese with sour cream, mayo, garlic, and lemon juice. Serve alongside.

name: Korean Fried Chicken Wings
description: Double-fried chicken wings in a crispy batter coated with sticky gochujang honey glaze and sesame seeds.
instructions: Whisk potato starch, cornstarch, baking powder, salt, and cold water into a thin batter.
Heat oil to 325°F. Dip wings in batter and fry in batches 4-5 minutes until lightly golden. Drain and cool to room temperature, then freeze 2 hours.
Make sauce: sauté garlic and ginger in sesame oil 2 minutes, add gochujang, soy sauce, rice vinegar, and honey. Simmer 10-12 minutes until syrupy.
Heat oil to 375-400°F. Fry frozen wings 4-5 minutes until deep golden and crispy.
Drain wings and toss in sauce.
Transfer to platter and garnish with scallions and sesame seeds.

name: Lemon Pepper Wings
description: Crispy baked wings tossed in a buttery lemon pepper glaze with honey and fresh lemon juice.
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Toss wings with baking powder and salt until evenly coated. Arrange in a single layer on the baking sheet.
Bake 40-45 minutes until wings are golden and crispy.
Whisk together melted butter, lemon pepper seasoning, honey, and lemon juice.
Remove wings from oven and brush with lemon pepper glaze, tossing to coat.
Garnish with lemon wedges and parsley and serve immediately.

name: Garlic Parmesan Wings
description: Baked chicken wings tossed in herb-garlic olive oil and showered with freshly grated Parmesan cheese.
ingredients: 3 lbs chicken wings drumettes and flats
instructions: Pat wings dry. Toss with baking powder and 1 tsp salt. Arrange on wire rack over baking sheet. Refrigerate uncovered 8 hours.
In a large bowl whisk together olive oil, basil, garlic, thyme, black pepper, red pepper flakes, and remaining salt. Set aside.
Preheat grill to high indirect heat or preheat oven to 425°F. Cook wings over cool side of grill 30-40 minutes until skin is golden and blistered.
Transfer hot wings to bowl with herb oil and toss well.
Add Parmesan cheese and toss again until wings are evenly coated.
Transfer to serving platter and serve immediately.

name: BBQ Smoked Wings
description: Low-and-slow smoked chicken wings glazed with sweet BBQ sauce and finished over high heat for crispy skin.
ingredients: 2 tbsp sweet BBQ glaze or sauce
instructions: Pat wings dry. Place in a zip-top bag with avocado oil and toss to coat. Add BBQ rub and shake until evenly coated.
Preheat smoker to 275°F using apple or cherry wood. Place wings directly on grates, close lid, and smoke 2 hours until internal temperature reaches 160-165°F.
Remove wings to a baking sheet. Increase smoker temperature to 400-450°F.
Brush wings with BBQ glaze and return to the smoker. Cook 3-4 minutes per side until wings reach 175°F internal temperature.
Remove from smoker. Drizzle with additional sauce if desired.
Serve immediately with ranch or blue cheese dressing.

name: Sticky Honey-Soy Wings
description: Oven-baked wings marinated in honey, soy, and garlic, basted repeatedly until lacquered and sticky.
instructions: Whisk soy sauce, balsamic, brown sugar, honey, garlic, Sriracha, ginger, pepper, and onion powder in a bowl.
Place wings in a zip-top bag, pour in marinade, and toss. Marinate 30 minutes at room temperature.
Preheat oven to 400°F. Line a baking sheet with foil. Arrange wings skin side up and reserve marinade. Bake 30 minutes.
Drain juices off the pan. Pour reserved marinade over wings and toss to coat. Turn oven to 350°F. Bake 30 more minutes, basting with pan juices every 10 minutes.
Broil 2-3 minutes for extra caramelization.
Garnish with sesame seeds and scallions and serve.

name: Grilled BBQ Wings
description: Grilled chicken wings with a honey BBQ glaze, charred and smoky with caramelized sauce.
instructions: Preheat grill to 425°F. Pat wings dry and toss with avocado oil, salt, pepper, and garlic powder.
Whisk BBQ sauce, honey, Worcestershire, and smoked paprika in a saucepan over medium heat. Bring to a simmer 5 minutes. Keep warm.
Place wings on grill grates. Close lid and grill 15-20 minutes, flipping every 3-5 minutes, until skin is crispy and internal temperature reaches 170-175°F.
Brush wings generously with BBQ glaze and grill 2-3 more minutes per side for caramelized crust.
Remove from grill and toss in remaining glaze.
Serve immediately.

name: Baked Crispy Wings
description: Ultra-crispy oven-baked wings using the baking powder method — no frying required, served with any sauce.
ingredients: 3 lbs chicken wings drumettes and flats
hot sauce or BBQ sauce for serving
instructions: Pat wings completely dry with paper towels. Toss with baking powder, salt, garlic powder, paprika, and pepper in a zip-top bag.
Spread wings in a single layer on a wire rack over a foil-lined baking sheet. Refrigerate uncovered at least 8 hours or overnight.
Preheat oven to 250°F. Place baking sheet on lower oven rack and bake 30 minutes.
Increase oven temperature to 425°F and move sheet to upper rack. Bake 40-50 minutes, rotating pan halfway, until skin is very dark golden and crispy.
Let rest 5 minutes. Serve with your choice of dipping sauce.
Toss in any sauce or serve plain for maximum crispiness.

name: 7-Layer Dip
description: Classic party dip with layered refried beans, guacamole, sour cream, cheese, tomatoes, olives, and scallions.
ingredients: 1 can 3.8 oz sliced black olives drained
instructions: Spread refried beans evenly in the bottom of a 9x13 dish. Mix half the taco seasoning into the beans for extra flavor.
Spread guacamole in an even layer over the beans.
Mix remaining taco seasoning into sour cream, then spread over the guacamole layer.
Sprinkle shredded cheese evenly over the sour cream.
Top with diced tomatoes, sliced black olives, and scallions.
Add jalapeño slices if desired. Serve immediately or refrigerate up to 4 hours before serving. Serve with tortilla chips.

name: Buffalo Chicken Dip
description: Creamy, spicy baked dip loaded with shredded chicken, cream cheese, Frank's hot sauce, and cheddar cheese.
ingredients: tortilla chips or celery sticks for serving
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F. Lightly grease an 8x8 baking dish.
Cook and shred chicken breast if starting from raw, then mix with hot sauce.
Stir together cream cheese, ranch dressing, hot sauce-chicken mixture, and 1 cup of cheddar until well combined.
Transfer to prepared baking dish and spread evenly. Top with remaining cup of cheddar cheese.
Bake uncovered 18-20 minutes until bubbly and edges are lightly browned.
Serve hot with tortilla chips or celery sticks.

name: Roasted Spinach Artichoke Dip
description: Warm baked dip with roasted lemon, jalapeño, cream cheese, fontina, spinach, and marinated artichokes.
ingredients: 10 oz frozen chopped spinach thawed and squeezed dry
12 oz marinated artichoke hearts roughly chopped
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F. Place lemon quarters, jalapeño, and garlic in a small baking dish with olive oil. Season with salt and pepper. Roast 15-20 minutes until golden.
Let cool, then finely chop roasted lemon, jalapeño, and garlic into a rough paste.
In a medium bowl, combine cream cheese, fontina, half the mozzarella, smoked paprika, spinach, artichokes, and the roasted lemon paste. Season with salt and pepper.
Transfer to a greased 8-inch baking dish. Top with remaining mozzarella.
Bake 15-20 minutes until cheese is melted and bubbling.
Top with pine nuts and serve warm with crackers or bread.

name: Jalapeño Queso Dip
description: Silky stovetop queso with fresh jalapeños, chipotle peppers, cream cheese, and melted cheddar for dipping.
instructions: Melt butter in a large skillet over medium heat. Add onion, jalapeños, garlic, cumin, and a pinch of salt. Cook 5-10 minutes until onion is fragrant.
Add cream cheese and milk. Cook over medium heat, stirring, until cream cheese is melted and sauce is smooth.
In a bowl, toss shredded cheddar with flour.
Little by little add the cheese to the warm milk mixture, whisking until the sauce is smooth.
Stir in chipotle peppers. Taste and season with salt.
Serve warm topped with salsa and avocado slices with tortilla chips.

name: Pimento Cheese Dip
description: Southern-style pimento cheese made with sharp cheddar, cream cheese, and pimentos — bold and spreadable.
ingredients: 8 oz sharp cheddar cheese freshly shredded
instructions: Shred cheddar cheese fresh for best results. Set aside 2 oz for folding in later.
Combine cream cheese, drained pimentos, remaining cheddar, mayo, garlic powder, onion powder, cayenne, and black pepper in a food processor.
Pulse until combined and somewhat whipped — about 1 minute on and off. Do not overprocess; you want some texture.
Remove from food processor and transfer to a bowl. Fold in reserved shredded cheddar and jalapeño if using.
Taste and adjust seasoning with salt and more cayenne if desired.
Serve immediately or refrigerate up to 1 week; let sit at room temperature 30 minutes before serving with crackers or veggies.

name: Beer Cheese Dip
description: Pub-style warm beer cheese dip with sharp cheddar, Gruyère, and a splash of beer — perfect for pretzels.
ingredients: 1 cup shredded Gruyère or Swiss cheese
soft pretzels or vegetables for dipping
instructions: In a medium saucepan over medium heat, melt butter. Whisk in flour, onion powder, garlic powder, cayenne, and salt. Cook 1 minute.
Gradually whisk in milk and beer a little at a time until smooth after each addition.
Continue cooking over medium heat, stirring constantly. Add mustard and Worcestershire sauce. Cook until sauce is thick and bubbly, about 5 minutes.
Turn off heat. Add cheddar and Gruyère and stir until completely melted and smooth.
Taste and adjust seasoning with salt and cayenne.
Transfer to a serving bowl and serve warm with pretzels, vegetables, or tortilla chips.

name: Hot Crab Dip
description: Bubbly baked crab dip with lump crabmeat, Old Bay cream cheese, mozzarella, Parmesan, and a golden crust.
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F. Spray an 8-inch oven-safe skillet or baking dish with cooking spray.
Blend cream cheese, mayonnaise, sour cream, lemon zest, lemon juice, and Old Bay seasoning with a hand mixer until smooth.
Fold in lump crab meat, 1.5 cups mozzarella, Parmesan, and most of the scallions.
Spread evenly in the prepared dish. Sprinkle reserved mozzarella and scallions on top.
Bake uncovered 25 minutes until top is browned and dip is bubbly.
Let rest 5 minutes then serve with crostini or crackers.

name: Queso Fundido
description: Baked Mexican chorizo-and-cheese skillet dip with melted Oaxacan cheese and served with warm tortillas.
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F. Heat a 10-inch oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat.
Add chorizo to skillet and brown, breaking it up, about 5 minutes. Slide cooked chorizo out onto a plate. Drain excess fat if needed.
In the same skillet, sauté onion, garlic, and jalapeño until softened, about 3 minutes.
Return chorizo to pan and spread evenly. Top with all the shredded cheeses.
Transfer skillet to oven and bake 10-15 minutes until cheese is melted and beginning to bubble.
Serve immediately topped with fresh cilantro and salsa with warm flour tortillas.

name: Crowd Guacamole
description: Restaurant-style chunky guacamole made with a spiced paste base of jalapeño, onion, and cilantro.
ingredients: 1/2 tsp kosher salt plus more to taste
1 Roma tomato peeled seeded and diced
instructions: Combine onion, jalapeño, salt, cumin, and half the cilantro on a cutting board. Use a fork to mash into a coarse paste.
Alternatively, grind into a paste using a mortar and pestle. This is the flavor base.
Scrape paste into a large bowl. Halve and pit avocados; scoop fruit into the bowl.
Mash avocado to desired consistency — chunky or smooth.
Stir in lime juice, remaining cilantro, and diced tomato. Taste and adjust salt, lime, and jalapeño as needed.
Serve immediately with tortilla chips. To store, press plastic wrap directly onto surface to prevent browning.

name: Pulled Pork Sliders
description: Slow-cooker pulled pork with tangy homemade BBQ sauce piled onto sweet Hawaiian rolls with zesty coleslaw.
instructions: Season pork with salt and pepper. Sear in a skillet over medium-high heat on all sides until browned.
In a medium bowl, combine onion, apple cider vinegar, ketchup, brown sugar, molasses, Worcestershire, and dry mustard.
Place pork in slow cooker, pour sauce over top. Cook on low 8-10 hours until fork-tender.
Remove pork, shred with two forks, discard large fat pieces. Return to slow cooker with enough sauce for desired consistency.
Prepare coleslaw by whisking mayo, vinegar, and sugar together, then toss with coleslaw mix.
Slice Hawaiian rolls, pile high with pulled pork and coleslaw. Serve.

name: Cheeseburger Sliders
description: Hawaiian roll cheeseburger sliders with seasoned ground beef, special sauce, pickles, and melted cheddar.
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F. Grease a small sheet pan.
Mix ground beef with salt, pepper, onion powder, garlic powder, and Worcestershire. Pat into a rectangle on the pan. Bake 15 minutes until browned. Drain grease.
Slice Hawaiian rolls in half horizontally. Place bottom half on the sheet pan.
Whisk together mayo, ketchup, and relish for special sauce.
Place cheese on roll bottoms, add beef patty, drizzle with special sauce, add pickles. Place top buns on. Brush with melted butter, sprinkle sesame seeds.
Wrap in foil and bake 15 minutes. Uncover and bake 5-6 minutes until tops are golden. Slice and serve.

name: BBQ Chicken Sliders
description: Tender shredded BBQ chicken piled onto toasted Hawaiian rolls with pickled jalapeños and creamy slaw.
instructions: Season chicken with garlic powder and smoked paprika. Place in a skillet with broth and half the BBQ sauce.
Simmer covered over medium heat 20-25 minutes until chicken is cooked through and tender.
Shred chicken using two forks. Add remaining BBQ sauce and toss to coat.
Toss coleslaw mix with mayo, apple cider vinegar, and sugar.
Melt butter and brush cut sides of rolls. Toast in a skillet or under the broiler until golden.
Add a slice of cheese to each roll bottom, pile on shredded chicken, top with coleslaw and jalapeños. Serve.

name: Meatball Subs
description: Italian-style meatball sub sandwiches loaded with marinara, melted provolone, and fresh basil.
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F. Combine beef, pork, breadcrumbs soaked in milk, Parmesan, egg, garlic, Italian seasoning, and salt in a bowl. Mix gently.
Roll into 1.5-inch balls and arrange on a parchment-lined baking sheet. Bake 18-20 minutes until cooked through.
Transfer cooked meatballs to a saucepan with marinara. Simmer covered 10 minutes.
Mix butter with minced garlic and spread on cut sides of rolls. Broil rolls 2-3 minutes until golden.
Place 4-5 meatballs in each toasted roll and top with sauce and a slice of provolone.
Broil 2-3 minutes until cheese is melted. Garnish with basil and serve.

name: Bacon-Wrapped Jalapeño Poppers
description: Cream cheese and cheddar-stuffed jalapeño halves wrapped in bacon and grilled until crispy and caramelized.
ingredients: 1 tbsp BBQ dry rub or seasoning
instructions: Preheat grill to 375-400°F using two-zone heat (one direct, one indirect).
In a bowl, combine cream cheese and cheddar cheese. Mix until well blended.
Slice jalapeños in half lengthwise. Scrape out seeds and ribs with a spoon.
Fill each jalapeño half with about 1 tablespoon of the cheese filling.
Wrap each stuffed jalapeño in half a slice of bacon. Tuck ends under or secure with a toothpick. Sprinkle with BBQ rub.
Grill over indirect heat 20-25 minutes. Move to direct heat 2-3 minutes to crisp the bacon. Serve hot.

name: Bacon-Wrapped Dates with Goat Cheese
description: Sweet Medjool dates stuffed with creamy goat cheese, wrapped in bacon and baked until caramelized and crispy.
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F. Line a rimmed baking sheet with parchment paper.
Slice dates along one long side and remove pits. Open each date like a book.
Fill each date with about 1/2 teaspoon of goat cheese and press the sides closed.
Wrap each stuffed date with a half-slice of bacon, overlapping the ends. Secure with a toothpick.
Place wrapped dates in a single layer on the prepared baking sheet.
Bake 20 minutes until bacon is crispy, flipping halfway. Transfer to a platter, sprinkle with pepper, and serve immediately.

name: Loaded Potato Skins
description: Crispy baked potato skins loaded with cheddar cheese, crispy bacon, sour cream, and green onions.
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F. Prick potatoes all over with a fork. Place directly on oven rack and bake 1 hour until soft when squeezed. Let cool slightly.
Halve potatoes lengthwise and scoop out flesh leaving a 1/4-inch border. Save flesh for another use.
Slice each half in half again to make 4 pieces per potato. Brush insides and outsides with olive oil. Season with salt and pepper.
Place on a baking sheet and bake at 450°F 20-25 minutes until edges are crispy and golden.
Remove and top each skin with cheddar cheese and crumbled bacon. Return to oven 3-5 minutes until cheese is bubbly.
Top with sour cream, scallions, and hot sauce. Serve immediately.

name: Fried Mozzarella Sticks
description: Golden-fried mozzarella sticks with a crispy panko crust and gooey cheese interior — served with marinara.
ingredients: 1 lb whole milk mozzarella block cut into 15 sticks
1.5 cups marinara sauce warmed for serving
instructions: Set up a dredging station: flour in one shallow bowl, beaten eggs in another, and panko mixed with Italian seasoning, garlic powder, parsley, pepper, and salt in a third.
Working one at a time, dredge each mozzarella stick in flour (shake off excess), dip in egg, then coat in panko. Repeat egg and panko steps for a second coat.
Place coated sticks on a baking sheet and freeze at least 1 hour.
Heat 3 inches of vegetable oil in a heavy pot to 350°F.
Fry in batches of 3-4 for about 1 minute until golden brown. Do not let cheese bubble and leak.
Drain on paper towels. Serve immediately with warm marinara sauce.

name: Nachos Supreme
description: Sheet-pan nachos layered with seasoned ground beef, refried beans, melted cheese, and all the toppings.
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F. Line two baking sheets with parchment paper.
Brown ground beef and onion in a skillet over medium-high heat until cooked through, about 8 minutes. Drain. Stir in taco seasoning and water; simmer until thickened.
Spread tortilla chips in a single layer across the prepared baking sheets.
Spoon dollops of refried beans and seasoned ground beef over the chips. Sprinkle cheese over everything.
Bake 15 minutes until cheese is melted and chips begin to crisp.
Remove from oven and top with diced tomatoes, scallions, olives, jalapeños, sour cream, and guacamole. Serve immediately.

name: Shrimp Cocktail Platter
description: Classic poached jumbo shrimp chilled over ice and served with homemade zesty cocktail sauce.
ingredients: 2 lbs jumbo shrimp peeled deveined tails on
instructions: Fill a medium saucepan 2/3 full with water. Add celery, salt, thyme, parsley, peppercorns, and bay leaves. Bring to a boil and simmer 10 minutes.
Prepare shrimp: peel and devein, leaving tails on.
Add shrimp and half the lemon to simmering water. Remove from heat immediately, cover, and let rest 3-4 minutes until pink and firm.
Fill a bowl with ice water. Transfer shrimp to ice bath until completely cooled, about 5 minutes. Drain.
Make cocktail sauce: whisk together ketchup, horseradish, Worcestershire, and lemon juice. Refrigerate 30 minutes.
Arrange shrimp around a bowl of cocktail sauce over crushed ice. Serve with lemon wedges.

name: 5-Alarm Competition Chili
description: Rich Texas-style no-bean chili with three chiles, chunks of beef chuck, and layers of deep smoky heat.
ingredients: 3 lbs beef chuck coarsely ground or cubed
2 dried ancho chiles stemmed and torn
shredded cheddar and sour cream for serving
instructions: Combine beef stock and tomato paste in a large Dutch oven. Whisk to combine.
Add chili powder, ancho chiles, chipotle, onion, garlic, cumin, oregano, cayenne, salt, and smoked paprika. Stir to combine. Add raw beef.
Cover and bring to medium heat, stirring occasionally. After about 1 hour the chili should reach a light simmer.
Turn off heat and allow to cool completely. Refrigerate overnight for best flavor development.
The next day, skim congealed fat off the top. Cover and warm over low heat 30 minutes. Raise heat to medium and simmer uncovered 1.5 hours until chili is reduced and thickened.
Taste and season with additional salt. Serve with shredded cheddar, sour cream, and cornbread.

name: Frito Pie
description: Texas-style Frito pie with zesty ground beef chili baked over corn chips with cheddar and all the fixings.
ingredients: 1 can 10 oz Rotel diced tomatoes with green chiles
sour cream diced tomatoes and sliced jalapeños for serving
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F. Coat a 9x13-inch baking dish with cooking spray.
In a large skillet over medium-high heat, brown ground beef with onion and bell pepper until cooked through, about 8 minutes. Drain grease.
Stir in taco seasoning. Add Rotel tomatoes, enchilada sauce, chili beans, and corn. Bring to a simmer and cook 5 minutes.
Sprinkle half the Fritos in the bottom of the baking dish. Top with 1 cup cheddar, then pour meat mixture over everything. Top with remaining Fritos and cheddar.
Bake uncovered 10-15 minutes until cheese is melted and bubbly.
Serve topped with sour cream, diced tomatoes, and jalapeños.

name: Party-Sized Fudge Brownies
description: Dense, fudgy 9x13 pan of scratch-made brownies loaded with chocolate chips — rich, shareable, and perfect for a crowd.
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F. Grease a 9x13-inch baking pan and line with parchment paper, leaving an overhang for easy removal.
Melt butter in a medium saucepan over low heat. Remove from heat and stir in sugar until combined.
Beat in eggs one at a time, then stir in vanilla.
In a separate bowl, whisk together flour, cocoa powder, salt, and baking powder. Fold into wet ingredients until just combined.
Stir in 1 cup chocolate chips. Pour batter into prepared pan and spread evenly. Scatter remaining 1/2 cup chips on top.
Bake 28-32 minutes until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out with moist crumbs. Sprinkle with flaky salt. Cool completely before cutting into 24 squares.

name: Air Fryer Chicken Breast
description: Juicy, perfectly seasoned boneless chicken breasts cooked to golden perfection in the air fryer.
ingredients: 4 small boneless skinless chicken breasts about 6 oz each
instructions: Pound the thicker end of each chicken breast so they are an even thickness.
Rub chicken with olive oil on all sides.
Mix garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, parsley, salt, and cayenne; rub spice blend all over chicken.
Preheat air fryer to 380°F.
Place chicken in basket in a single layer and air fry 5 to 6 minutes per side, 10 to 12 minutes total, until internal temp reaches 165°F.
Rest 5 minutes before slicing and serving.

name: Air Fryer Chicken Thighs
description: Crispy-skinned bone-in chicken thighs seasoned with lemon and herbs, cooked in the air fryer.
instructions: Pat chicken thighs dry with paper towels.
Squeeze lemon juice over chicken and season with all spices; rub well on all sides.
Place chicken thighs skin-side down in air fryer basket.
Air fry at 400°F for 12 minutes.
Flip skin-side up and cook an additional 12 minutes until skin is crispy and internal temp reaches 165°F.
Rest 5 minutes before serving.

name: Air Fryer Buffalo Chicken Wings
description: Crispy air-fried chicken wings tossed in classic Frank's hot sauce and butter for the ultimate buffalo flavor.
instructions: Pat wings dry thoroughly with paper towels.
In a large bowl, combine salt, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, oregano, and baking powder; toss wings to coat evenly.
Spray air fryer basket with oil and arrange wings in a single layer in batches.
Air fry at 400°F for 16 to 22 minutes, shaking basket halfway through, until golden and crispy.
While wings cook, warm hot sauce and stir in melted butter.
Toss cooked wings in buffalo sauce and serve immediately.

name: Air Fryer Garlic Parmesan Wings
description: Crispy air-fried chicken wings coated in a savory garlic butter and Parmesan sauce.
instructions: Pat wings completely dry with paper towels.
Toss wings with salt, pepper, garlic powder, and baking powder in a large bowl.
Arrange in a single layer in the air fryer basket; air fry at 400°F for 20 to 22 minutes, shaking basket halfway, until deeply golden.
Meanwhile, melt butter in a small saucepan over low heat; add minced garlic and cook 1 to 2 minutes until fragrant.
Remove from heat and stir in Parmesan and parsley.
Toss hot wings in garlic Parmesan sauce and serve immediately.

name: Air Fryer Buffalo Chicken Nuggets
description: Bite-sized chicken chunks dipped in hot sauce and coated in panko, air fried to crispy perfection.
ingredients: 1 lb boneless skinless chicken breast cut into bite-size chunks
instructions: Cut chicken into small bite-sized chunks; season with garlic powder, paprika, chili powder, and pepper.
Place panko in one shallow bowl and hot sauce in another.
Dip each chicken piece in hot sauce, then roll in panko to coat.
Place coated nuggets in air fryer basket in a single layer.
Spray generously with olive oil and air fry at 400°F for 4 minutes.
Flip, spray the other side, and cook 4 more minutes until golden and cooked through.
Serve with celery sticks and blue cheese dressing.

name: Air Fryer Breaded Pork Chops
description: Thick pork chops dredged in seasoned panko breadcrumbs and air fried until golden and juicy.
instructions: Pat pork chops dry; season both sides with salt and pepper.
Set up a dredging station: flour in one dish, beaten eggs in another, and panko mixed with Parmesan, Italian seasoning, and paprika in a third.
Dredge each chop in flour, dip in egg, then firmly press into panko mixture.
Preheat air fryer to 400°F.
Spray both sides of breaded chops with cooking spray; place in basket in a single layer.
Cook 5 minutes, flip, spray again, and cook 4 to 5 more minutes until breading is golden and internal temp reaches 145°F.
Rest 5 minutes before serving.

name: Air Fryer Pork Tenderloin
description: Herb-rubbed pork tenderloin cooked quickly in the air fryer until juicy and perfectly tender.
instructions: Remove silver skin from pork tenderloin using a sharp knife.
Brush pork with olive oil on all sides.
Combine salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, and thyme; rub evenly over the tenderloin.
Preheat air fryer to 400°F.
Place tenderloin in the basket (cut in half if needed to fit) and cook 16 to 17 minutes until internal temp reaches 145°F.
Transfer to a plate and rest at least 5 minutes before slicing.

name: Air Fryer Salmon with Honey Dijon Glaze
description: Flaky salmon fillets brushed with a honey-Dijon glaze and air fried to golden perfection in minutes.
instructions: Pat salmon dry with paper towels; season lightly with salt and pepper.
In a small bowl, whisk together honey, Dijon, olive oil, soy sauce, and garlic powder.
Line air fryer basket with aluminum foil; preheat air fryer to 400°F for 3 minutes.
Spoon glaze generously over the top of each salmon fillet.
Place fillets in basket not touching; air fry 8 to 9 minutes for 1-inch thick fillets until salmon reaches 145°F and glaze is caramelized.
Serve immediately.

name: Air Fryer Seasoned Shrimp
description: Plump jumbo shrimp seasoned with garlic and paprika, air fried in minutes for bowls, salads, or tacos.
ingredients: 1.25 lbs jumbo shrimp peeled and deveined
instructions: In a bowl, whisk olive oil with garlic powder, paprika, parsley, and salt.
Add shrimp and toss to coat on all sides.
Arrange shrimp in a single layer in the air fryer basket without overlapping; work in batches if needed.
Air fry at 400°F for 5 to 6 minutes, shaking basket halfway through, until shrimp are pink and curled.
Serve immediately with lemon wedges.

name: Air Fryer Garlic Butter Steak Bites
description: Tender sirloin cubes seared in the air fryer and finished with garlic butter for a quick steakhouse treat.
ingredients: 1.5 lbs sirloin steak cut into 1.5-inch cubes
instructions: Pat steak cubes very dry; toss with olive oil, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, salt, and pepper.
Preheat air fryer to 400°F for 3 minutes.
Arrange steak bites in a single layer in basket; do not crowd.
Air fry 6 to 8 minutes for medium, shaking halfway, until browned on the outside.
Meanwhile, melt butter in a small skillet over medium heat; add minced garlic and cook 1 minute until fragrant.
Toss hot steak bites with garlic butter and parsley; serve immediately.

name: Air Fryer Parmesan Brussels Sprouts
description: Halved Brussels sprouts roasted until crispy in the air fryer, finished with Parmesan and breadcrumbs.
ingredients: 1 lb Brussels sprouts trimmed and halved
instructions: Toss Brussels sprouts with 1 tablespoon olive oil and salt in a large bowl.
Add sprouts to air fryer basket and air fry at 350°F for 14 minutes, shaking basket halfway through.
Meanwhile, combine Parmesan, breadcrumbs, garlic, parsley, pepper, and remaining 1/2 tablespoon oil in a small bowl.
Open basket and spread Parmesan mixture evenly over sprouts; spritz with olive oil spray.
Air fry at 350°F for 2 more minutes until topping is golden.
Serve immediately.

name: Air Fryer Parmesan Green Beans
description: Crisp-tender green beans air fried with olive oil and topped with golden Parmesan breadcrumbs.
ingredients: 1 lb fresh green beans rinsed and trimmed
instructions: Toss green beans with 2 teaspoons olive oil and salt until coated.
Add to air fryer basket and air fry at 375°F for 6 to 7 minutes, shaking halfway, until crisp-tender.
Combine Parmesan, breadcrumbs, garlic, paprika, parsley, and pepper with remaining oil in a small bowl.
Spread crumb mixture over green beans in basket; spritz with oil spray.
Air fry at 375°F for 2 more minutes until golden.
Transfer to a platter and serve hot.

name: Air Fryer Sweet Potato Fries
description: Lightly seasoned sweet potato fries that come out crispy on the outside and tender inside from the air fryer.
ingredients: 2 large sweet potatoes peeled and cut into 1/4-inch fries
instructions: Peel and cut sweet potatoes into even 1/4-inch thick fries; dry thoroughly with paper towels.
Toss fries with olive oil, salt, garlic powder, paprika, pepper, and cayenne until evenly coated.
Preheat air fryer to 380°F.
Arrange fries in a single layer in basket; do not overcrowd (cook in batches).
Air fry 10 minutes, then shake basket and cook 7 to 8 more minutes until edges are crispy.
Serve immediately with dipping sauce of choice.

name: Air Fryer French Fries
description: Classic golden french fries made from fresh russet potatoes, soaked and air fried to crispy perfection.
ingredients: 3 large russet potatoes peeled and cut into 1/4-inch fries
instructions: Cut potatoes into 1/4-inch fries; place in a large bowl of cold water and soak 30 minutes.
Drain well and pat very dry with a clean kitchen towel.
Toss fries with olive oil, garlic powder, and seasoned salt.
Preheat air fryer to 390°F.
Place fries in basket in a single layer and cook 10 minutes; shake basket and cook another 6 to 8 minutes until golden and crispy.
Add additional salt to taste and serve immediately.

name: Air Fryer Breakfast Home Fries
description: Seasoned diced russet potatoes cooked in the air fryer until golden brown and crispy for the perfect breakfast side.
ingredients: 3 medium russet potatoes cut into 1/2-inch cubes
instructions: Preheat air fryer to 400°F.
Toss diced potatoes with olive oil, paprika, salt, garlic powder, onion powder, thyme, and pepper in a large bowl.
Lightly spray air fryer basket with nonstick cooking spray.
Add seasoned potatoes in a single layer; do not overcrowd.
Cook 15 minutes, shaking basket every 5 minutes for even browning.
Remove when golden brown and crispy; serve immediately.

name: Air Fryer Bacon
description: Perfectly crispy twisted bacon strips cooked in the air fryer with no grease splatter and easy cleanup.
instructions: Preheat air fryer to 350°F.
Take each bacon strip and twist into a tight rope shape.
Lay twisted bacon in the air fryer basket without strips touching; work in batches as needed.
Season lightly with salt and pepper if desired.
Air fry 6 to 10 minutes depending on thickness and desired crispness.
Use tongs to transfer to a paper towel-lined plate to drain; serve immediately.

name: Air Fryer Egg Cups
description: Individual egg cups loaded with vegetables and cheese, air fried in silicone molds for an easy protein-packed breakfast.
instructions: Preheat air fryer to 300°F.
Whisk eggs and milk together in a large bowl; season with garlic powder, salt, and pepper.
Stir in spinach, bell pepper, tomatoes, and half the cheddar.
Spray 4 silicone egg molds or ramekins with cooking spray; fill each about 3/4 full with egg mixture.
Top each with remaining cheese; place molds in air fryer basket.
Air fry 10 to 12 minutes until eggs are fully set and tops are lightly golden.
Cool briefly in molds before unmolding and serving.

name: Air Fryer Crispy Garlic Rosemary Chickpeas
description: Canned chickpeas tossed with olive oil and herbs then air fried until irresistibly crunchy as a healthy snack.
ingredients: 2 cans 15 oz each chickpeas drained and rinsed
instructions: Drain and rinse chickpeas; pat very dry with paper towels.
In a bowl, toss chickpeas with olive oil, salt, garlic powder, and rosemary until evenly coated.
Preheat air fryer to 400°F.
Spread chickpeas in air fryer basket in a single layer.
Cook 15 minutes, stirring halfway through, until chickpeas are golden and crispy.
Allow to cool completely before serving or storing in an airtight container.

name: Air Fryer Mozzarella Sticks
description: Classic mozzarella sticks double-coated in panko and frozen before air frying to prevent cheese from leaking.
instructions: Beat eggs and water in a shallow bowl; place flour in a second bowl; mix panko, garlic powder, Italian seasoning, salt, and pepper in a third.
Halve mozzarella sticks lengthwise; coat in flour, dip in egg, roll in panko pressing to adhere.
Dip again in egg and roll again in panko for a double coat; arrange on parchment-lined baking sheet.
Freeze for at least 30 minutes (do not skip this step).
Preheat air fryer to 390°F; spray basket and all sides of frozen sticks with cooking spray.
Air fry 4 to 7 minutes in batches until crispy and golden; serve immediately with marinara sauce.

name: Air Fryer Jalapeño Poppers
description: Cream cheese-stuffed jalapeño halves topped with shredded cheese and crispy bacon, air fried until bubbly.
ingredients: 1 cup shredded Colby Jack cheese divided
instructions: Slice jalapeños lengthwise and remove seeds and veins; brush with olive oil.
Air fry jalapeño halves at 400°F for 4 minutes; let cool 5 minutes and drain upside down on paper towels.
Beat cream cheese with garlic powder, salt, and pepper until smooth.
Stir in 1/2 cup Colby Jack, most of the bacon, and green onions.
Fill each jalapeño half with cream cheese mixture; top with remaining cheese and reserved bacon.
Air fry at 400°F for 5 minutes until cheese is melted and bubbly; serve hot.

name: Air Fryer Onion Rings
description: Thick-cut onion rings dredged in seasoned panko and air fried until shatteringly crispy without deep frying.
ingredients: 2 large yellow onions cut into 1/2-inch rings
instructions: Separate onion rings and set aside.
In a bowl, whisk flour, paprika, garlic powder, and salt.
In another bowl, whisk eggs and buttermilk together.
In a third bowl, combine panko with olive oil.
Dredge each ring in flour, dip in egg-buttermilk mixture, then press into panko to coat; place on a baking sheet.
Spray air fryer basket; arrange rings in a single layer.
Air fry at 350°F for 6 minutes, flip, spray again, and cook 5 to 6 more minutes until golden brown.
Serve immediately with dipping sauce.

name: Air Fryer Pork Egg Rolls
description: Crispy egg rolls stuffed with seasoned ground pork and coleslaw mix, air fried instead of deep fried.
instructions: Cook ground pork in a skillet over medium heat until no pink remains; drain fat.
Add garlic and ginger; cook 1 minute. Add coleslaw mix and cook 5 to 6 minutes until tender.
Stir in soy sauce and green onions; cool slightly.
Mix flour with just enough water to make a paste.
Lay out egg roll wrappers; place 1/3 cup filling in center of each.
Fold diagonally, tuck sides in, roll up and seal tip with flour paste.
Brush outside of each egg roll with oil; place in air fryer basket 3 to 4 at a time.
Air fry at 390°F for 8 minutes, flip, cook 3 more minutes until golden and crispy.

name: Air Fryer Falafel
description: Classic herb-packed chickpea falafel balls air fried until golden and crispy without deep frying.
instructions: Soak dried chickpeas in water overnight; drain well (do not use canned).
Combine soaked chickpeas, shallots, parsley, cilantro, garlic, spices, lemon juice, and flour in food processor.
Pulse until coarse and well combined but not completely smooth; refrigerate 30 minutes.
Shape mixture into 1-inch balls; spray air fryer basket with cooking spray.
Place falafel in basket in a single layer with space between each; spray tops with oil.
Air fry at 350°F for 15 to 18 minutes, turning halfway through, until golden and crispy.
Serve immediately in pita with tahini sauce.

name: Air Fryer Samosas
description: Flaky dough parcels stuffed with spiced potato and pea filling, air fried until golden and crispy.
instructions: Make dough: combine flour, 2 tbsp oil, and 1/4 tsp salt; gradually add warm water and knead until smooth. Rest covered 20 minutes.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in skillet; add cumin seeds. Once sizzling add ginger, chile, garam masala, coriander, and remaining salt; cook 30 seconds.
Add mashed potatoes and peas; cook 2 minutes. Stir in cilantro; cool.
Divide dough into 8 balls; roll each into a 6-inch disc and cut in half.
Fold each semicircle into a cone; fill with 2 tbsp potato filling; seal edges tightly.
Brush samosas with oil; place in air fryer basket.
Air fry at 375°F for 12 minutes; flip, brush again with oil, and cook 8 to 10 more minutes until golden.
Serve with chutney.

name: Air Fryer Korean Chicken Bites
description: Crispy cornstarch-coated chicken thigh pieces air fried and tossed in a sticky gochujang glaze.
ingredients: 1.5 lbs boneless skinless chicken thighs cut into bite-size pieces
instructions: Toss chicken with vinegar, 1 tbsp soy sauce, ginger, and salt; marinate 15 to 20 minutes.
Set up two bowls: beaten eggs and cornstarch; dip each piece in egg then cornstarch.
Line air fryer basket with parchment; arrange coated chicken in single layer; spray with oil.
Air fry at 400°F for 8 minutes; flip, spray with more oil, cook 7 more minutes until crispy.
Make sauce: stir together ketchup, gochujang, honey, 2 tbsp soy sauce, sesame oil, and garlic.
Toss hot chicken in sauce; garnish with scallions and sesame seeds; serve immediately.

name: Air Fryer Beef Burgers
description: Juicy seasoned 80/20 ground beef patties cooked in the air fryer in under 15 minutes.
instructions: Combine ground beef, salt, pepper, onion powder, and garlic powder in a bowl; mix gently.
Form into 4 patties about 1/2-inch thick; make a small indent in the center of each.
Preheat air fryer to 370°F.
Add patties in a single layer to the basket; cook 6 minutes.
Flip and cook 3 to 5 more minutes until beef reaches 160°F.
Add cheese if using; cook 1 more minute until melted.
Serve on buns with desired toppings.

name: Air Fryer Turkey Burgers
description: Moist and flavorful turkey burgers with soy sauce and breadcrumbs, air fried until juicy and brown.
ingredients: 1 lb ground turkey not extra lean
salt and black pepper to taste
instructions: Gently mix all ingredients in a bowl until just combined.
Form into 4 patties 1/2-inch thick; make a small indent in center of each.
Refrigerate patties 30 minutes to help them hold together.
Preheat air fryer to 350°F.
Place patties in a single layer in the basket; cook 6 minutes.
Flip and cook 6 to 8 more minutes until internal temp reaches 165°F.
Serve on buns with desired toppings.

name: Air Fryer Crispy Hash Browns
description: Frozen shredded hash browns tossed with oil and air fried until deeply golden and crispy on the outside.
ingredients: 16 oz frozen shredded hash browns do not thaw
instructions: Add frozen hash browns to a large bowl; break up any large clumps.
Drizzle oil over hash browns; toss to coat evenly; season with salt and pepper.
Spread hash browns into air fryer basket in an even layer.
Air fry at 380°F for 15 minutes; flip with a spatula and cook an additional 3 to 5 minutes until golden and crispy.
Serve immediately.

name: Air Fryer Brown Sugar Rubbed Pork Chops
description: Boneless pork chops coated in a sweet and savory brown sugar spice rub and air fried to juicy perfection.
instructions: Preheat air fryer to 400°F.
In a small bowl, combine brown sugar, chili powder, garlic powder, black pepper, and salt.
Using a sharp knife, cut a few slits in the fat cap on the sides of each chop to prevent curling.
Massage rub into both sides of the pork chops.
Place chops in a single layer in the basket; cook 12 minutes, flipping after 6 minutes, until internal temp reaches 145°F.
Transfer to a plate; rest 5 minutes before serving.

name: Air Fryer Roasted Cauliflower
description: Cauliflower florets seasoned with smoked paprika and garlic, air fried until caramelized and tender.
ingredients: 1 medium head cauliflower cut into florets
instructions: Cut cauliflower into even florets; pat dry with paper towels.
Toss florets with olive oil, smoked paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and pepper in a large bowl.
Preheat air fryer to 390°F.
Add florets in a single layer to the basket; cook 8 minutes.
Shake basket and cook 6 to 7 more minutes until edges are caramelized and tender.
Sprinkle with Parmesan if using and garnish with parsley; serve immediately.

name: Instant Pot Chicken Noodle Soup
description: Classic chicken noodle soup made fast in the pressure cooker with tender chicken and egg noodles.
instructions: Set Instant Pot to Saute (High). Heat olive oil and saute onion and celery for 3 minutes until softened. Add garlic and cook 1 minute more.
Add carrots, chicken broth, thyme, bay leaf, salt, and pepper. Nestle chicken breasts into the broth.
Seal lid and cook on High Pressure for 10 minutes. Allow natural pressure release for 5 minutes, then quick release remaining pressure.
Remove chicken breasts and shred with two forks. Discard bay leaf.
Set pot to Saute. Add egg noodles and cook 6-8 minutes until tender. Return shredded chicken to pot.
Taste and adjust seasoning. Ladle into bowls and garnish with fresh parsley.

name: Instant Pot Beef Stew
description: Hearty pressure-cooked beef stew with tender chuck roast, potatoes, and carrots in rich broth.
ingredients: 2.5 lbs boneless chuck roast cut into 1.5-inch cubes
instructions: Season beef cubes with salt and pepper. Set Instant Pot to Saute (High). Heat 1 tbsp oil and sear beef in batches until browned on all sides, about 4 minutes per batch. Remove beef and set aside.
Add remaining oil and saute onion until softened, about 3 minutes. Add garlic and cook 30 seconds. Stir in broth and scrape up browned bits from bottom of pot to deglaze.
Add tomato paste, Worcestershire sauce, thyme, and bay leaf. Return browned beef to pot. Add carrots, potatoes, and celery on top. Do not stir.
Seal lid and cook on High Pressure for 35 minutes. Natural pressure release for 10 minutes, then quick release remaining.
Remove thyme and bay leaf. Whisk cornstarch with 2 tbsp cold water to make a slurry. Set pot to Saute. Stir slurry into stew and simmer 2 minutes until thickened. Add peas and stir.
Serve hot.

name: Instant Pot Chili
description: Award-winning ground beef chili pressure-cooked in 15 minutes with kidney beans and crushed tomatoes.
ingredients: 2 (15 oz) cans kidney beans drained and rinsed
1/2 cup light lager beer or additional broth
instructions: Set Instant Pot to Saute (High). Add ground beef and onion; brown meat breaking it up, about 5 minutes. Add garlic and cook 1 minute. Drain excess grease.
Pour in beer (or broth) and scrape up any browned bits from bottom of pot. Cook 2 minutes. Hit Cancel to stop Saute.
Add beef broth, chili seasoning, kidney beans, and Worcestershire sauce. Stir well. Place crushed tomatoes on top without stirring.
Seal lid and set vent to Sealing. Cook on High Pressure for 15 minutes.
Allow natural pressure release for at least 15 minutes, then release any remaining pressure.
Stir chili and serve with desired toppings such as shredded cheddar, sour cream, and scallions.

name: Instant Pot Lentil Soup
description: Nourishing red lentil soup with cumin, carrots, and a squeeze of lemon, cooked in under 30 minutes.
instructions: Set Instant Pot to Saute (Medium). Heat olive oil and cook onion, carrots, and celery for 3 minutes. Add garlic, cumin, turmeric, and paprika; cook 1 minute until fragrant.
Add rinsed lentils, vegetable broth, diced tomatoes, salt, and pepper. Stir well. Hit Cancel.
Seal lid and set vent to Sealing. Cook on High Pressure for 10 minutes. Quick release the pressure.
Stir the soup; lentils will have broken down and thickened the broth naturally.
Stir in fresh lemon juice and taste for seasoning.
Ladle into bowls and garnish with fresh parsley. Serve with crusty bread.

name: Instant Pot Split Pea Soup
description: Thick and smoky split pea soup with ham, cooked under high pressure for a silky bowl of comfort.
instructions: Set Instant Pot to Saute. Heat olive oil and cook onion, celery, and carrots for 5 minutes until softened. Add garlic and cook 1 minute.
Add split peas, chicken broth, ham, Worcestershire sauce, thyme, bay leaf, salt, and pepper. Stir well.
Seal lid and set vent to Sealing. Cook on High Pressure for 15 minutes. Quick release the pressure when done.
Remove bay leaf and thyme sprigs. Stir soup vigorously — the split peas will dissolve into a thick creamy texture.
Taste and adjust salt and pepper as needed.
Serve hot. Soup will thicken further as it cools; add broth to thin if desired.

name: Instant Pot Pulled Pork
description: Fall-apart tender pulled pork with a smoky spice rub, pressure-cooked in 60 minutes.
ingredients: 3 lbs boneless pork shoulder cut into large chunks
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together brown sugar, garlic powder, onion powder, smoked paprika, cumin, salt, chile powder, and black pepper.
Add pork shoulder pieces and massage the spice rub all over the meat. Allow to marinate 15 minutes.
Place rubbed pork into the Instant Pot inner liner. Add 1/4 cup water.
Seal lid and set vent to Sealing. Cook on High Pressure for 60 minutes.
Allow natural pressure release for 15 minutes, then quick release any remaining pressure.
Remove pork to a cutting board and shred with two forks. Return shredded pork to the cooking liquid. Serve with BBQ sauce on rolls or in tacos.

name: Instant Pot Pot Roast
description: Classic pot roast with fork-tender chuck roast, potatoes, carrots, and rich pan gravy.
ingredients: 2 medium yellow onions sliced into wedges
instructions: Combine salt, seasoned salt, pepper, rosemary, thyme, onion powder, and garlic powder. Rub all over the roast.
Set Instant Pot to Saute (High). Heat olive oil and sear roast 2 minutes per side. Remove and set aside.
Add butter and onions; stir constantly to deglaze the pot for 2 minutes. Add garlic, Worcestershire sauce, wine, and broth and scrape up any browned bits.
Place trivet in pot over onions with handles up. Set roast on trivet fat-side up. Wrap potatoes and carrots in separate foil pouches and place on top of roast.
Seal lid and cook on High Pressure for 60 minutes. Natural release 15 minutes, then quick release remaining.
Remove foil pouches and roast. Set Instant Pot to Saute. Whisk cornstarch with 2 tbsp water; stir into pot and simmer 1 minute until thickened. Slice roast and serve with gravy and vegetables.

name: Instant Pot Pulled Chicken
description: Juicy shredded chicken breast made in the Instant Pot in under 25 minutes, perfect for meal prep.
instructions: Place chicken breasts in the Instant Pot. Add chicken broth, celery stalks, and bay leaves.
Sprinkle salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, and oregano over the chicken.
Seal lid and set vent to Sealing. Cook on High Pressure for 10 minutes. Natural release for 8 minutes, then quick release remaining pressure.
Remove chicken to a cutting board. Discard celery and bay leaves. Reserve broth for soup or other uses.
Shred chicken with two forks or use a hand mixer for quick fine shredding.
Add a splash of reserved broth back to the chicken to keep it moist. Use in tacos, salads, sandwiches, or bowls.

name: Instant Pot Chicken Tikka Masala
description: Tender chicken in a rich, spiced tomato-coconut sauce made fast in the pressure cooker.
ingredients: 1.5 lbs boneless skinless chicken thighs cut into bite-size pieces
instructions: Set Instant Pot to Saute. Melt butter, then add onion, garlic, ginger, and all spices (garam masala through cardamom). Cook 3 minutes until onion is softened and spices are fragrant.
Add tomato sauce and stir. Season chicken with 1 tsp salt and add to pot. Stir to combine. Sprinkle remaining salt.
Seal lid and set vent to Sealing. Cook on High Pressure for 15 minutes. Quick release the pressure.
Stir in coconut milk and frozen peas. Set pot to Saute and simmer 5 minutes to thicken sauce.
Turn pot off. Let cool 3 minutes, then stir in Greek yogurt.
Serve over basmati rice or with naan, garnished with fresh cilantro.

name: Instant Pot Dal Makhani
description: Buttery, creamy black lentil dal cooked low and slow under high pressure, Instant Pot style.
ingredients: 1 cup whole black urad dal rinsed and drained
1/4 cup half and half or heavy cream
instructions: Wash the urad dal and rajma well. Add to Instant Pot along with bay leaves, garlic, ginger, and 3 cups water.
Seal lid and cook on High Pressure for 30 minutes. Allow natural pressure release for 10 minutes, then quick release remaining.
Using the back of a spoon, mash some of the dal to make it creamy while leaving most intact.
In a small saucepan, heat ghee. Add cumin seeds and let them sputter 30 seconds. Add tomato paste and cook until it absorbs the ghee, about 2 minutes.
Pour tomato-ghee mixture into the dal and mix well. Set pot to Saute and add a little water if needed for consistency.
Stir in yogurt and cream. Simmer 5 minutes on Saute. Garnish with cilantro and serve with naan or rice.

name: Instant Pot Chana Masala
description: Spiced chickpea curry with tomatoes and aromatic spices, pressure-cooked for deep flavor.
instructions: Set Instant Pot to Saute. Heat coconut oil, then add fennel seeds and cumin seeds. Cook 1-2 minutes until sizzling.
Add bay leaves and onion; cook 3 minutes until softened. Add garlic, ginger, and red chili; cook 1 minute until fragrant.
Stir in coriander, chili powder, and turmeric. Cook 1 minute. Add diced tomatoes, chickpeas, and water. Stir to combine. Hit Cancel.
Seal lid and set vent to Sealing. Cook on High Pressure for 5 minutes. Quick release the pressure.
Remove lid and stir in fresh cilantro. Season to taste with salt.
Serve over basmati rice or with naan. Squeeze fresh lemon juice over top if desired.

name: Instant Pot Mac and Cheese
description: Ultra-creamy homemade mac and cheese with three cheeses, cooked in the pressure cooker in minutes.
ingredients: 2 cups sharp cheddar cheese freshly grated
instructions: Add chicken broth, salt, garlic powder, onion powder, and paprika to Instant Pot. Stir to combine. Add elbow noodles and gently push down so they are submerged in the broth in an even layer.
Seal lid and set vent to Sealing. Cook on High Pressure for 3 minutes.
Allow natural pressure release for exactly 5 minutes, then quick release remaining pressure.
Open lid and stir to break up any clumped noodles. Stir in milk.
Add cheese in handfuls, stirring to melt after each addition. Fold in sour cream.
Stir until creamy and smooth. Adjust thickness with additional milk if needed. Serve immediately.

name: Instant Pot Spaghetti and Meatballs
description: One-pot spaghetti and meatballs with marinara sauce, cooked under pressure in just 8 minutes.
ingredients: 2 oz cream cheese or herb cheese
instructions: Set Instant Pot to Saute (High). Add olive oil and butter. Once melted, add shallots and garlic; saute 3 minutes.
Add meatballs, broth, 1.5 cups of the marinara sauce, and oregano. Stir well.
Break spaghetti in half and place in the pot in batches, smoothing with a spoon to submerge under the broth. DO NOT stir the spaghetti. Top with cherry tomatoes.
Seal lid and cook on High Pressure for 8 minutes. Quick release the pressure when done.
Stir the spaghetti to detach any clumped noodles. Add remaining 1.5 cups marinara, Parmesan, and cream cheese; stir until combined.
Allow to rest 5 minutes before serving so sauce thickens. Serve with additional Parmesan.

name: Instant Pot Mushroom Risotto
description: Creamy Arborio rice risotto with sauteed mushrooms and Parmesan, cooked under pressure in 6 minutes.
instructions: Set Instant Pot to Saute (High). Add oil and 2 tbsp butter. Once melted, add shallots and cook 2 minutes. Add garlic and cook 1 minute. Add mushrooms and remaining butter; saute 3 minutes until browned.
Pour in white wine; let bubble 1 minute while scraping up any browned bits from bottom of pot.
Add Arborio rice and stir to coat for 1 minute. Add broth, seasoned salt, pepper, Italian seasoning, and parsley. Stir well, again deglazing the bottom.
Seal lid and cook on High Pressure for 6 minutes. Quick release the pressure.
Immediately stir everything together; the risotto will come to the right creamy consistency upon stirring.
Stir in Parmesan and truffle oil if using. Transfer to a serving dish and enjoy immediately.

name: Instant Pot Chicken Biryani
description: Fragrant layered chicken and basmati rice biryani cooked under pressure with whole spices.
ingredients: 2 cups basmati rice rinsed and soaked 20 minutes
instructions: Marinate chicken in yogurt, ginger, garlic, jalapenos, garam masala, turmeric, and salt for 20 minutes (or overnight for deeper flavor).

Set Instant Pot to Saute (High). Heat ghee; add cumin seeds, cardamom, cloves, and cinnamon stick until sizzling. Add sliced onions and cook, stirring, until well-browned and crisp at the edges, about 12 minutes.
Add garlic and jalapenos; cook 2 minutes. Add marinated chicken and yogurt marinade to the pot. Stir to combine.
Drain soaked basmati rice and carefully spread over the chicken in an even layer. Pour in 1 cup water and gently push rice to submerge. Sprinkle cilantro and mint on top.
Seal lid and cook on High Pressure for 5 minutes. Allow full natural pressure release (about 15 minutes).
Open pot and gently fluff rice from bottom. Garnish with additional cilantro. Serve with raita.

name: Instant Pot Hard Boiled Eggs 5-5-5
description: Perfectly cooked hard boiled eggs using the foolproof 5-5-5 pressure cooker method for easy peeling.
instructions: Pour 1 cup of water into the Instant Pot inner pot. Place the trivet (rack) in the bottom.
Set eggs on the trivet in a single layer.
Seal lid and set vent to Sealing. Cook on High Pressure for 5 minutes.
When cook time is done, allow natural pressure release for 5 minutes. Do not touch the pot. Then quick release any remaining pressure.
Immediately transfer eggs to an ice bath or run under cold water for at least 5 minutes until fully cooled.
Peel right away — eggs release cleanly from the shell. Store unpeeled eggs in refrigerator up to 1 week.

name: Instant Pot Black Beans From Dry
description: Perfectly cooked black beans from dry in the Instant Pot with no soaking required.
instructions: Rinse dried black beans and pick out any debris. Set Instant Pot to Saute. Heat olive oil and cook onion, bell pepper, and jalapeno 2 minutes. Add garlic; cook 1 minute.
Add cumin, oregano, and tomato paste; stir 1 minute to toast spices. Add bay leaves. Hit Cancel.
Add rinsed beans and water. Stir well.
Seal lid and set vent to Sealing. Cook on High Pressure for 35 minutes.
Allow natural pressure release for 15 minutes. Slowly release any remaining pressure (beans may foam — release slowly).
Remove bay leaves. Add salt and stir. Roughly mash a portion of beans against the side for creamier texture. Garnish with cilantro and serve.

name: Instant Pot Cheesecake
description: Silky New York-style cheesecake cooked in the Instant Pot water bath method for a perfect creamy texture.
ingredients: 16 oz cream cheese at room temperature
instructions: Grease a 6-inch springform pan and line the bottom with parchment paper. Mix graham cracker crumbs with melted butter; press firmly into bottom of pan. Freeze 10 minutes.
Using a hand or stand mixer, beat cream cheese and sugar until smooth and creamy. Add eggs one at a time, mixing well after each. Mix in sour cream, vanilla, and flour until no lumps remain.
Pour batter over frozen crust. Cover pan tightly with aluminum foil.
Add 2 cups water to Instant Pot. Place trivet with handles inside. Carefully lower springform pan onto trivet.
Seal lid and cook on High Pressure for 35 minutes. Allow full natural pressure release (about 15-20 minutes).
Remove foil and let cheesecake cool on counter for 1 hour. Refrigerate uncovered at least 4 hours or overnight before serving. Run knife along edges before releasing springform.

name: Instant Pot Rice Pudding
description: Creamy Arborio rice pudding with vanilla and cinnamon, cooked under pressure for a silky dessert.
instructions: Combine Arborio rice, whole milk, sugar, and salt in the Instant Pot. Set pot to Saute and bring to a boil, stirring constantly to dissolve sugar.
Once mixture begins to boil, immediately seal lid. Cook on Low Pressure for 16 minutes.
While rice cooks, whisk eggs with half and half and vanilla extract in a bowl.
When cook time ends, turn pot off and wait 10 minutes before doing a quick pressure release. Carefully remove lid. Stir the rice.
Stir the egg mixture into the hot pudding. Set pot to Saute and cook, stirring, until pudding just begins to bubble, about 2 minutes. Turn off pot. Stir in raisins if using.
Serve warm or pour into dishes, cool to room temperature, then refrigerate. Dust with ground cinnamon before serving.

name: Instant Pot Chicken Bone Broth
description: Rich, collagen-packed chicken bone broth made hands-off in the Instant Pot in under 2 hours.
ingredients: 1 whole chicken carcass or 2 lbs chicken bones
2 stalks celery with leaves cut into quarters
instructions: Place chicken bones, carrot, onion, celery, thyme, peppercorns, and bay leaves into the Instant Pot.
Pour apple cider vinegar over bones and let sit 10 minutes (helps draw minerals from bones). Pour in cold water up to two-thirds max fill line.
Seal lid and set vent to Sealing. For bone broth: Cook on High Pressure for 120 minutes. For lighter chicken stock: cook 45 minutes.
Allow natural pressure release for at least 30 minutes before quick releasing any remaining pressure.
Remove lid and carefully strain broth through a fine mesh strainer into a large bowl or pot, discarding all solids.
Cool broth and refrigerate overnight. Skim fat from surface before using. Store refrigerated up to 5 days or freeze up to 3 months.

name: Instant Pot White Bean and Kale Soup
description: Hearty Italian white bean and kale soup with garlic and herbs, cooked under pressure in minutes.
ingredients: 2 (15 oz) cans great northern beans drained and rinsed
instructions: Set Instant Pot to Saute. Heat olive oil and cook onion, celery, carrots, red pepper flakes, pepper, salt, and oregano for 3 minutes until onions begin to soften. Add garlic and cook 30-60 seconds.
Pour in white wine and scrape up any browned bits from the bottom of the pot. Cook 1-2 minutes then hit Cancel.
Add vegetable broth, cubed potatoes, drained beans, and bay leaf. Stir to combine. Push kale into liquid.
Seal lid and set vent to Sealing. Cook on High Pressure for 5 minutes. Natural pressure release for 10 minutes, then quick release remaining.
Remove bay leaf. Stir everything together and taste for seasoning.
Ladle into bowls and top with grated Parmesan cheese if desired.

name: Instant Pot Beef Short Ribs
description: Fall-off-the-bone beef short ribs braised in red wine and herbs under high pressure.
instructions: Pat short ribs dry, season generously with salt and pepper, and dust lightly with flour.
Set Instant Pot to Saute (High). Heat olive oil and sear ribs in batches on all sides until browned, about 3 minutes per side. Remove and set aside.
Add onion and stir constantly for 3 minutes to deglaze pot. Add garlic; cook 1 minute. Add wine and scrape up all browned bits from bottom. Stir in tomato paste and broth.
Return short ribs to pot. Add thyme, bay leaves, and carrots.
Seal lid and cook on High Pressure for 45 minutes. Natural pressure release for 15 minutes, then quick release remaining.
Remove ribs. Discard thyme and bay leaves. Set pot to Saute; whisk in cornstarch slurry and simmer sauce 2 minutes to thicken. Pour over ribs and serve over mashed potatoes.

name: Instant Pot Corned Beef and Cabbage
description: Classic St. Patrick's Day corned beef with cabbage, potatoes, and carrots cooked under pressure.
ingredients: 3 lbs flat-cut corned beef brisket with spice packet
1 small head green cabbage cut into wedges
1 tbsp whole grain mustard for serving
instructions: Rinse corned beef brisket under cold water. Place fat-side up in the Instant Pot.
Add onion, garlic, peppercorns, and spice packet from the brisket. Pour in beef broth and water.
Seal lid and cook on High Pressure for 75 minutes. Natural pressure release for 15 minutes, then quick release remaining pressure.
Remove brisket to a cutting board and tent with foil. Add potatoes and carrots to the hot broth in the pot.
Seal lid and cook on High Pressure for 3 minutes. Quick release. Remove potatoes and carrots. Add cabbage wedges and cook on Saute for 5 minutes until tender.
Slice corned beef against the grain. Arrange on platter with vegetables. Serve with whole grain mustard.

name: Instant Pot Refried Beans
description: Creamy homemade refried beans from dry pinto beans, pressure-cooked to perfection.
ingredients: 2 tbsp lard or bacon fat or butter
instructions: Rinse dried pinto beans and add to Instant Pot. Add onion, garlic, cumin, chili powder, and water. Do not add salt yet (salt toughens beans).
Seal lid and set vent to Sealing. Cook on High Pressure for 45 minutes. Natural pressure release for 15 minutes, then slowly release any remaining pressure.
Drain beans, reserving 1 cup of cooking liquid.
Set pot to Saute. Add lard or butter. Add drained beans in batches and mash with a potato masher or immersion blender to desired consistency.
Add reserved cooking liquid as needed to reach desired texture (creamy but thick). Season with salt and pepper.
Serve as a side dish, in burritos, tacos, or as a dip with chips.

name: Instant Pot Dulce de Leche
description: Luscious caramel dulce de leche made effortlessly in the Instant Pot from sweetened condensed milk.
instructions: Remove labels from sweetened condensed milk cans. Do not open the cans.
Pour 2 cups water into the Instant Pot. Place trivet inside. Set unopened cans on their sides on the trivet. Make sure cans are completely covered by water — add more water if needed.
Seal lid and cook on High Pressure for 40 minutes. Allow full natural pressure release (about 20 minutes).
Carefully remove cans using tongs — they will be very hot. Allow cans to cool completely at room temperature before opening, at least 1 hour.
Once completely cool, open cans to reveal golden-brown dulce de leche.
Stir until smooth. Use as a dip, spread, ice cream topping, or filling for cakes and cookies. Store in refrigerator up to 2 weeks.

name: Instant Pot Whole Chicken
description: Juicy and tender whole roasted chicken cooked in the pressure cooker in just 25 minutes.
instructions: Pat whole chicken dry inside and out. Mix softened butter with garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, rosemary, salt, and pepper. Rub seasoned butter all over the outside of the chicken and under the breast skin.
Stuff the cavity with lemon quarters, garlic, and thyme sprigs.
Set Instant Pot to Saute (High). Heat olive oil and sear chicken breast-side down for 3 minutes until golden. Flip and sear 2 minutes more. Remove chicken.
Add chicken broth and deglaze bottom of pot. Place trivet inside and set chicken breast-side up on trivet.
Seal lid and cook on High Pressure for 25 minutes (for a 4-lb chicken; add 5 minutes for 5-lb). Natural release for 15 minutes, then quick release remaining.
Verify internal temperature reaches 165°F in the thickest part of the thigh. For crispy skin, broil in oven for 3-5 minutes. Rest 10 minutes before carving.

name: Instant Pot Vegetable Broth
description: Rich, golden vegetable broth made from kitchen scraps and aromatics in just 30 minutes.
ingredients: 3 stalks celery with leaves rough chopped
1 cup mushroom stems or sliced mushrooms
instructions: Set Instant Pot to Saute. Heat olive oil and add onions, carrots, and celery. Cook 5 minutes until lightly browned to develop flavor.
Add garlic (cut-side down), tomatoes, and mushrooms; cook 2 minutes more. Hit Cancel.
Add parsley, thyme, bay leaves, peppercorns, salt, and water. Do not fill above the two-thirds max fill line.
Seal lid and set vent to Sealing. Cook on High Pressure for 30 minutes. Allow natural pressure release for 15 minutes, then quick release any remaining.
Strain broth through a fine mesh strainer into a large bowl, pressing solids to extract all liquid. Discard solids.
Taste and adjust salt. Cool and store in the refrigerator up to 5 days or freeze up to 3 months.

name: Instant Pot Apple Butter
description: Smooth, spiced apple butter made in the pressure cooker in a fraction of traditional stovetop time.
ingredients: 5 lbs apples peeled cored and quartered (such as Fuji or Gala)
instructions: Add quartered apples, granulated sugar, brown sugar, apple cider, cinnamon, nutmeg, cloves, and allspice to the Instant Pot. Stir to combine.
Seal lid and cook on High Pressure for 8 minutes. Quick release the pressure.
Use an immersion blender to puree the apple mixture directly in the pot until completely smooth.
Set pot to Saute and cook uncovered, stirring frequently, until apple butter thickens to desired consistency, about 20 minutes.
Stir in vanilla extract and lemon juice. Taste and adjust sweetness with additional sugar if needed.
Pour into sterilized jars and refrigerate up to 3 weeks, or process in a hot water bath for shelf-stable storage.

name: Instant Pot Carnitas
description: Crispy Instant Pot pork carnitas with citrus and spices, pressure-cooked then broiled for the perfect crunch.
ingredients: 3 lbs boneless pork butt cut into 2-inch cubes
instructions: Place sliced onions and garlic in the bottom of the Instant Pot. Mix pork cubes with lemon juice, spices, salt, and pepper in a bowl.
Place seasoned pork on top of onions. Pour orange juice and water around the pork.
Seal lid and cook on High Pressure for 35 minutes. Allow natural pressure release for 10 minutes, then quick release remaining.
Remove pork to a cutting board and shred with two forks. Set pot to Saute and reduce remaining liquid to concentrate flavor.

Heat coconut oil in a large cast iron skillet over high heat. Spread shredded pork in a single layer and cook undisturbed until crispy and browned, about 3-4 minutes. Drizzle some concentrated broth over the crispy meat.
Serve in corn tortillas with salsa, cilantro, and diced onion.

name: Instant Pot Hummus From Scratch
description: Ultra-creamy homemade hummus made from dried chickpeas cooked in the pressure cooker, smoother than any can.
ingredients: 2-4 tbsp ice cold water to blend
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil for serving
instructions: Add dried chickpeas, 4 cups water, and baking soda to the Instant Pot (baking soda helps chickpeas get ultra-creamy).
Seal lid and cook on High Pressure for 40 minutes. Allow natural pressure release for 10 minutes, then quick release remaining.
Drain chickpeas but reserve 1/2 cup cooking liquid. While still warm, add chickpeas to a food processor or blender.
Add tahini, lemon juice, garlic, cumin, and salt. Process 1 minute.
With motor running, drizzle in ice cold water 1 tbsp at a time until hummus reaches a smooth, fluffy consistency. Taste and adjust lemon and salt.
Transfer to a serving bowl. Drizzle with olive oil and sprinkle paprika and fresh parsley.
